src: Kuwo umoya walesikhatsi kanye nekuhambisana nemoya webuntfu, iKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi basite labo labeswele kanye nemindeni emimangweni yabo.
tgt: Sisizwe esikhathalelanayo, esihloniphanayo kwaye nesibancedayo aba basweleyo.

src: Sisive lesinakekelanako, lesihloniphanako futsi leseseka labo labanenhlanhla lencane.
tgt: Lo Nyaka Mtsha uzayo usinika ithuba sonke sokuba sizibophelele kwakhona ekusebenzeleni ikamva eliqaqambileyo lethu sonke.

src: Emavi endvudvuto.
tgt: Imiyalezo yovelwano.

src: IKhabhinethi yendlulisa emavi ayo endvudvuto, kulila kanye nekuvelana nemndeni nebangani baMohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, loshone ngaLesibili, mhla ti-8 Ingongoni.

tgt: UMnu Edward Xolisa Makaya njenge-DDG: Afrika kwiSebe lezobuDlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano.

src: Mnu Omega Shelembe njenga-DDG: Kwengamela Emabhizinisi Ahulumende Nekutfutfukiswa Netheknoloji Yelwatiso Lwetekuchumana kuLitiko Letakhiwonchanti Tetekuchumanisa Netinsita Teliposi (i-DPS),.
tgt: Ngelokuqumbela, iKhabhinethi yenza umbulelo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abathobele umthetho bangenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu, into ebonakalisa ukuba zingxelo zerhafu ezizigidi eziyi-5.94 ezingenisiweyo ngabahlawuli berhafu abenimivuzo kuphela.

src: Kwephetsa, iKhabhinethi yendlulisa kubonga kwayo bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labangenise emaphepha abo ekukhokha umtselo lokwente kutsi kube nebantfu labatigidzi leti-5.94 labangenise emaphepha abo ekukhokha umtselo yebakhokhintsela labaholako.
tgt: Eli nani linyuke nge-11.52% kwelama-2014, kwaye abo bafake iingxelo zerhafu kwangexesha bangaphezulu kwama-90% iminyaka emithathu ilandelelana.

src: Loku kwente-11.52 wemaphesenti lasetulu kunalawo anga-2014, futsi kufaka ngesikhatsi emaphepha ekukhokha umtselo kwendlule emaphesenti lange-90 eminyaka lemitsatfu lelandzelanako.
tgt: Eli nani liphezulu labo bafake iingxelo zabo zerhafu ngexesha kunceda urhulumente ukuba akwazi ukuhambisa iinkonzo futhi aphucule umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.

src: Lokwenta tintfo ngendlela lefanele kwenta hulumende kutsi akwati kwetfula tinsita letiphucula lizinga lemphilo lato tonkhe takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ngeli thuba leeholide zokuphela konyaka, urhulumente uza kuqalisa ngamaphulo ahlukeneyo aza kufuna bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika nabo basindwendweleyo ukuba badlale eyabo indima ukuqinisekisa ukuba eli xesha leeholide zokuphela konyaka lonwatyelwa kwiimeko ezikhuselekileyo nezingenazingozi.

src: Kulesikhatsi semaholide nemigubho, hulumende ufezekisa imikhankhaso leminyenti leyehlukene ledzinga kutsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye netivakashi badlale indzima yabo ekucinisekiseni kutsi lesikhatsi semaholide aKhisimusi sitfokotelwa kusimondzawo lesiphephile nalesivikelekile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuye wonke umntu ukuba asebenzisane nabeNkonzo zesiPolisa zoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) kwaye baxele kwabasemagunyeni zonke izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho kumakhaya ethu neendawo esihlala kuzo.

src: IKhabhinethi imema wonkhe umuntfu kutsi asebentisane neLuphiko Lwetemisebenti Yemaphoyisa LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) nekutsi babike tento tebugebengu emakhaya etfu nasemimangweni.
tgt: Ukuze sikwazi ukumelana nabahambi abaninzi abaphuma kumazwe angaphandle, onke amasebe karhulumente kumazibuko okungena kweli ukusuka ngomhla we-10 kweyoMnga kowama-2015 ukuya kutsho kowe-14 kweyoMqungu ngowama-2016 aza kuwandisa amaxesha omsebenzi.

src: Bonkhe basebentisi bemgwaco bacelwa kutsi bahloniphe imitsetfo yemgwaco, kufaka ekhatsi kuhlonipha imikhawulo yetivinini tekuhamba emgwacweni bacinisekise kutsi timoto tabo tinguletifanele kutsi tingaba semgwacweni bangashayeli badzakiwe babuye futsi bafase emabhandi ekuphepha.
tgt: Bonke abasebenzisi bendlela bayabongozwa ukuba bathobele imithetho yendlela, kuquka nokuqhuba ngokwesantya esifanelekileyo ukuqinisekisa ukuba iimoto zabo zikulungele ukuba sendleleni bangaqhubi benxilile futhi banxibe iibhanti zokuzikhusela.

src: Labahamba ngetinyawo bacelwa kutsi bangafaki engotini timphilo tabo kanye netebashayeli.
tgt: Abahambi ngeenyawo bayacelwa ukuba baqinisekise ukuba xa besendleleni ababeki ubomi babo okanye obabaqhubi engozini.

src: Umnotfo.
tgt: Uqoqosho.

src: IKhabinethi ihlangene kute icocisane ngesimo setemnotfo kanye nangetindzaba letiphatselene nebhajethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibihlangene ngeenjongo zokuxoxa ngobume bezoqoqosho nemiba enxulumene nohlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: IKhabhinethi ibone kutsi kunemaphuzu lamanengi lanelifutse emnotfweni walelive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele imiba eliqela enempembelelo kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Simo semnotfo emhlabeni wonkhe sibe ngulesibi kakhulu kuletinyanga letisandza kwendlula.
tgt: Kwezi nyanga zakutsha nje imeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi iye isiba mbi.

src: Kukhula komnotfo lokuhamba kancane emhlabeni wonkhe kukhomba kutsi, kahle hle kunebutsakatsaka emnotfweni kanye nebungoti lobusetulu kumave lamanyenti lasatfutfuka, lokufaka ekhatsi nelive lase-China.
tgt: Uhlumo loqoqosho olucothayo ehlabathini jikelele, ingakumbi, lubonakalisa ukuqhuba kakubi kunye nemingcipheko ephezulu kumazwe abalulekileyo asakhulayo aliqela, aquka neChina.

src: Lokuvuka kwemnotfo lokulindzeleke e-USA kunawubanga kutsi kube nekwenyuka, emhlabeni wonkhe, kwemali loyikhokha nawuboleke imali.
tgt: Ukuphucuka kohlumo loqoqosho kwelizwe laseMelika (i-USA) obekulangazelelwa ngamazwe onke ehlabathi kulindeleke ukuba kungakhokelela ekunyukeni kwenzala kwimali-mboleko kwihlabathini jikelele.

src: Kwehla kwemtsamo wekuhwebelana kanye nekungatinti etimakethe temhlaba tekutsenga nekutsengisa emasheya kusho kutsi kunesidzingo sekutsi tive ticine futsi tente tintfo ngekucophelela kulesikhatsi lesitako.
tgt: Umthamo ophantsi kurhwebo nombhodamo kurhwebo lwhlabathi kubethelelela ukubaluleka kokuba amazwe ehlabathi kufuneka aqine kwaye achule ukunyathela kwezi nyanga zimbalwa zizayo.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi yabona kutsi kube nekuzuza lokutsite ngekuba phasi kwentsengo yawoyela longakahlutwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphele ukuba iyeyakhona iinzuzo kwixabiso eliphantsi le-oli ekrwada.

src: Live laseNingizimu Afrika njengaloku lelive lelihweba kakhulu ngekutfumela timbiwa ngephandle, likhatsatekile ngalokuchubeka kwekwehla kwentsengo yekutsengwa kwetimbiwa.
tgt: Njengelizwe elithumela ikakhulu izimbiwa kumazwe angaphandle, uMzantsi Afrika uxhalabile kukuhla okuqhubekayo kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa.

src: Hulumende uyachubeka ngekwakha etikwalesimo semnotfo salelive lesihlukahlukene, kantsi netinzuzo talokutfunyelwa ngephandle kuyachubeka ngekusima kakhulu kulokuyinsimbi kanye nasetintfweni letisengakaguculwa.
tgt: Urhulumente usaqhuba ekwakheni kwiziseko zoqoqosho ezahlukahlukeneyo zeli lizwe, kwaye ingeniso evela ekuthunyelweni kwemveliso kumazwe angaphandle kuyaqhuba ukuxhomekeka ikakhulu kwisinyithi kunye neempahla zorhwebo ezingalungiselelwanga ngokugqibeleleyo.

src: Lokwehla kwentsengo yetimbiwa kutawuphindza futsi kubuyele esimeni sako ngekushesha.
tgt: Ukwehla kwamaxabiso ezimbiwa akukhangeleki ngathi kungatshintsha ngokukhawuleza.

src: Loko kutakwenta kutsi kube nemphumela losimeme emnotfweni waseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemave amanengi abalingani betfu elivenikati lase-Afrika.
tgt: Oku kuza kuba neziphumo ezibi kuqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika nakuninzi lamazwe esirhweba nawo kwilizwekazi le-Afrika..Ukwehla kwexabiso leRandi kule minyaka imbalwa idlulileyo kunika ithemba elingcono kuhlumo lwemveliso ethunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle kwaye, kudityaniswe nexabiso le-oli eliphantsi ehlabathini jikelele, kuye kwanceda kwanika isiqabu kuxinzelelo kwimali ekhoyo karhulumente.

src: Kwehla kwemandla eLirandi kuleminyaka lembalwa leyengcile kunika ematsemba lancono ekukhula kwemtsamo wetimpahla letitfunyelwa ngephandle, kanye nekuhlangana nentsengo lephasi yawoyela, kusite ekutseni kwehlise kucindzeteleka kwisikhwama semali yelive.
tgt: Nangona kunjalo, uhlumo olubuthathaka kumahlakani ezorhwebo aphambili oMzantsi Afrika luye lwathetha ukuhla kwezinga ezifunwa ngalo iimveliso zoMzantsi Afrika kumazwe angaphesheya.

src: Noma kunjalo, lokukhula lokubutsakatsaka kumave labahwebelana neNingizimu Afrika kusho kudzingeka ngendlela lephasi kwemikhicito yaseNingizimu Afrika kumave angaphandle.
tgt: Imeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi jikelele ithathwa njengomngeni ingakumbi kumazwe asakhulayo, nanamaxabiso aphantsi ezimbiwa nokuqiniswa kwemigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali e-USA okubeka uxinizelelo ekungeneni nasekuphumeni kwemali namazinga ohlumo alindelekileyo.

src: Simo semnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe sitsatseka njengalesinensayeya kumave lasafufusa, lokuhambisana nentsengo lephasi yetimbiwa kanye nekucina kwenchubomgomo yetemnotfo eMelika lokuyintfo leletsa kucindzeteleka kulutjalotimali nekukhula lokulindzelekile.
tgt: Oku kukhokelele ekubeni kungabikho zinzo kuqoqosho lwehlabathi.

src: Loku kubange kutsi kube nekungatinti lokukhulu kutimakthe temhlaba tekutsenga nekutsengisa emasheya.
tgt: IRandi yaseMzantsi Afrika, neseyiphakathi kwezinye zeemali ekurhwetywa ngayo kakhulu yamazwe asakhulayo, ibethwe ngokukodwa zimeko zoqoqosho kwezi veki zisanda kudlula.

src: Lirandi laseNingizimu Afrika, lelisemkhatsini wetimali temave lasafufusa lekuhwebelana ngato kakhulu, lishayeke kakhulu kulamaviki lengcile.
tgt: Kule meko imaxongo kuqoqosho lwehlabathi, apho onke amazwe ajongene nemingeni enzima iKhabhinethi iphinde yakubethelela ukubaluleka kokuba urhulumente angenelele ngobuchule nangokupheleleyo ukubuyisela isantya uqoqosho obeluhluma ngayo.

src: Kulesimo semnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe lesimatima, lapho onkhe emave ebukene netinsayeya letimatima, Ikhabhinethi isicinisekisile sidzingo sekutsi hulumende angenelele ngezikhatsi lezithize kanye nangekutsatsa sincumo sekubuyisa litubane lekukhula kwemnotfo.
tgt: IsiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) siwalungiselele la manyathelo okungenelela.

src: Luhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) luniketa letinyatselo tekungenelela.
tgt: Urhulumente uza kuthethana namahlakani akhe, ingakumbi abezoshishino nemibutho yezabasebenzi, ukuze kufikelelwe kwizivumelwano ngamanyathelo ekuza kubanjiswana ngawo ukomeleza uqoqosho, ukwakha ukuthembeka, ukunyusa izinga lotyalo-mali nokubuyisela uMzantsi Afrika kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho oluquka wonke umntu.

src: Inkhulumo Yebunjalo Belive mhla ti-11 Indlovana itawuchaza ngalowo msebenti.
tgt: INtetho engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA) eza kuba ngomhla we-11 kweyoMdumba iza kuwuthathela ingqalelo lo msebenzi.

src: IKhabhinethi yesekele tinyatselo letimatima tekubuyisa indlela lesimeme yetimali tahulumende, ngekubuka lesimo lesibutsakatsaka setemnotfo wemhlaba wonkhe kanye nemphumela waso lapha kulelive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphumeze amanyathelo aluqilima ukubuyisela umzila wezezimali ozinzileyo, iyithathele ingqalelo inkangeleko ebuthathaka yoqoqosho lwehlabathi jikelele kunye nemiphumela yayo apha ekhaya.

src: Indvuna Yetetimali Pravin Gordhan utawuchaza leto tinyatselo ngesikhatsi etfula ibhajethi yavelonkhe mhla tinge-24 Indlovana Kusitwa ngetimali Kwemfundvo LephakemeIKhabhinethi itivumile tichibiyelo kuluphakelo lwebhajethi yavelonkhe letitawugudluta imali kute kusitwe emanyuvesi ngetimali ngaphandle kwekuphula imikhawulo yencitfomali lemenyetelwe phambilini.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan uza kuwachaza la manyathelo xa esenza intetho yakhe yohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yowama-20.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma neNdvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha Blade Nzimande basandza kusho kutsi loluphakelo lwekubukana nekutsi timali tekufundza enyuvesi tingenyuki kulomnyakakufundza losetulu njengaloku kuvunyelenwe, kwesula sikweleti sebafundzi labakweleda Sikhwama Savelonkhe Sekusita Bafundzi Ngetimali (i-NSFAS) kanye nekuvikela kutsi lesikweleti singakhuli esikhatsini sethemu lesemkhatsini.
tgt: Inkxaso-mali yezeMfundo ePhakamileyoIKhabhinethi iziphumezile izilungisokuhlahlo lwabiwo-mali lesizwe apho kuza kuxulwa imali ukuze ixhase iidyunivesithi kungakhange kophulwe izicwangciso zenkcitho ezasibhengezo esasenziwe somda wenkcitho.

src: Letinyatselo tekungenelela tingumphumela wemihlangano leminyenti lebekhona lecale ngeMphala 2015 kantsi nanyalo solo isachubeka.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMphathiswa weMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho uBlade Nzimande kutsha nje bachaze ukuba ezi mali ziza kuvala isikroba esivelileyo ngenxa yokunganyuswa kwemali yokufunda ekuvunyelwene ngako kulo nyaka, ukucima amatyala asele ekhulile atyalwa ngabafundi beSkimu soNcedo lwezeZimali saBafundi seSizwe (i-NSFAS) nokuthintela ukukhula kwamatyala lawo kwisigaba WEBTOKEN manyathelo okua aziziphumo zothotho lweentlanganiso ezaqala kweyeDwarha yowama-2015 nezisaqhubekayo sithetha nje.

src: Indvuna Yetemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha kanye nelitsimba lakhe letekulawula babambe imihlangano leminyenti nebaholi be-SASCO, Imikhandlu Lemele Bafundzi (ema-SRC), Inhlangano Yemanyuvesi aseNingizimu Afrika, Inyonyana Yebafundzi baseNingizimu Afrika, ema-CEO ema-SETA, Inhlangano Yeluntjintjo Kwetemfudvo Lephakeme kanye neLikomidi lasePhalamende lelibukene nemfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezeMfundo noQeqesho neqela lakhe labalawuli ubambe iintlanganiso ezininzi neenkokheli ze--SASCO, onke amaBhunga abaMeli babaFundi (ii-SRC), uMbutho weeDyunivesithi zaseMzantsi Afrika, iManyano yabaFundi baseMzantsi Afrika , amaGosa aziNtloko zeziGqeba zoLawulo (ii-CEO) we-SETA, uMbutho weNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo kunye nekomiti yasePalamente ejongene nezemfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Mengameli uphindze futsi wabamba umhlangano nebaholi bebafundzi waphindze wamemetela kutsi utawusukumisa Likhomishana lelitawuhlola letinkinga letivele kuTemfundvo Lephakeme.
tgt: UMongameli naye ukwadibene kunye neenkokheli zabafundi waza wavakalisa ngokumiselwa kweKhomishini eza kuqwalasela imiba ephakanyiswe kwicandelo lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo.

src: Letinkhulumiswano tisachubeka njengaloku singuhulumende sifuna kutfola likhambi lesikhatsi lesidze.
tgt: Ezi ndibano zisaqhuba kuba njengorhulumente sikholelwa ekubeni siyafuna ukusebenzela ekufumaneni isisombululo esiza kusabela kuzo zonke ezi ngxaki.

src: Letimfuno tebafundzi tihambisana netinjongo teluhlelo lwahulumende lolumayelana netemfundvo.
tgt: Izinyanzeliso zabafundi ziyahambelana neenjongo zenkqubo karhulumente ngokumalunga nezemfundo.

src: Njengesinyatselo lesiphutfumako, sekukhokhwe tigidzigidzi le-R2,33 kute kusonjululwe kushoda kwemali mayelana netimali tekusebenta kwemanyuvesi ngenca yalesivumelwane sekwenyusa imali yekufundza yanga-2016 nga-0%.
tgt: Njengenyathelo elikhawulezileyo, imali eyi-2.3 yeebhiliyoni zeerandi ibekelwe bucala ukuncedisa kwimali ethi yaphela esithubeni yemisebenzi yemihla ngemihla yeedyunivesithi ngenxa yesivumelwano sokunganyuswa kwemali yokufunda ngowama-20.

src: Ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2016/17, hulumende ubeke embili R2,543 yetigidzigidzi temali yembuso yekusita kutsi yabelwe i-NSFAS kutsi inikete kubolekiswa kwemali kute kusitwe bafundzi labange-71 753 lababonakele kutsi bayafaneleke kutsi basitwe ngetimali i-NSFAS kepha bangasitwa ngalokugcwele nome abazange sebasitwe sanhlobo vele kuyo yonkhe leminyakakufundza lemitsatfu leyengcile.
tgt: Ngonyaka-mali wowama-2016/17, urhulumente uphinde wabekela bucala imali eyi-2.543 yeebhiliyoni zeerandi kwimali karhulumente ukuba iye kwi-NSFAS ukuze ibonelele ngemali-mboleko yokunceda abafundi abachongiweyo abangama-71 753 nabafanelekileyo ukuba bangafumana inkxaso-mali ye-NSFAS kodwa banikwa nje inkxaso-mali engaphelelanga okanye abayinikwa tu kule minyaka yabo mithathu idlulileyo.

src: Loku kusho kutsi labo bafundzi labafanele kutsi basitwe ngeke bavinjelwe kutsi bachubeke netimfundvo tabo ngobe bakwelata emanyuvesi imali yekufundza lesilele.
tgt: Oku kuthetha ukuthi aba bafundi bafanelekileyo abazokuthintelwa ekubeni baqhubekeke ngezifundo zabo ngenxa yokuba betyala idyunivesithi.

src: Letinye futsi tigidzigidzi leti-R.039 titawukwabelwa i-NSFAS ngemnyakamabhuku wanga-2016/17 kute kusekelwe ngetimali bafundzi labangakasitwa ngetimali nome labasitwe kancane kepha labasasenyuvesi nga-2016 kute baphotfule tifundvo tabo.
tgt: Enye imali eyi-2.039 yeebhiliyoni zeerandi iza kwabelwa i-NSFAS kunyaka-mali wama-2016/17 ukuze ixhase abafundi abangaxhaswanga okanye abangaxhaswanga ngokupheleleyo abasesedyunivesithi ngowama-2016 ukuze bagqibe izifundo zabo.

src: Letimali tengeta kuletigidzigidzi leti-R10 i-NSFAS letatisebentisa ngemnyakakufundza wanga-2016.Hulumende utimisele kunika imfundvo yamahhala ngemuva kwamatekuletjeni kubo bonkhe bafundzi labafanele ngekwetemfundvo labaphuyile nalabo bantfu labasebentako, ngekungengci imikhawulo lesimeme yetetimali tahulumende.
tgt: Le nkxaso-mali yongeza imali ezibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-10 eza kunikezelwa yi-NSFAS kunyaka wemfundo wama-2016.Urhulumente uzinikele ekuboneleleni ngemfundo yamabanga aphakamileyo yasimahla kubo bonke abafundi abafanelekileyo abangathatha ntweni abakumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, kodwa oku ngokokuvuma kwepokotho karhulumente.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bafundzi, basebenti, tifundziswa kanye nebaphatsi bemanyuvesi kutsi basebentisane nahulumende kute kufezeke lenjongo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abafundi, abasebenzi, abahlohli kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo kunye nabalawuli basezidyunivesithi ukuba basebenzisane norhulumente ukufezekisa le njongo iphambili.

src: Tento letitsikameta kufundza nome letidala kutsi kulindzeleke tintfo letingeke tifezeke tite imbuyiselo.
tgt: Iintshukumo eziphazamisa ukufunda okanye ezidala oko kungafanelekanga okanye ukulindelwa koko kungenakufezekiswa zingathathwa njengezinxamnye nenenkqubela phambili.

src: Ludlame nekuwesabisa akwemukeleki.
tgt: Ubundlobongela nokugrogrisa akwamkelekanga tu kwaphela.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika babone kutsi kunetimo letiyinsayeya esikhatsini lesitako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bakuqonde ukuba ukuba kukho iimeko eziyimingeni kweli xesha sijonge kulo.

src: Timo tetemnotfo temhlaba wonkhe tibutsakatsaka.
tgt: Uqoqosho lwehlabathini luyadodobala.

src: Lifutse lelibi lentsengo lephasi yetimbiwa selivele liyavela eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Iziphumo zamaxabiso aphantsi ezimbiwa sele zibonakala eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kudvonsa kamatima kwalelive njengekunganeli kwekuphakelwa kwagezi solo kusekhona.
tgt: Iingxaki zala ekhaya ezifana nokunqongophala kombane zisasombethe.

src: Lesomiso lesikhulu sibanga bumatima etifundzeni letinengi.
tgt: Imbalela emandla yenza kube nzima kumaphondo aliqela.

src: IKhabhinethi inelitsemba kutsi bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika batawukhombisa kuba sive lesicinile lesikwatiko kubaluleka kwekusebenta ngekubambisana ngekuthula nangekuvana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqinisekile ukuba abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayakuhlala besisizwe esikwaziyo ukumelana neenzima, ukusebenzisana ngoxolo nemvisiswano.

src: Lokuvela kwalabo labanebuhlanga lokusandza kwenteka kucinise kutinikela kwetfu sonkhe ekwakheni sive lesite buhlanga, lesite kucwasana ngebulili nalesiphumelelako.
tgt: Ukubhentsa kwabathile kutsha nje ukuba basakholelwa kubuhlanga kuye kwasenza sonke sazinikela nangakumbi ekwakheni isizwe esingenacalucalulo ngokobuhlanga, ngokwesini nesinekamva eliqaqambileyo.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleniIKhabhinethi ikuvumile kubekwa etikhundleni kwalaba labalandzelako:.
tgt: IzikhundlaIKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqeshwa kwaba balandelayo:.

src: Kufezekiswa kwetinhlelo tahulumende letibalulekile.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele Inkhulumo yaMengameli Jacob Zuma Yebunjalo Belive layetfule ngaLesine, mhla ti-11 Indlov.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho engoBume beSizwe kaMongameli Jacob Zuma ayenze ngoLwesine umhla we-11 kweyoMdumba.

src: Lenkhulumo ibe ngumhlahlandlela wendlelalisu lekucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo tahulumende.
tgt: Le ntetho ibonise indlela mayelana nokusebenza kwenkqubo karhulumente yokungena endimeni.

src: Mengameli ucele hulumende, betemisebenti kanye nebetemabhizinisi kutsi basebentisane ekutfoleni tisombululo tekukhula kwemnotfo losimeme.
tgt: UMongameli umemelele urhulumente, abasebenzi namashishini ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana ukuze bafumane izisombululo eziza kunceda ekukhuliseni uqoqosho ngokuzingileyo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyatisekela letinyatselo tekunciphisa tindleko letimemetelwe nguMengameli, Indvuna Yetetimali letawuphindza yenabe kabanti ngato mhla tinge-24 Indlovana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amanyathelo okuthoba inkcitho, manyathelo lawo aza kwaziswa nguMphathiswa wezeMali ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba.

src: Inkhulumo Yemcombelelo yanga-2016/17 itawuphindza futsi ichaze kabanti ngekuphakelwa kwemitfombolusito letawucondziswa etinhlelweni letahlukahlukene tahulumende njengaloku kugcizelelwe nguMengameli.
tgt: INtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-malii lowama-2016/17 iza kuphinda ibonise indlela yokwabiwa kwamancedo ngokweenkqubo ngeenkqubo zikarhulumente, ngokokugxinisisa kukaMongameli.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukele imphumelelo yeMining Indaba, lebeyibanjelwe lapha eKapa kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-11 Indlovana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgqungquthela yezeMigodi ebibanjelwe ngempumelelo eKapa ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-11 kweyoMdumba.

src: Baholi labamelele umkhakha wetimayini kanye nabohulumende labanengi base-Afrika bashiyelene ngekuvisisa kwabo lokujulile mayelana nekutsi lomkhakha ungatihola kanjani tekusisa ngetimali kanye nekusebentisa lamatfuba lakhona lapha e-Afrika.
tgt: Abameli abaphambili becandelo lezemigodi noorhululumente abaninzi base-Afrika babelana ngeembono zabo malunga nendlela eli candelo elingaluqhuba ngayo utyalo-mali lixhamle nakumathuba akhoyo e-Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuncomile kakhulu kutinikela kwahulumende waseJapani kutsi utawukhulisa tekusisa tawo lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqhwabele izandla ukuzinikela korhulumente waseJapan ekunyuseni utyalo-mali lwayo eMzantsi Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yakucinisekisa futsi kutinikela kwayo kutsi kube nemkhakha wetimayini losimeme nalochumako.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqinisekisa ukuzinikela kwayo kwicandelo lezemigodi elizinzileyo neliphumelelayo.

src: Sivumelwane seLuhlakamsebenti Lwemboni Yetimayini Lesimeme sisekele imboni yetimayini kulesimondzawo lesikhona lesimatima.
tgt: IsiCwangciso-sikhokelo sesiVumelwano seCandelo lezeMigodi eliZinzileyo sixhasa icandelo lezemigodi kule meko inzima igqubayo.

src: Hulumende uyachubeka nekunika siciniseko setekulawula futsi utawucinisekisa kutsi Umtsetfosivivinyo Wetimbiwa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemitfombolusito Yephethroliyamu, losasetandleni tePhalamende uyaphotfulwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko inika ingcaciso kunye nesiqinisekiso ngemithetho elawula ezemigodi kwaye iza kuqinisekisa ukuqukunjelwa koMthetho osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweziMbiwa nePetroliyam osePalamente kungoku nje.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Letibalulekile.
tgt: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyivumile Inchubomgomo yekugcina Yavelonkhe Yekugembula, lebukana netinsayeya letikhinyabeta kusebenta ngemphumelelo kweMtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekugembula, 2004 (Umtsetfo we-7 wa-2004).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMgaqo-nkqubo wokugqibela weSizwe wokuNgcakaza ojongene nemingeni ethintela ukusebenza kakuhle koMthetho weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza, wowama-2004 (uMthetho uNombolo 7 wowama-2007).

src: Lenchubomgomo seyivele seyihanjisiwe yayiswa kummango kutsi ucale inchubo yekubonisana ngayo.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele kuboniswene ngawo noluntu.

src: Lenchubomgomo iphakamisa tichibiyelo kuluhlakamsebenti lwesakhiwo sekulawula semabhodi etekugembula kanye nekucinisa tindlela tekuphatsa kute kuncishiswe kusetjentiswa kabi kwekugembula.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza nezilungiso kwimithetho elawula iibhodi zokungcakaza, kwaye iqinisa imiqathango yolawulo ukuze kuhle ukusetyenziswa kakubi kokungcakaza.

src: Loku kusebenta kumakhasino, kumabhingo, emishinini yekukhokha kanye nekubheja emahhashi.
tgt: Usebenza kwiikhasino, kwi-bingo, koomatshini bokungcakaza abangahlawuli kakhulu nasekubhejeni emidyharhweni yamahashe.

src: Lenchubomgomo itakwenta kutsi Umlawuli Wavelonkhe Wetekugembula atsatse sikhundla seBhodi Yavelonkhe Yetekugembula lotawubika ngco kuLitiko Letekuhweba Netimboni.
tgt: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kutshintsha iBhodi yeSizwe yezokuNgcakaza, ijike ibe nguMlawuli weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza oza kuba phantsi kweSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa kweMbiko Lomayelana Nekubuketwa Kwemnyaka Webudzala Lophasi Wekucala Kwenta Bugebengu ePhalamende, lokudzingekako kuMtsetfo Webulungiswa Bebantfwana, wanga-2008 (Umtsetfo we-75 wanga-2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iNgxelo engokuPhononongwa kweYona miNyaka iVumelekileyo ukuba uBani angaBekwa iTyala loLwaphulo-mthetho ingeniswe ePalamente ngokommiselo woMthetho wezoBulungisa baBantwana, wowama-2008 (uMthetho uNombolo 75 wowama-2008).

src: Lombiko uncoma kutsi lelive lemukele tibophelelo tetifundza kanye netemave ngemave mayelana nemnyaka lophasi webudzala wekucala kwenta bugebengu kubantfwana labaphambana nemtsetfo.
tgt: Le ngxelo ikhuthaza ukuba ilizwe eli lamkele izinyanzeliso zamazwe ngamazwe nezeengingqi malunga neyona minyaka mincinci ivumelekileyo yabantwana abanokuthi baphule ngayo umthetho.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kugazetwa Kwetindzawo Tekutfutfukisa Emandla Lavusetelelekako (i-REDZ).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kwiphephandaba lombuso kweZiza zokuPhuhliswa kwaMandla aHlaziyekayo (i-REDZ).

src: Loku kutawuhlela kahle inchubo yekulawula, kutfolwe tindzawo lapho umoya netheknoloji yekushisa kwelilanga i-Photovoltaic ingakhutsatwa khona kanye nalapho igridi ‘lejulile’ ingacondziswa khona.
tgt: Ezi ziza ziza kucwangcisa iinkqubo zokumisela imithetho, zichonge iindawo apho ubuxhakaxhaka bobuchwepheshe bomoya nelanga be-photovoltaic bungakhuthazwa khona nalapho bungalawulwa khona.

src: Lama-REDZ atawusicinisekisa kuntjintjela kumnotfo lonekhabhoni lephasi, kutsi kube nentfuntfuko yesakhiwonchanti lesisheshisako, kanye nekufaka ligalelo lelibumbene kanye neluhlakamsebenti lolulawulako lolucombelekako lolunciphisa indendende yekulandzela kuhleleka kwetintfo letiphatselene netindleko tekuhambelana.
tgt: Ezi REDZ ziza kuqinisekisa ukutshintshela kuqoqosho olusebenzisa ikharbon ephantsi, zikhawulezise uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, kwaye zibe negalelo kwimithetho evakalayo necacileyo eza kuphugula ubucukubhede obuhambelana nexabiso lokuthobela.. IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zowama-2014 zeNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yeziKhombisi zeNzululwazi, ubuChwephweshe nobuChule bokuYila yeBhunga leSizwe leeNgcebiso ngezokuYila.

src: IKhabhinethi yatjelwa ngalamafisha mayelana naloko lokwatfolwa nguMbiko wa-2014 weSayensi yaseNingizimu Afrika, Ithekhinoloji Netinkhomba Tekwenta Lokusha weMkandlu Wavelonkhe Wetekweluleka mayelana Nekwenta Lokusha.
tgt: Le yingxelo yezinto ezenzekayo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yeSizwe yezokuYila (i-NSI).

src: Lombiko unika tindlelamkhuba ekusebenteni kweLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekwenta Lokusha (i-NSI).
tgt: Ihlola ukwenza umsebenzi negalelo le-NSI kwizinto eziphambili ezingundoqo kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).

src: Ihlola kusebenta kanye neligalelo le-NSI etintfweni tavelonkhe letibekwe embili njengaloku kusho Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfuntfuko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukusetyenziswa kwamagosa karhulumente adla umhlalaphantsi nalowo asaqeshiweyo njengabahlohli kwisiKolo sikaZwelonke sikaRhulumente (i-NSG).I-NSG yaqala ukusebenza ngowama-2013, sithatha indawo yeZiko lokuQeqesha ubuNkokeli noLawulo (i-PALAMA), kwaye sigunyaziswe ukuba sikhuthaze ukuphuhla okuphucukileyo kwezinto ezingundoqo nemithetho-siseko elawula ulawulo lwamagosa karhulumente kwaye sibe semgangathweni, sibe nefuthe ekuphuhliseni izakhono zabasebenzi kumaziko.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kusetjentiswa kwebafundzisi bemfundvo lephakeme lesetitsatse umhlalaphasi kanye netisebenti tahulumende leticashwe ngalokugcwele kutsi tisebente eSikolweni Savelonkhe Sahulumende (i-NSG)I-NSG yatfulwa ngemnyaka wa-2013, kutsi itsatse sikhundla seBuholi Bekuphatsa Ummango Nekulawula Temfundvo (i-PALAMA), futsi igunyatwe kutsi itfutfukise emagugu lachubekela embili kanye nemitsetfomgomo lebusa kuphatfwa kwemmango kanye nekwenta ncono bunjalo, nekuchubekisela embili lifutse letentfutfuko yemtfombolusito lebantfu kuletikhungo.
tgt: Eli linge liza kukhe livavanywe kuqala nokusebenza kweNKqubo esisiNyanzelo yoQhelaniso yabasebenzi bakarhulumente.

src: Lesichamkelo sitawulingwa kusebenta kanye nekucala kusetjentiswa kweLuhlelo Loludzingekile Lwekutayatisa tisebenti tahulumende.
tgt: Le nkqubo yenza abasebenzi bakarhulumente babe lulutho kwinkonzo karhulumente.

src: Lendlela isita tisebenti tahulumende kutsi tibe nguletineligalelo emsebentini wahulumende.
tgt: Baza kwabelana ngamava abo, ubungcali, izakhono kunye nolwazi ukuze bacebise kwaye bancede abasebenzi bakarhulumente.

src: Titawundlulisa sipiliyoni sato, bungcwethi, emakhono kanye nelwati lwekufundzisa kanye nekucecesha tisebenti tahulumende.
tgt: Eli linge liza kuphinda liphucule kakuhle nangendlela eyonga inkcitho izinga leenkonzo esizinika uluntu.

src: Lesichamukelo sitawuphindza futsi sente ncono kutsi kube nekuletfwa kwetinsitakalo kubantfu letisezingeni ngemiphumela futsi ngendlela lengabiti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume iNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yesiGaba sesi-3 sokuGqibela engokuPhunyezwa koMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso loQoqosho (i-OECD) (iSivumelwano esiChasana nokuNyoba.

src: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umbiko waseNingizimu Afrika Wesigaba Sekugcina se-3 Selive lomayelana Nekucala Kwekusebenta Kwenhlangano Yetemnotfo Yekusebenta Ngekubambisana kanye Nentfutfuko (i-OECD), (Ingcugcutsela Lelwisana Nekudiza).
tgt: Le ngxelo iza kungeniswa kwiQela eliSebenza ngokuNyoba.

src: Lombiko ukhombisa inchubekelembili leseyentiwe nguhulumende mayelana netingenelelo takhe tekulwa nekudiza lokwentiwa mave angaphandle ngekutsi akutfungatse akutfole, akuphenye aphindze ashushise labo labakwentako.
tgt: Ingxelo le icacisa nenkqubela karhulumente ekungeneleleni kwakhe athintele ukunyotywa ngabamanye amazwe, ngokukubona, ukukuphanda nokubutshutshisa.

src: Lombiko uphindze futsi ugcamise sichamukelo lesesentiwe sekucaphelisa ummango mayelana nalobugebengu.7 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kutsi Litiko Letasekhaya (i-DHA) lehlukaniswe libe ngephasi Kwebulungiswa, Kuvikela Bugebengu kanye Neliphiko Lekuphepha Ligunya leLitiko Letasekhaya kutsi ligcine bunguye bemuntfu lobuphephile, nekubhaliswa lokungiko kanye nesimo sabo bonkhe labangekhatsi kulomncele walelive, lokusinyatselo lesimcoka sekwenta yonkhe leminye imisebenti yembuso.
tgt: Ingxelo ikwagqamisa nelinge lokuvula abantu amehlo ngolu lwaphulo-mthetho.

src: Liphindze futsi lagunyatwa kutsi lilawule luhlelo lwekungena nekufika kulelive, lokuyintfo lenelifutse ngco ekuphepheni kwavelonkhe, kubumbana kutenhlalo kanye nekufezekiswa kwetinjongo tentfutfuko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) lihlelwe ngokutsha libe phantsi kweNtlanganisela yezoBulungisa, uThintelo lolwaPhulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.

src: Ngaphambilini i-DHA beyihleleke njengensitakalo letayelekile yekuphatsa yekusekela lengaphasi kweKulawula neLiphiko Letekuphatsa.
tgt: I-DHA igunyaziswe ukuba ligcine irejista eluqilima, echanekileyo yokuba ngoobani, isithini imeko yabo, bonke abangaphakathi kwemida yeli lizwe, nto leyo encedisa kakhulu kweminye imisebenzi karhulumente.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuvikela, Kukhangisa, Kutfutfukisa kanye Nekulawulwa Kwelwati Lwendzabuko.
tgt: Isebe likwagunyaziswe ukuba liphathe inkqubo yemfuduko, enefuthe ngqo kukhuseleko lwesizwe, ukunamathelana koluntu nokuphumeleliswa kweenjongo zophuhliso.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo, wekuvikela, kukhangisa, kutfutfukisa kanye nekulawula Lwati Lwendzabuko.
tgt: Kwilixa elingaphambili, eli Sebe lalihlelwe njengelixhasa ngeenkonzo zolawulo linqumbene nezokuPhatha kunye nezoLawulo.

src: Unika emandla ekusungula kanye nemisebenti yelihhovisi Lelwati Lwendzabuko Lwavelonkhe, kulawulwa kwemalungelo alabo labanelwati lwendzabuko, kusungulwa kanye nemisebenti yelitsimba lelilulekako macondzana nelwati lwendzabuko.
tgt: Imithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo wokuKhusela, ukuKhuthaza, ukuPhuhlisa nokuLawula uLwazi lweMveli.

src: Uphindze futsi uvumele kutsi ukhone kufinyelela kanye netimo tekuvunyelwakulwati lwendzabuko kanye nakumimango yendzawo, kusungulwa kwesilulu savelonkhe selwati lwendzabuko, kubhaliswa, kuvunyelwa ngekucinisekiswa kanye nekunikwa sitifiketi kwalabo labasebenta ngelwati lwendzabuko, kuhambisa nekuchumanisa lwati lwendzabuko lolweyame ekwenteni lokusha.
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo injongo yawo kukukhusela, ukukhuthaza ukuphuhliswa nokulawulwa kweenkqubo zoLwazi lweMveli.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawusebentisana Nemtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemphahla Loticambele, 2013 (Umtsetfo we-28 wa-2013).IKhabhinethi iluvumile lushicilelo lweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Kubhaliswa Kwematayitela kute ummango uphawule ngalo.
tgt: Ubonelela ngokusekwa nangemisebenzi yeofisi yeeNkqubo zeSizwe zoLwazi lweMveli, ulawulo lamalungelo abo banolwazi lwemveli, ukusekwa nemisebenzi yabantu aBacebisi malunga neenkqubo zolwazi lwemveli.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wekubhaliswa Kwematayitela, 1937 (Umtsetfo we-47 wa-1937) kute kusukwe kutindleleni tekusebentisa emaphepha kepha kuyiwe kutindlela telihhovisi lematayitela le-elekthroniki.
tgt: Ukwavumela ukufikelela kunye nemiqathango yokufikelela kulwazi ngabahlali bomthonyama nabendawo, ukusekwa kwenkqubo yesizwe yokurekhoda iinkqubo zolwazi lwemveli, ukubhalisa, ukugunyazisa nokunikwa kweencwadi ezifaneleyo iincutshe zemveli, ukulungiselela nokulungelelanisa ulwazi lwemveli olungqiyame ngezinto ezintsha.

src: Ubukana netindzaba tekuphepha ngobe unika kutsi labandluliswa ematayitela babhalise njengalabasebentisa loluhlelo lwekubhalisa lwe-elekthroniki.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuphila Kwetitfombo (i-Phytosanitary).
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo uza kufezekisa iSilungiso seMithetho yoLwazi olungoloMqambi walo kuphela we- 2013 (uMthetho wama-28 we- 2013).IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kweSilungiso soMthetho osaYilwayo wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zeMihlaba zowe-2015 ukuze uluntu luphefumle ngaso.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo wenta kutsi kushaywa kwemtsetfo waseNingizimu Afrika kuhambisane netibopho letifanele kanye nemazinga kute kube nekuhwebelana lokuphephile nalokungavuni licala kwemave ngemave kute kutsi kwehwebelana ngetitfombo nangemikhicito yetitfombo kwasekhaya nekwemave ngemave kwalelive kube ngulokuphephile.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zoMhlaba we-1937 (uMthetho wama- 47 we-1937) ukuze iofisi yezi ncwadi ibe yala maxesha asebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo nasewuphasisiwe, live lase Ningizimu Afrika litawukhona kuvikela kungena kweluhlupho lolubuya emaveni langephandle kanye netifo letingabhebhetsekisa loluhlupho loluyingoti kanye netifo tetitfombo kulelive.
tgt: Loo nto ijonga imiba yokhuseleko ngokubonelela ngokubhaliswa kwabo bancutsheza ngokususa umhlaba komnye umntu uye komnye njengabagunyaziswe ukusebenzisa le nkqubo yokubhaliswa kwemihlaba ngobuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.2 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo weMpilo yeZityalo yowe-2015.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetinkantolo.
tgt: Lo mthetho osayilwayo ulungelelanisa umthetho woMzantsi Afrika nezinyanzeliso kunye nemigangatho efaneleyo ukulungiselela urhwebo olukhuselekileyo nolungakhethi cala lamazwe ngamazwe ukuqinisa urhwebo lwasekhaya nolwamazwe ngamazwe lwezityalo neziveliso zezityalo.

src: LoMtsetfo uchibiyela Umtsetfo Wetimantji Tetinkantolo, 1944 (Umtsetfo we-32 wa-1944) kanye Nemtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Tinkantolo Letiphakeme, 2013 (Umtsetfo we-10 wa-2013).Letichibiyelo tihlose kudzambisa inhlupheko yalabakweletako labatikhandza sebachashatwa nguloluhlelo lwekugcogca tikweleti etinkantolo tetimantji kanye nekubandzakanya umklamo weLitiko Letekuhweba Netimboni wekususa lwatiso lolungasiluhle lwebatsengi.
tgt: Wakuba uphunyeziwe lo mthetho osayilwayo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kukwazi ukuthintela ukungena kwezitshabalalisi zasemazweni ezivalelweyo ngenxa yezifo ezibulalayo kwanezifo ezinokusasaza izitshabalalisi ezinobungozi nezifo zezityalo elizweni.

src: LoMtsetfo uhlose kuchibiyela tigaba teMtsetfo Wetimantji Tetinkantolo, 1994 (Umtsetfo we-32 wa-1994) (I-MCA) kute kulungiswe kuchashatwa kuMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Tinkhokhelo (i-EAO).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osiSilungiso osaYilwayo weeNkundla zamaTyala we-2015.Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1944 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1944) noMthetho osiSilungiso weeNkundla eziPhakamileyo we-2013 (uMthetho we-10 we-2013).Ezi zilungiso zijonge ukwenza lula imeko yabakwelitayo abazifumana bengamaxhoba okuphathwa kakubi yinkqubo yokuqokelelwa kwamatyala kwiinkundla zemantyi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kulungisa nekucedza tehlulelo letiphuma ngalokungemtsetfo, ikakhulu letikhishwa bomabhalane betinkantolo ngaphandle kweliso letebulungiswa, etikhatsini letinyenti ngekungabi nesipiliyoni nome ngekuvumelana nalabakweletwako, bameli babo nome bagcogci betikweleti.
tgt: Zikwajonge nokulungiselela iprojekthi yeSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino yokuguzula iinkcukacha ezimbi zesikweliti somthengi.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawucinisekisa kutsi labakweletako baniketwa tehlulelo letihambisana nemtsetfo wesitolimende nome Umtsetfo Wetinkhokhelo Nekudliwa letisemtsetfweni wekukhokha titolimende.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ufuna ukulungisa amacandelo athile oMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1994 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1994) ukuze ujongane nokuphathwa kakubi kwiziHlomelo zeMiyalelo yokuNyanzelisa ukuHlawulwa (i-EAO).

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi balisebentise lelitfuba bahloniphe futsi lentsandvo yelinyenti leyatfolwa kamatima ngekutsi baphume bayowusebentisa lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti babhalise baphindze bavote kulolukhetfo lolutako.2 Mengameli Zuma utawube avakashele ngekwembuso e-Islamic Republic of Iran kusukela mhla tinge-28 kuya mhla tinge-29 Indlovana2016.Lokuvakasha kutawucinisa budlelwane betfu betepolitiki nebetemnotfo nelive lase-Iran kanye nekugcugcutela budlelwane emkhatsini weNingizimu Afrika ne-Iran.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ujonge kwanokuphelisa izigwebo eziwiswa ngokungekuko, isikakhulu ngoomabhalane abangenaliso lamthetho, kumaxa amaninzi ngenxa yokungabi namava okanye ngokwenza igumgedle nabakwelitwayo, amagqwetha abo okanye abaqokeleli bezikweliti.

src: NjengeMkomuzi Lomkhulu Wembutfo Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF), Mengameli Zuma utawugubha Lusuku Lwembutfo Lohlomile lwesigaba sesihlanu eBhayi, eMphumalanga Kapa, mhla tinge-21 Indlovana 2016.
tgt: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo uza kuqinisekisa ukuba abakwelitwayo bagwetyelwa ngendela ehambelana nomyalelo wokuhlawula ngezavenge okanye i-Emoluments Attachment Order ekwimida esemthethweni yokuhlawula ngezavenge.

src: Lomcimbi lowentiwa minyaka yonkhe wekukhombisa kwesekela nekubonga bomake nabobabe labaseMbutfweni Wavelonkhe Wetekuvikela waseNingizimu Afrika.3 Mengameli Zuma utawukhuluma ekuvulweni Kwendlu Yavelonkhe Yebaholi Bendzabuko ePhalamende, eKapa mhla tinge-26 Indlovanae 2016.
tgt: Imisitho ezayo.1 Impelaveki yokuqala yokubhaliswa kwabavoti bebhaliselwa uNyulo lowe-2016 loRhulumente waseKhaya iza kuba ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.

src: Budlelwane emkhatsini wahulumende nebaholi bendzabuko bubalulekile njengaloku bonkhe basebentela kwenta ncono timphilo tebantfu.4 NgeMgcibelo mhla tinge-20 Indlovana2016, Lisekela Mengameli Cyril Ramaphosa utawube ahola litsimba Letindvuna lelitawuya eMbukisweni WaMengameli Wekutfutfukisa Lusha lotawubanjelwa lapha eGrace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abahlali boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baluxhamle kwaye baluzimase olu lawulo lwentando yesininzi olufumaneke nzima ngokuthi baphume balisebenzise ilungelo labo lolawulo lwentando yesininzi babhalise kwaye bavote kolu nyulo luzayo.2 UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwaseburhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran ukususela ngomhla wama- 28 ukuya kowama-29 kweyoMdumba ngowe- 2016.Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa ukunxibelelana okusoloko kuqhubeka kwezopolitiko noqoqosho ne-Iran kwaye luvuselele nobudlelwane phakathi kwamazwe aseZantsi kunye naseNtla kwe-Ikhweyitha.

src: Lombukiso wesekelwa ngematiko eTindzaba Tasekhaya, Lemisebenti, Lekutfutfukisa Tenhlalo kanye Neletekuvikela.
tgt: NjengeNkumanda ePhezulu yoMbutho weSizwe wezoKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika (i-SAND), uMongameli Zuma uza kuphatha umcimbi woSuku lwecandelo loMkhosi lesihlanu.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe bantfu labasha kulendzawo kutsi baye kulombukiso, ngobe utawubanika lwatiso mayelana nekutsi bangatichuba njani tifundvo tabo, bangawasungula njani emabhizinisi nome yini labangakuzuza kuleto tichamukelo tekubasekela letentiwa nguhulumende.5 IKhabhinethi iwuvumile Umhlangano Wesifundza lomayelana Nekuvikela Bantfu ngalokuphatselene Nebulili Lobuguculiwe, Ngekwebulili kanye Nekukhuluma, lobitwe Ikhomishani yaseNingizimu Afrika Yemalungelo Eluntfu, kusukela mhla ti-3 kute kube mhla ti-5 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.Lomhlangano utawenta kutsi kube nekukhulumisana kute kube nekuvisisana lokukhulu netimbangela letisisusa kanye nekubonakala kwaletinsayeya kute kutfolakale tisombululo letiphatsekako kanye netindlela letikhona embusweni ekulungiseni nalokukuchashatwa.6 IKhabhinethi ibafisela lokuhle bonkhe bafundzi lababhala luhlolo Lwekuchibiyela libanga lamatekuletjeni.
tgt: Lo mbhiyozo owenziwa unyaka nonyaka ubonisa inkxaso nombulelo kumadoda namabhinqa oMkhosi weSizwe woKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika.3 UMongameli Zuma uza kuthetha xa kuvulwa iNdlu yeSizwe yeeNkokheli zeMveli ePalamente eKapa ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016.

src: Bafundzi bayagcugcutelwa kutsi bafinyelele ekutfoleni loluhlelo lwelitfuba lesibili lolusha losandza kwetfulwa lwekusekela bakamatekuletjeni lolutfolakala kuto tonkhe tifundza lolusita bafundzi etifundvweni tabo ngemitfombolusito leyahlukahlukene.
tgt: Ubudlelwane phakathi korhulumente neenkokheli zemveli bubaluleke kakhulu kuba zisebenzela ukuphucula ubomi babantu.4 NgoMgqibelo umhla wama-20 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016, uSekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokhela igqiza laBaphathiswa ukuya kuMboniso kaMongameli woPhuhliso loLutsha eGrace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.

src: Injongo Yaloluhlelo Lwelitfuba Lesibili Lwamatekuletjeni kunika bantfu labasha labangakaphumeleli kutsi bakhone kuhlangabetana netidzingo Tesitifiketi Savelonkhe Samatekuletjeni (i-NSC) litfuba lesibili lekutsi batfole matekuletjeni ngaleyo ndlela bente ncono lizinga letimphilo tabo.
tgt: Lo mboniso uxhaswa ngamasebe emiCimbi yaseKhaya, ezabaSebenzi, oPhuhliso loLuntu noKhuselo.

src: Luhlolo lwekuchibiyela luyincenye Yeluhlelo lwelitiko Lwelitfuba Lesibili Lwamatekuletjeni futsi lunika bafundzi labahlulekile kutfola tindzingo letiphasi tekuphumelela netekutfola sitifiketi, kepha labadzinga tifundvo letimbili letisetulu kute batfole i-NSC.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abantu abatsha baloo ndawo ukuba baye kulo mboniso oza kubonelela ngolwazi lokuqhubela phambili ezifundweni,ukuqala amashishini abo okanye ukuncedwa ngamalinge karhulumente enkxaso.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo lesentiwe nguMengameli semagama emalunga eLikhomishani Yekuphenya Imfundvo Lephakeme.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubanjwa kweNdibano ye-Afrika engokuKhuselwa kwaBantu ngokweNdlela abaziBona, Abazichaza nabaZazi ngayo iSini sabi yiKhomishoni yoMzantsi Afrika yamaLungelo oLuntu ukususela ngomhla we-3 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.

src: Ikhabhinethi icela bonkhe labatsintsekako Kutemfundvo Lephakeme kutsi bafake ligalelo kulomsebenti welikhomishani kute kutfolakale sisombululo sesikhatsi lesidze saletinsayeya Imfundvo Lephakeme lebukene nato.
tgt: Le semina iza kulungiselela uthethathethwano ukuze kubekho kuqondwe ngakumbi oyena nobangela ongundoqo wale mingeni nokuzibonakalisa kwayo ukuze kufumaneke izisombululo ezibonakalayo nezinto ezikhoyo okunokukhethwa kuzo nguRhulumente ukujongana nolu lwaphulo.6 IKhabhinethi inqwenelela impumelelo bonke abafundi ababhala iimviwo zabo zokuxabangela iBanga le-12.

src: Lokushiwo yiKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letimcoka eveni.1 Indvuna Yetimbiwa Mosebenzi Zwane, Indvuna Yelihhovisi Lamengameli Susan Shabangu kanye Nendvuna Yetentfutfuko Yebantfu Bathabile Dlamini – labebakhetfwe nguMengameli kutsi basekele hulumende wesifundza, tisebenti tasemayini kanye nemindeni letsintsekile emva kwalengoti leyenteke eLily Gold Mine eBhabutini – babikela Ikhabhinethi kafishane mayelana nalokusha lokwentekako.
tgt: Abafundi bakhuthazwa ukuxhamla iNkqubo esandula ukusungulwa enika abafundi umnyinyiva wesibini wokubhala iimviwo zebanga le-12.

src: Ikhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli ekuceleni sive kutsi sikhumbule letisebenti tasemayini letintsatfu letisolo tivaleleke ngephasi kwemgodzi kanye nemindeni yato sitithandazele sicabange ngato futsi.2 IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngesomiso lesisolo sihlasele letinye tincenye talelive.
tgt: Ikho kuwo onke amaphondo kwaye inceda abafundi ezifundweni zabo ngezixhobo.

src: Ikhabhinethi iyabonga kakhulu kulabo bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika, labasekela imitamo yekulwa nesomiso.
tgt: Injongo yeli Thuba lesiBini lokuBhala iBanga le-12 kukunika abantu abatsha abangaliphumelelanga ibanga le-12 umnyinyiva wesibini wokupasa, ngaloo ndlela baphucule izinga lobomi babo.

src: IKhabhinethi itsandza kuvakalisa kudvumisa kwayo kulabo labalalele lesicelo sekubika nome ngabe ngukuphi kuvuta kwemanti ngekusekela Umkhankhaso Wekulwa Nekuvuta loholwa yiNdvuna Yetemanti Nekuhanjiswa Kwekungcola Nomvula Mokonyane.
tgt: Iimviwo zokuxabangela ziyinxalenye yeNkquba yokuNika iThuba lesiBini lokuBhala iiMviwo zeBanga le-12 yesebe kwaye inceda abo bangaphumelelanga nabangafumananga ziqinisekiso, kodwa befuna ubuncinane izifundo ezibini ukuze babe bapasile.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawudvumisa sibili lomoya weBuntfu lokhonjiswe ngulesichamkelo lebesiholwa i-Operation Hydrate lesente umehluko emimangweni lebeyihlukumetekile.3 IKhabhinethi ibambe tinkhulumomphikiswano yaphindze yawuphuma umphumela logcwele waloMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemtselo, 2014.
tgt: Imemelela bonke abanomdla nabachaphazelekayo kwiMfundo ePhakamileyo ukuba babe negalelo emsebenzini wekhomoshoni ukuze kufunyanwe isisombululo esiza kuhlala sihleli semingeni ejongene nayo iMfundo ePhakamileyo.1 Uluvo lweKhabhinethi malunga nemiba esematheniUMphathiswa weSebe lemiThombo yeziMbiwa uMosebenzi Zwane, ovela kwiSebe likaMongameli uSusan Shabangu noMphathiswa weSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu uBathabile Dlamini—abakhethwa nguMongameli Zuma ukubonelela ngenkxaso urhulumente wephondo, abasebenzi-mgodini neentsapho ezichaphazelekayo emva kwentlekele kuMgodi iLiily Gold Mine eBarberton – bachazele iKhabhinethi ngokutsha okwenzekayo.

src: Ngekusho kwalo Mtsetfo, kwentiwa umholo wempesheni kwetinzuzo tesikhwama semhlalaphasi kutawucala mhla ti-01 Indlovuylenkhulu 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazibandakanya noMongameli ekumemeleleni isizwe ukuba sicinge ngabasebenzi-mgodini abathathu abasabambeke phantsi komhlaba kwaye sibathandazele.

src: Loku kusho kutsi kusukela ngalolo lusuku, tinzuzo tesikhwama sephrovidenti netinzuzo tesikhwama sempeshini titawuphatfwa ngalokufananako ngendlela yekutsi emalunga langaphasi kwesikhwama sephrovidenti atawutsi nakasatsatsa umhlalaphasi avunyelwe kutsi atsatse kunye kulokutsatfu etinzuzeni tesikhwama sawo sephrovidenti lokungukheshi njengenkhokhelo lesamba bese kutsi kubili kwalokutsatfu lokusele batawukusebentisela kutfola imiholo yenyanga nasetsatse umhlalaphasi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ixhalabile yimbalela esachaphazela iindawo ezithile zelizwe.

src: Letingucuko kulomtsetfo titsintsa labo labahola kakhulu kanye nabo bonkhe labangaphasi kwalesikhwama sephrovidenti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvuyo lwayo kwabo basabele ikhwelo lokuxela ukuvuza kwamanzi ngolo hlobo bexhasa iPhulo loMphathiswa waManzi noCoceko uNomvula Mokonyanene.

src: Tinhlangano letinyenti kanye nebantfu bavakalise kukhatsateka kwabo mayelana nekucala kusebenta kwaletingucuko letinsha ngaleyo ndlela base benta tetfulo kuhulumende ngaloko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyela umoya wobuntu obubonakaliswe liphulo elikhokhelwa yiOperation Hydrate nelenze umahluko kubahlali ababandezelekileyo.2 IKhabhinethi ixoxile yaqwalesela iziphumo ngokupheleleyo zokuqalisa koMthetho osisiLungiso seMithetho yeRhafu we-2014.

src: Kuyabonakala kutsi nanome kube netinchubo tekubonisana kabanti ngembikwekutsi lomtsetfo uphasiswe, loko kukhatsateka kusasekhona nekutsi loko kukhala kufanele kutsi kubukwe ngekushesha kute kucinisekiswe kutsi ngesikhatsi letingucuko tetinzuzo kusikhwama sephrovidenti ticala kusebenta kufanele tenteke kahle futsi ngemphumelelo.
tgt: Ngokwalo Mthetho, ukuhlawulwa kwemali esisigxina kwingxowamali egciniweyo kuza kuqalisa ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla ngo-2016.

src: Ngaleso sizatfu-ke, Ikhabhinethi incume kutsi kube nekuchibiyelwa kwaloMtsetfo Wekuchibiyela Imitsetfo Yemtselo njengeludzaba loluphutfumako kuhlehliswe lusuku lwamhla lu-01 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 lwabekwa mhla lu-01 Indlovulenkhulu 2018 kute kube nekubonisana nalabatsintsekako labamcoka.
tgt: Loo nto ithetha ukuthi ukususela ngaloo mhla amancedo aloo ngxowa aza kufana nawomhlala-phantsi lo uqhelekileyo kuba amalungu aloo ngxowamali xa athatha umhlalaphantsi aza kuvunyelwa ukuba athathe isambukru esiziinkozo esisinye esithathwini kumancedo.

src: Lokubonisana kungaholela kulokunye futsi kuchibiyelwa kwalemitsetfo.
tgt: Imali esalayo kuza kufuneka amalungu ayisebenzise athenge imali enikwa umntu ngomnyaka ebomini bakhe bonke.

src: Bhishobhi Modise uhole lelibandla lelinemalunga langetulu kwetigidzi letintsatfu eNingizimu ye-Afrika, alandzela ekushoneni kweyise nemsunguli walelibandla, uyise Comforter Frederick Modise nga-1996.
tgt: Ngeso sizathu, iKhabhinethi igqibe kwelokuba yandlale ngokungxamiseke kakhulu isilungiso kuMthetho osiSilungiso seMithetho yeeRhafu ungaqalisi ukusebenza loo mthetho ngomhla wokuqa kweyoKwindla kowe-2016, koko uqale ukusebenza ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla kowe-2018 ukwenzela ukuba kuphinde kuthethathethwane nabachaphazelekayo.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindza futsi ivakalisa kudzabuka kwayo ngekundlula emhlabeni kwaMabhalane Jikelele waphambilini waMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Shifu Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: Amazwi ovelwano.1 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano ngokubhubha koHloniphekileyo uBhishophu Glayton Modise weInternational Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: Wacala kusebenta nga-1992 ngesikhatsi lapho kunemtselela waMhlabuhlangene macondzana nemphi yaseGulf, wasebenta ithemu yinye yesikhatsi seminyaka lesihlanu.
tgt: UBhishophu Modise ukhokhele ibandla elinamalungu angaphezu kweemiliyoni ezintathu kumazantsi eAfrika, emva kokubhubha kukayise nongumseki waloo cawe oHloniphekileyo uComforter Frederick Modise ngowe-19.2 IKhabhinethi ikwavakalisa uvelwano lwayo olunzulu ngokubhubha kutsha nje kwayesakuba nguNobhala-jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo, iNkosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

src: Utawukhunjulwa ngeligalelo lakhe labenalo etindzabeni tekuthula netentsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: Ungene kweso sikhundla ngowe-1992 xa ifuthe lo mbutho lo likhula emva kwemfazwe yeGulf, wasebenza iminyaka emihlanu.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Umnu Kevin Govender lobuya eHhovisi leliseKapa Lelwatitinkhanyenti kute kube Nentfutfuko kanye Nenyonyana Yemave Ngemave Yelwatitinkhanyenti yabosotinkhanyenti lotawuba aklonyeliswa ngekuhlanganyela Indondo yase-Edinburg ya-2016 ngekusungula Lelihhovisi Lelwatitinkhanyenti Kute kube Nentfutfuko leliseKapa.
tgt: Ubhubhe kwisibhedlele saseCairo eneminyaka engama- Uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe kuxolo nolawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Govender uwekucala waseNingizimu Afrika kutsi atfole lomklomelo kutesayensi nethekhinoloji lefaka ligalelo ekuvisiseni nakutenhlalakahle yeluntfu.
tgt: Imiyalezo yokuvuyisana.1 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMnu.

src: IKhabhinethi imshayela lihlombe umdansi webhaleyi loneminyaka le-16 budzala Leroy Mokgatle lozuze umklomelo Wekutsandvwa Tetsameli kanye nemfundzate e-Prix de Lausanne International Ballet Competition eSwitzerland.
tgt: Kevin Govender we-Cape Town-based Office of Astronomy for Development and the International Astronomical Union oza kuwonga ngembasa enodumo iEdinburgh Medal yowe-2016 ngokuseka iOffice of Astronomy for Development eKapa.

src: Ungumuntfu wekucala waseNingizimu Afrika kutfola lomfundzate eminyakeni lenge-28 aphindze abe wesibili emlandvweni walelive.
tgt: UGovender ngummi wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika ukufumana le mbasa yodumo ngempumelelo kwezenzululwazi netheknoloji, nto leyo ebenegalelo ekuqondeni uluntu nempilo yalo.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye naMengameli Zuma ekuhalaliseni labo labaphumelele kuMkomelo Wesibili Wemnyaka Webuntfu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithi halala kuLeroy Mokgatle ongumdanisi weballet nominyaka ili-16 owine imbasa iAudience Favourite nemali yokufunda kukhuphiswano i-International Ballet Competition eSwitzerland.

src: Lamaciko abantfu labasivusela inshisekelo futsi baphakamisela etulu umjeka waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ngummi wokuqala waseMzantsi Afrika owine le mali yokufunda kwiminyaka engama- 28 kwaye ngowesibini ukwenza oko kwimbali yeli lizwe.

src: Kubekwa etikhundleniKonkhe kucashwa kuya ngekucinisekiswa kweticu tabo kanye nekuvunyelwa lokufanele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izibandakanya noMongameli Zuma ngokuvuyisana nabo baphumelele i-2nd Annual Ubuntu Awards.

src: Ibhodi Yemanti yaseNyakatfo neLepelle:a) Umhlonishwa Thovhele Tshivhase (Sihlalo)b) Umnu Matsebe Ivor Phasha (Lisekela Lasihlalo)c) Make Thandeka Thembekile Celiwe Hlongwa (lilunga)d) Umnu Boxing Phillemon Sebola (lilunga)e) Umnu Ntale Herold Matsepe (lilunga)f) Make Mankone Mabataung Ntsaba (lilunga)g) Make L Malamba (lilunga)h) Make Josephine Mampheri Letsoalo (lilunga) nai) Make Makgetsi Annabelle Mphahlele (lilunga).
tgt: Ezi zimbasa eziwonga iinkokheli zoshishino zaseMzantsi Afrika nabantu ababalaseleyo ngenxa yegalelo labo ekukhuthazeni izinto zethu zesizwe nezo zobomi ezingundoqo ehlabathini liphela.

src: U-Advocate JB Skosana ucashwe njengeLisekela Lemcondzisi Jikelele (i-DDG): Tinsitakalo Tasenkantolo kuLitiko Letebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa Kwemtsetfosisekelo (i-DoJ&CD).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nombethi-mbande uWouter Kellerman, cappella group Ladysmith Black Mambazo nomculi wegospile uNeville D ngokuba ngabakhethiweyo kwiGrammy yowe-2016.

src: Kucala kwekusebenta kwetinhlelo letimcoka tahulumende IKhabhinethi iyemukele Inkhulumomcombelelo ya-2016 letfulwe yiNdvuna Yetetimali Pravin Gordhan mhla tinge-24 Indlovana 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali yowama-2016 ethe yenziwa nguMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yama-2016.

src: LoMcombelelo ukhombisa kukhona kwetfu kumelana nebumatima, kutinikela kanye nekuhlakanipha njengaloku sikhona kubhukula kulesikhatsi sesimo semnotfo lesibi emlandvweni losandza kwendlula.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lubonakalisa ukomelela, ukuzinikela nokuba nobuchule njengoko sichankcatha kwelona xesha lakhe lanzima kwezoqoqosho ezimbalini.

src: Lomcombelelo uhlangabetana naloko lelive lelikudzingako uphindze udale kutsi siwetsembe lomnotfo ngekutsi sibeke lelive endleleni yetekukhula kwemnotfo longukhukhulelangoco, losimeme nalesingawetsemba futsi.
tgt: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali luhlangabezana noko eli lizwe likudingayo kwaye lukwadala intembeko kwezoqoqosho ngokubeka eli lizwe kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho ethembakeleyo, ezinzileyo nedibene ngokuphilisayo.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze futsi iyachubeka yemukela tinyatselo letimcoka letitsatsiwe tekunciphisa tindleko iphindze futsi iyatinikela ekusebentisaneni ngekuhlanganyela nayo yonkhe imikhakha ekufakeni ligalelo lemtamo wavelonkhe kutsi kucale kusebente letinyatselo letishiwo nakwetfulwa umcombelelo.
tgt: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo abalulekileyo okugcina iindleko ziphantsi kwemo elawulekayo kwaye ikwazibophelela ekusebenzisaneni nawo onke amacandelo ekwenzeni igalelo kwilinge elidibeneyo lesizwe ukuphumeza umlima-ndlela omiselwe luhlahlo lwabiwo-mali.

src: IKhabhinethi yemukela Licembu Lebetindzaba Lamengameli (i-PPC) leletfulwe nguMengameli Jacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa kweQela looNondaba likaMongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma.

src: Le-PPC itawakhiwa bahleli betepolitiki, bachumanisi betepolitiki, lababika ngetepolitiki kanye netintsatseli teteminotfo letigunyatwe kutsi tibike ngetindzaba letitsintsa Lihhovisi Lamengameli ngalokuchubekako kanye nangalokugcwele.
tgt: I-PPC izakuquka abahleli bezopolitiko, iintatheli zezopolitiko, oonondaba bezopolitiko neentatheli zezoqoqosho eziqinisekisiweyo ukuba zizo ezinegunya lokukhupha ingxelo nge-Ofisi kaMongameli ngokupheleleyo zihlale zisenza njalo rhoqo.

src: Inhloso ye-PPC kutsi betindzaba banike kufinyelela lokuncono kulwatiso.
tgt: Injongo ye-PPC kukubonelela amajelo eendaba ngokufikelela okuphuculiweyo kulwazi.

src: Itawuphindza futsi yente kube ncono kutsi betindzaba bafinyelele kuMengameli kanye naseHhovisi Lamengameli, kute kucinisekiswe kutsi tintsatseli nato titfola lwatiso lolwendvulelako kanye netinchubo kute tente ncono kuvisisa kwato kanye nekubika kwato.
tgt: Iza kuphucula ukufikelela kwamajelo eendaba kuMongameli ne-Ofisi kaMongameli, khona ukuze iqinisekise ukuba iintatheli nazo zifumana ulwazi neenkqubo ezizeleyo ukuze kuphucuke indlela ababhala kunye nabazikhupha ngayo iindaba.

src: Emalunga elicembu labetindzaba lasisekelo nawo futsi atawutjelwa ngalamafisha Lisekelamengameli kanye nangunome ngabe nguyiphi Indvuna lemenywa nguMengameli kutsi yabelane ngetinhlelo telive letibalulekile.
tgt: Amalungu eliqelaloonondaba aza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiitlanganiso noSekela-Mongameli okanye nawuphi na uMphathiswa omenyiweyo nguMongameli ukuba babelane ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwisizwe.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise kudvumisa kwayo ngeligalelo leNingizimu Afrika lebenalo ekwenteni kutsi kube nekuthula eBurundi, lokuyintfo lehambisana nenchubomgomo yetfu yemave angephandle yekutinikela kutsi sicinisekise kutsi kunekuthula nekutinta kulelivekati.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilincomile igalelo elenziwe nguMzantsi Afrika ekubuyiseleni uxolo eBurundi, ngokuhambelana nesibophelelo somgaqo-nkqubo wethu wezangaphandle ukuqinisekisa uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi.

src: Iphindze futsi Ikhabhinethi yayemukela imiphumela ye-inclusive Inter-Burundian Dialogue lebeyibanjiwe ngesikhatsi kuvakashe litsimba leliphakeme Letinhloko Tembuso kanye naHulumende teLubumbano Lwe-Afrika (i-AU) eBujumbura eBurundi, lebeliholwa nguMengameli Zuma.
tgt: Kwakhona izamkele iziphumo zoThethathethwano oluquka bonke abemi baseBurundi obelubanjwe ngethuba igqiza eliphezulu leeNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente leMbumba yase-Afrika (i-AU), ebelikhokelwa nguMongameli uZuma, belityelele eBujumbura eBurundi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kukhetfwa kwaMengameli Zuma nguMabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangene (i-UN) Ban Ki-moon, kutsi abe ngusihlalo ngekuhlanganyela weKhomishini Lephakeme Yetekucasha Kutemphilo kanye Nekukhula Kutemnotfo naMengameli François Hollande waseRiphabhulikhi yaseFrance.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kukaMongameli uZuma nguNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) uBan Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngusihlalo wesibini kwiKhomishini ePhezulu yeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlumo lwezoQoqosho ebambisene noMongameli u-François Hollande weRhiphabliki yaseFrance.

src: Loku akusiko kwekucala kutsi Mengameli Zuma akhetfwe ngumtimba wemhlaba kutsi ente umsebenti wemhlaba wonkhe.
tgt: Asikuko okokuqala ukuba uMongameli uZuma achongwe ngumbutho wehlabathi ukuba enze umsebenzi kwimibutho yehlabathi.

src: Lokukhetfwa kwakhe kuyindlela yekutsatsela etulu umsebenti webuhloli lobuhle lobentiwa nguMengameli wetfu esigabeni semave ngemave.
tgt: Le khomishini iza kuvuselela ukudalwa kwamathuba amatsha emisebenzi kwicandelo lezempilo kuwo onke amazwe jikelele, ingakumbi kulawo aphuhliswe kancinci.

src: LeKhomishini itawukhutsata kudaleka kwematfuba emsebenti lamasha emkhakheni wetemphilo kuwo onkhe emave, ikakhulu emaveni lasengakatfutfuki kuyaphi.
tgt: Oku komeleza nokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo yowama-2030, eza kunceda kakhulu ukuhlangabezana nemingeni entlantlu-ntathu yentswela-ngqesho, indlala nokungalingani.

src: Loku futsi kuphindze kucinise kucala kwekusebenta kwe-Ajenda Ya-2030 Yentfutfuko Lesimeme, letawudlala indzima lenkhulu ekulungiseni lensayeya lemihiba lemtsatfu yekusweleka kwemsebenti, buphuya nekungalingani.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa koPhando lweSizwe loLuntu lowama-2016 eMamelodi ePitoli nguMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli uJeff Radebe noSonkcukhacha-manani Jikelele uPali Lehohla.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kwetfulwa kweLuklayo Lwavelonkhe Lwemmango Lwa-2016 eMamelodi lapha ePitoli lolwentiwe yiNdvuna yaseHhovisi Lamengameli Jeff Radebe kanye naSolubalo Jikelele Pali Lehohla.
tgt: Uhlolo lwalo nyaka lwenziwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika endiwaziyo, ikhaya endiliqondayo” kwaye lujongiswe kwimizi engaphezu kwe-1,5 sezigidi – lilolona lukhulu ukuza kutsho ngoku xa luthelekiswa nolo lwalwenziwe kwiminyaka emihlanu edlulileyo elafikelela nje kwimizi engaphezulu kwama-300 000.

src: Luklayo lwalonyaka lwentiwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “INingizimu Afrika Lengiyatiko, Likhaya Lengilivisisako” futsi kuhloswe ngalo kufinyelela emakhaya langetulu kwetigidzi leti-1.5 – lolukhulu kakhulu nalucatsaniswa nalolo lolwentiwa eminyakeni lesihlanu leyengca lapho kwatsatfwa khona kuphela emakhaya la-300 000.
tgt: Olu hlolo luza kwenziwe kwinyaga kaTshazimpuzi zize iziphumo zifumaneke ekupheleni kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Loluklayo lutakwentiwa ngenyanga yaMabasa kantsi imiphumela yalo itakwatisa ekupheleni kwenyanga yeNhlaba 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ngenkxalabo ingxelo enikzelwe nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi kunye noMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho kuPhando lweCandelo llezeMpilo olukhokelwa yiJaji uSandile Ngcobo.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngembiko lowetfulwe yiNhlangano Yemhlaba Yetemphilo kanye neNhlangano Yetemnotfo Nekubambisana Nentfutfuko kuLuphenyo Lwemakethe Yetemphilo lobeluholwa nguJaji Sandile Ngcobo.
tgt: Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ubonelela ngezona nkonzo zezonyango zibiza kakhulu xa uthelekiswa namanye amazwe.

src: Ikhabhinethi itawulindza kuphotfulwa kwaloluphenyo ngembikwekutsi iphefumule ngaloludzaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iza kulinda kuqukunjelwe olu phando phambi kokuba iphefumle ngalo mba.

src: Tincumo letimcoka teKhabhinethi IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kushicilelwa kweNdlelalisu Yesikhashana Yekulungisa Kungcoliseka Kwemoya eMimangweni Leminyene Lenemalingena Lencane yaseNingizimu Afrika kute ummango uphawule.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwakweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa iNgxaki yoNgcoliseko loMoya kwiiNdawo eziXineneyo Ezihlala Abantu abaMkela iMivuzo ePhantsi eMzantsi Afrika ukwenzela uluntu ukuba luhlomle.

src: Lendlelalisu ihlose kunika indlela yekwenta tintfo legcilile kute kubukanwe nemazinga lasetulu ekungcoliseka kuletinye taletindzawo letiminyene temimango lenemalingena lencane.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxile ekuboneleleni ngendlela egxile ekuzinikeleni ukusebenza ngezinga eliphezulu longcoliseko kolunye loluntu oluhlala kwiindawo ezixineneyo nolwamkela imivuzo ephantsi.

src: Lendlelalisu inika indlela yekwenta tintfo lechumene yekucala kusebenta kwalemitamo yekunciphisa kusha kwemafutsa asemakhaya.
tgt: Sibonelela ngendlela elungeleleneyo ekuphumezeni amalinge okunciphisa ukuvutha kwezibaso emakhayeni.

src: Lesingenelelo sekucinisekisa kutsi letindzawo tenta tintfo ngekuhambisana ne-National Ambient Air Quaity Standards.
tgt: Olu ngenelelo lelokuqinisekisa ukuba le mimandla iyathobelana neMimiselo yoMgangatho weziRhangqo yeSizwe.

src: Lendlelalisu legcilile itawusekela indlelalisu yavelonkhe levele ikhona yekubukana nekungcoliseka kwemoya kulelive.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxilileyo siza kuxhasa isicwangciso-qhinga sesizwe esikhoyo ukuhlangabezana nongcoliseko lomoya kweli lizwe.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kubanjwa ngekuhlanganyela kweNgcungcutsela Yengculazi Ye-21 Yemave Ngemave (i-AIDS 2016) emkhatsini wahulumende kanye neNhlangano Yemave Ngemave Ye-AIDS lapha e-International Convention Centre (e-ICC) eDurban kusukela mhla ti-18 kuya mhla tinge-22 Kholwane 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba urhulumente abe lelinye lamahlakani aza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yeZizwe-ngezizwe kaGawulayo yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) ndawonye noNombutho eHlabathi kaGawulayo kwiZiko leNgqungquthela yeZizwe ngezizwe (i-ICC) eDurban ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeKhala yowama-2016.

src: Kubanjelwa kwalengcungcutsela kulelive kutakwenta kutsi kulwa kwalelive ne-HIV kanye nesifo sesifuba kube setulu kuphindze kube nelifutse kuyinye yetinsayeya letibaluleke kakhulu lapha eNingizimu Afrika, kulesifundza kanye nasemhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kuza kuqhubela phambili indlela ilizwe lethu elihlangabezana ngayo neeNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nesifo sephepha (i-TB) ngeli xesha kwangaxesha nye lisenza impembelelo komnye weyona mingeni iyeyona ibalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika, kummandla welizwekazi nakwihlabathi.

src: Lengcungcutsela itawenta kutsi kube nenkhundla yebacwaningi labavela emhlabeni wonkhe kutsi bashiyelane ngelwati lolusha kulendzima, kufundziswane ngebungcweti balomunye kanye nekutfutfukisa tindlelalisu tekwenta ncono yonkhe imikhakha yemitamo yetfu lehlanganisiwe yekwelapha nekuvikela i-HIUmtsetfosivivinyo IKhabhinethi ikuvumile kungeniswa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo wa-2015 Wekuchibiyela Tekutfutsa Tavelonkhe Tendlela Yaseveni, lochibiyela Umtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekutfutsa Wendlela Yaseveni, wa-2009 (Umtsetfo we-5 wa-2009).
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iza kubonelela abaphandi abavela kwiinkalo zonke zehlabathi ngeqonga lokwabelana ngeenkqubo zobunzululwazi zala maxesha kweli candelo, ukufunda kubuchule bomnye nomnye nokuphuhlisa ubuchule bokuqhubela phambili onke amacala kumalinge wethu ahlangeneyo okunyanga nokuthintela i-HIUmthetho oYilwayo.

src: Letichibiyelo taloMtsetfo Wavelonkhe Wetekutfutsa Wendlela Yaseveni wa-2009 utawuchubela embili lenchubo yekuntjintja nekwakha kabusha luhlelo lwavelonkhe lwetekutfutsa lwendlela yaseveni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho-siHlomelo wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe wama-2015 ePalamente, ohlomela uMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe, wama-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wama-2009).

src: Loku kutawuba neligalelo lelihle lelitawuholela ekutseni kube nensita yekutfutsa ummango lephephile, lenekufinyeleleka, lengabiti kanye nalephumelelako.
tgt: Ezi zilungisoo zoMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni wama-2009 ziza kuqhubela phambili inkqubo yokuguqula nokumisela ngokutsha inkqubo yezothutho zasemhlabeni yesizwe.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uyinkhombandlela, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo, tekutfutsa letingasito timoto tinsita tekutfutsa te-ehailing kanye nekutihlanganisa netekutfutsa temmango.
tgt: Oku kuza kwenza igalelo kwinkonzo yezothutho kawonkewonke ekhuselekileyo, efikelelekayo, enobuchule nesebenzayo.

src: Uphindze futsi unike kutsi kube nekuphatfwa lokukhanyako mayelana nemandla lanikiwe kanye nemitsetfo macondzana nekukhishwa kwetimvume tekusebenta kwetitfutsi temmango.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubonelela ngophuhliso olutsha kwicandelo lezothutho kawonkewonke.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo utawuphindza futsi usite ekucaleni kwekusebenta kwe-Integrated Public Transport Networks kantsi futsi uyincenye yeLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwesakhiwonchanti kanye Nemklamo we-7 Wendlelalisu Lehlanganisiwe, lolugcile ekusebentiseni intfutfuko lechumanisiwe yasedolobheni kanye nenethiwekhi lehlanganisiwe kute kwentiwe kutsi emadolobhakati abe tinjini tekukhula.
tgt: Ubonelela ngesikhokelo ekukho phakathi kwaso, izithuthi ezingezo moto iinkonzo zezothutho ezibizwa ngezixhobo zobuchwephetshe nokuphawulwa kwezithuthi zikawonkewonke ngokutsha ngokusebenza ngendlela ephucukileyo.

src: Lokuvakasha ngekweLuhlelo Lwembuso kutawucinisa budlelwane lobukhona emkhatsini walamave lamabili kuphindze futsi kwente ncono kuhwebelana emkhatsini walesifundza.
tgt: Ukwabonelela ngokucacisa ngengcaciso kwinkqubo yokudluliselwa kwamagunya nemimiselo ngokumayela nokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zokuqhuba izithuthi zikawonkewonke.

src: Inyanga Yemalungelo eLuntfu ngeNdlovulenkhulu 2016 itawugujwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “INingizimu Afrika ibumbene ekulweni nebuhlanga.” Litiko Letebuciko Nemasiko lidvwebe luhlelo lwenyanga yonkhe lolufaka ekhatsi luchungechunge lwetinkhulumiswano letimayelana nekusebenta ngekubambisana ekwakheni ummango wentsandvo yelinyenti longabandlululani ngebuhlanga, longabandlululani ngebulili kanye nalolinganako.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kubonelela ngokuqaliswa koThungelwano lwezoThutho lukaWonkewonke oluDibeneyo kwaye luyinxalenye yeProjekthi ye-7 yesiCwangciso seziSeko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe, sigxile ekusebenziseni uphuhliso olulungeleleyo ezidolophini nothungelwano lwezothutho oludibeneyo ukumisela izixeko njengonobangela wohlumo.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi baphawule ngaLoluhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwekwenta lwekulwa neBuhlanga, Kubandlulula ngekweBuhlanga, Kutondza Bekuchamuka kanye Nekungabeketelelani Lokuhambisana naloko (lwa-2016-2021) ngembikwa mhla tinge-30 Inhlaba 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Loluhlelo lunika kutsi kube nenchubomgomo yemmango yekulwa nekubandlululwa ngekwebuhlanga letawusita ekunikeni lifutse etibophelweni tetfu temave ngemave temalungelo eluntfu.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni luza kuqinisa ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwalamazwe mabini nokuqhubela phambili urhwebo oluphakathi kwemimandla yala mazwe.

src: I-Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue letawuba se-ICC eDurban kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-9 Indlovulenkhulu 2016 inika kutsi kube nenkhundla yekwenta ncono Luhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lolukhulu Lwetidzakamiva (2013-2017).
tgt: INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ukulwa nobuhlanga.” ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko limisele inkqubo ebude buyinyanga equka iintlanganiso ezimalunga nokusebenzisana ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esingenabuhlanga, esingacaluli ngokwesini, esilinganayo nesilawulwa ngentando yesininzi.

src: Kulwa netidzakamiva letingekho emtsetfweni kuhambisana neLuhlelo Lwavelonkhe Lwentfutfuko kantsi lenkhulumiswano ingaphasi kweliso laMhlabuhlangene ngekulandzela tibophelelo teTingcungcutsela taMhlabuhlangene Tetidzakamiva kanye Nebugebengu Lobuhlelekile Bemave Ngemave, Luhlelo Lwamhlabuhlangene Lwekwenta lolumacondzana Nekulawula Tidzakamiva (2013-2017) kanye netincumo te-BRICS (iBrazil, iRussia, iIndia, iChina neNingizimu Afrika).
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlomle kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza seSizwe sokulwa ubuHlanga, uCalucalulo ngokobuHlanga, iNtiyo yabaSuka kuMazwe angaPhandle kunye neminye imiKhuba yokungaNyamezelani (sowama-2016-2021) phambi komhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.

src: Lengcungcutsela inguMhlangano wekulandzelela we-Russia-Africa Anti-Drug Dialogue, lehlose kwetfula livi linye lelibumbene kutsi baholi bemhlaba bahlose kulwa njani nalenkinga yetidzakamiva yemave ngemave.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso sibonelela ngesiseko somgaqo-nkqubo kawonkewonke wokulwa nocalucalulo ngokobuhlanga okuza kunceda ukunika impembelelo kwisibophelelo sethu samalungelo oluntu ezizwe-ngezizwe.

src: Hulumende – ngekuhlanganyela naMabhalane Wemave e-Commonwealth, Inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-UNISA) kanye ne-Sikhungo Savelonkhe Sekutfutfukiswa Kwelusha – batawube babambe Ingcungcutsela Yesibili Yemave e-Commonwealth lemayelana neMsebenti Welusha letawube ibanjelwe lapha ekhempasini yase-UNISA ePitoli kusukela mhla ti-8 kuya mhla ti-10 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.
tgt: INgqungquthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa neziYobisi kwi-ICC yaseDurban ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 lubonelela ngeqonga lokuqinisa isiCwangciso esiyiNtloko seziYobisi seSizwe (sowama-2013-2017).Umlo wokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uyahambelana neSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwaye le ngqungquthela iphantsi kwemiqondiso emihle ye-AU ukusebenzela isibophelelo ngokwemimiselo efanelekileyo ye-UN yeziVumelwano zoLwaphulo-mthetho oluHleliweyo Phakathi kwaMazwe amaBini neziYobisi, isiCwangciso soMsebenzi se-AU (2013-2017 nezindululo zamazwe e-BRICS (i-Brazil, Russia, India, China noMzantsi Afrika).

src: Lengcungcutsela itawube yenteka ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kumbandzakanya Bantfu Labasha eKwakheni Sive: Indzima Yelusha Yekusebenta” futsi itawuhlola kabusha indzima ledlalwa lusha lolusebentako kanye netifundziswa ekumbandzakanyeni bantfu labasha ekutfutfukiseni emave abo.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ilandela iNgqungqthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa iziYobisi, eligxile ekubonakaliseni imo edibeneyo yokuba iinkokheli zehlabathi zizimisele kangakanani ukuqubisana neengxaki yeziyobisi phakathi kwezizwe ngezizwe.

src: Lokushiwo yiKhabhinethi mayelana netindzaba letimcoka eveni IKhabhinethi iyawuphindza umlayeto waMengameli Zuma wesidzingo sekuhlonipha tikhungo netinchubo letisungulwe ngekulandzela Umtsetfosisekelo waseRiphabhlikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika wa-1996 kanye nemtsetfo.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siza kuthiwe thaca kwiNdibano eNkulu eKhethekileyo ye-UN kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2016.

src: Mengameli Zuma ulungisa loludzaba lweKhomishana ye-SARS kanye neNdvuna Yetetimali ngekusebentisa tindlela letingito nekulandzela tindlela letisemtsetfweni.
tgt: Urhulumente – ngokusebenzisana ne-ofisi kaNobhala wamaZwe aye ngamaThanga, iDyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-UNISA) ne-Arhente yoPhuhliso loLutsha yeSizwe – uza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yesibini2 yamaZwe ayesakuba ngamaThanga ngoMsebenzi woLutsha kwikhampasi yase-UNISA ePitoli ukususela ngomhla- we-8 ukuya kowe-10 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: Mengameli uhlelembisa tinyatselo tekulungisa letinkinga ngekutibophelela nangendlela lekahle kute kuzuze wonkhe umuntfu.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela iqhubeka phantsi komxholo othi: “Bandakanya uLutsha eKwakheni iSizwe: iNdima yabaSebenzi abaluLutsha” nokuphinda kuhlolwe indima yamagcisa alulutsha olusebenzayo nabahlohli bamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ekubandakanyeni ulutsha kuphuhliso lwamazwe walo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela onkhe emacembu lanenshisekelo kuloludzaba kutsi asebentise kutitsiba nekutibamba, kanye futsi nekutsi avumele litfuba lekutsi letinkinga tisonjululwe ngekusebentisa tindlela letingito.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izeka mzekweni kumyalezo kaMongameli uZuma ngokudingeka kokuhlonitshwa kwamaziko neenkqubo ezidalwe ngokwemimiselo yomgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika yowe-1996 nomthetho.

src: IKhabhinethi icela kutsi bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika babhalisele Lukhetfo Lwahulumende Wendzawo lwa-2016 mhla ti-5 kanye namhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uyasebenza ngemeko yoMkhomishinala weZiko loMzantsi Afrika leeNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika noMphathiswa wezeMali ngokulandela iindlela ezifanelekileyo esebenzisa izikhokelo ezifanelekileyo zezomthetho.

src: Akufani njenganakunelukhetfo lwavelonkhe, lukhetfo lwahulumende wendzawo ludzinga kutsi ubhalise kulelo wadi lohlala kulo.
tgt: UMongameli umisele iinkqubo zokuhlangabezana nalo mba ngokufanelekileyo nangoxolo ukwenzela uncedo lwethu sonke.

src: Kubalulekile kutsi ube namatisi (i-ID) – matisi wakho loluhlata lonebhakodi kanye neLikhadimatisi kokubili kutakwemukelwa – kanye futsi nekuhlola simo sakho sekubhalisa, inombolo yeliwadi kanye nesiteshi sekuvota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza onke amaqela achaphazelekayo ukuba azole azibambe, aze anikeze ithuba lokuba lo mba usonjululwe ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo.

src: Onkhe emahhovisi eLitiko Letasekhaya atawube avuliwe kusukela ngensimbi ye-08:00 kuya ensimbini ye-17:00 mhla ti-5 kanye namhla ti-6 Indlovulenkhulu 2016, loku kuyahambisana nema-awa ekusebenta eKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele kulamalanga lamabili.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhalisele uNyulo looRhulumente baseKhaya lowama-2016 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonkhe labasha nalabavota kwekucala kutsi babhalise kute batewuvota.
tgt: Unyulo loorhumente basekhaya, alufani nolwesizwe kuba koloorhulumente basekhaya kufanele ubhalise kwiwadi ohlala kuyo.

src: Ngekuvota kwakho kusho kutsi utsatse sinyatselo sekutsi uvakalise livi lakho etincumeni letikutsintsako naletitsintsa ummango wakho.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba ube neNcwadi yeSazisi (i-ID) – ziza kwamkeleka zombini i-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi kunye neKhadi-Sazisi – nokukhangela isimo sokuba ubhalisile na, iinombolo yewadi kunye nokuba simi phi isikhululo sakho sokuvota.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayisola kakhulu imishuco yebafundzi leneludlame ekhatsi, letsikamete kufundza kulamanye emanyuvesi lokuholele ekucekeleni phasi kwemphahla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza lonke ulutsha kunye nabo baza kuqala ukuvota ukuba babhalisele ukuvota.

src: Lemishuco incisha bafundzi labafanele litfuba lekuchuba tifundvo tabo kanye nekukhinyabeta lilungelo labo lemfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Ngokuvota kwakho uthathe inyathelo elibhekisele ekubeni ilizwi lakho livakale ekuthathweni kwezigqibo ezikuchaphazelayo nendawo ohlala kuyo.

src: Hulumende uvule tindlela tekuchumana nabo bonkhe labatsintsekako emfundvweni lephakeme kutsi kucocisanwe futsi kube netinkhulumiswano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela lwabafundi, noluthe lwaphazamisa izifundo kwezinye iidyunivesithi laze lakhokelela ekutshatyalalisweni kwezakhiwo nempahla.

src: Loku kuholele ekutseni simo sibuyele kulesingiso kanye nekugcugcutela kutsi kube nekubumbana kutenhlalo emanyuvesi etfu ngenhloso yekutfola tisombululo tesikhatsi lesisemkhatsini kuya esikhatsini lesidze taletinsayeya letilumbene nekuntjintjwa kwalomkhakha njengaloku kuchaziwe kutincumo teNgcungcutsela ya-2015 Yekuntjintja Imfundvo Lephakeme.
tgt: Aba baqhankqalazi bathintela abafundi abanelungelo ilungelo lokuqhuba ngezifundo zabo kwaye oko kunempembelelo engekho ntle kwilungelo labo lokufumana imfundo ephakamileyo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayesekela imitamo yema-ejensi ekugcinwa kwemtsetfo kucinisekisa kutsi lisiko letekufundza libuyela esimeni salo, nekutsi imphahla iyavikeleka kanye nemalungelo alowo nalowo ayavikeleka.
tgt: Urhulumente uvulele bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwezemfundo ephakamileyo iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ukwenzela iingxoxo nothethathethwano.

src: Kusebenta kwemtsetfo kungetulu kwako konkhe futsi kufanele kutsi kugcinwe ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi.
tgt: Oko kukhokelele ekubuyeleni kwisiqhelo nokukhuthazwa kwentalo-ntle kwiidyunivesithi zethu ezifuna ukufumana isisombululo kwimingeni yexesha eliphakathi ukuya kweyelide edibene nokudalwa kwenguqu kwelicandelo njengoko ichazwe kwizindululo zeMbizo yeNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo yowama-2015.

src: Kuthula nekuzotsa kufanele kutsi kubuyiselwe emanyuvesi etfu kute kutsi tinhlelo tekufundza tichubeke ngesikhatsi kusalungiswa letinsayeya tesikhatsi lesisemkhatsini netesikhatsi lesidze.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amalinge awenziwe zi-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba isithethe sokufunda sibuyiselwe, kunye nokukhuselwa kwempahla nesakhiwo namalungelo womntu ngamnye.
