tgt: IKhabhinethi imnqwenelela okuhle kodwa kumhlala-phantsi wakhe.

src: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngeMbiko weKhomishini Yekuphenya Ngetinsolo Tekukhwabanisa, Tenkhohlakalo, Kwehluleka Kugcina Emazinga Ekusebenta Ngekwetsembeka nobe Kungasebenti ngalokufanele Ekutsengweni Kwetikhali Tekuvikela (Ikhomishini Yekutsengwa Kwetikhali) lekhishwe nguMengameli lamuhla ekuseni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe malunga neNgxelo yeKhomishini yoPhando malunga neziTyholo zobuQhetseba, uRhwaphilizo, iMposiso okanye iziPhene kwiSivumelwano seNtengo yeziXhobo zoMkhosi zobuChule (iKhomishini yeNtengo yeziXhobo) ethe yakhutshwa nguMongameli kusasa nje.

src: LoMbiko utfole kutsi kute bufakazi bekusebenta ngalokungakafaneli, kudiza, kukhwabanisa nobe inkhohlakalo enchubeni yekutsengwa kwetikhali, SinguHulumende siyayemukela imiphumela yeluphenyo lweKhomishini.
tgt: Le Ngxelo ayifumanisanga bungqina bubonakalisa bugwenxa, kunyoba, buqhetseba okanye rhwaphilizo kwinkqubo yokuthengwa kwezixhobo.

src: Sitfolakele simsulwa njengobe besihlale sisho kuyo yonkhe leminyaka kutsi simsulwa kanye nekutsi letikhali tatsengwa ngalokusemtsetfweni.
tgt: NjengoRhulumente siyazamkela iziphumo zeKhomishini.

src: Setsemba kutsi lemiphumela italuvala loludzaba leseluchubeke sikhatsi lesidze.
tgt: Liye lahlanjwa igama lethu njengokuba besisoloko sisitsho kwiminyaka emininzi edlulileyo ukuba akukho bugwenxa kwaye le nkqubo yokuthengwa ibimsulwa ingenamakhwiniba.

src: Kubekwa EtikhundleniKutawuhlolwa ticu tabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni kubuye futsi kwentiwe nekucinisekiswa lokufanele.
tgt: Siyathemba ukuba ezi ziphumo ziza kuwuvala lo mba ubukade urhuqwa ixesha elide.

src: Siyabonga Gama Sikhulu Lesikhulu seLicembu kanye neMnu Garry Pita njengeSikhulu Lesikhulu Setetimali sakaTransnet.
tgt: Nathi njengoMongameli uZuma sibulela uJaji Willie Seriti noJaji Thekiso Musi, onke amangqina, kuquka nowayesakuba nguMongameli uThabo Mbeki, abetshutshisi ababegoca-goca amangqina ngemibuzo, amagqwetha, abasebenzi nabo bathe benza igalelo ekwenzeni ukuba umsebenzi wale Khomishini ube yimpumelelo.

src: Kufezekiswa Kwetinhlelo Tahulumende Letibalulekile.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuvakasha kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma Kwembuso kwekuya e-Islamic Republic of Iran, lokukhulisa ngemandla budlelwane betemnotfo nekuhwebelana emkhatsini walamave omabili, ngekusayina tivumelwane letinyenti kanye nekutinikela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran, nolwandisa ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho norhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe omabini, ngokutyikitywa kwezivumelwano nezibhambathiso eziliqela.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma naMengameli Hasan Rouhani bacinise kubambisana emikhakheni yetekuhwebelana, temfundvo nekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono isayensi netebucwepheshe, emandla agezi, kufaka ekhatsi kuhlolisiswa kwegesi yemakhemikhala aphethroli nemakhono ekuwuhluta tekulima kumbiwa kwetimbiwa kanye nekuzuza kwakhiwa kwesakhiwonchanti netitfutsi timali, kubhanga nemshwalensi kanye netekuvakasha.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMongameli uHasan Rouhani bayiqinisile intsebenziswano kumacandelo ezorhwebo, ezemfundo nophuhliso lwezakhono inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe ezamandla kuquka nokuhlolwa kwe-oli kunye namandla okucolwa kwayo ezolimo imigodi nezokuxhamlisa kwezemigodi uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nezothutho ezezimali, ezebhanki neze-inshorensi nokhenketho.

src: Konkhe loku kufaka sandla ekufezekisweni kweLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP).Mayelana netemave emhlaba, labaholi lababili bavumelene kutsi kuciniswe simemo sekulungisa Mhlabuhlangene (i-UN) ikakhulu Umkhandlu Wekuvikela we-UN, ngekuya kwetimfuno temave lasatfutfuka.
tgt: Xa zizonke zenza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).Kwimiba yezehlabathi, ezi nkokheli zimbini zivumelene ukuba makuqiniswe isimemo sokuhlaziywa nokuziza iinguqu kuMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ingakumbi iBhunga loKhuselo le-UN, ukuze lincede nezizwe ezinoqoqosho elisakhulayo.

src: Lemiphumela icinise Kuvakasha Ngekwemsebenti kwaMengameli e-United Arab Emirates (e-UAE) lapho khona omabili lamave avusetele kutinikela kwawo ekuhlanganiseni nasekuphakamiseni budlelwanobubili emkhatsini walamave omabili, ikakhulu kutekuhwebelana, imikhakha yelutjalomali neyemnotfo kutsi ibe yelubanjiswano lolubalulekile lolukhulu.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zomeleza uTyelelo lukaMongameli oluyiNxalenye yomsebenzi kwi-United Arab Emirates (i-AEU) apho omabini la mazwe ahlaziye khona isivumelwano sawo ekudibaniseni nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwane benkululeko, ingakumbi kwezorhwebo, kwimiba yotyalo-mali neyezoqoqosho kubudlelwane bobuchule obudibeneyo.

src: Loku kwakhele etukweKuvakasha Kwembuso kwaMengameli Jacob Zuma ngeLweti nga-2011 lokwaholela ekusungulweni kweKhomishini Lehlangene Ye-SA-UAE lokwasheshisa ngalokuphelele umdlandla nemandla ekuhwebelana emkhatsini walamave omabili kusuka kutigidzigidzi leti-R13 nga-2011 kuya kutigidzigidzi letinge-R27 nga-2015.INingizimu Afrika kanye ne-UAE baphindze bavuma kukhulisa kubambisana kwabo kute basebentise ematfuba lakuMnotfo waseLwandle, kute kukhutsatwe kutsengiswa kulamanye emave imikhicito letilimo yaseNingizimu Afrika, imikhicito leyakhiwe ikakhulu tintfo tetekuvikela nelubanjiswano.
tgt: Oku kwakhela phezu koTyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni lwenyanga yeNkanga yowama-2011 nolwakhokelela ekusekweni kweKhomishini eDibeneyo yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Unite Arab Emirates olwathi lwakhawulezisa isantya esipheleleyo sorhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini ukususela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-13 ngowama-2011 ukuya kwiibhiliyoni zeerandin ezingama-27 ngowama-2015.UMzantsi Afrika ne-United Arab Emirates ukwavumelene ngokwandisa intsebenziswano yokusebenzisa ithuba elivela kuQoqosho laseLwandle, ukuthumela kumazwe angaphandle, iimveliso zezolimo zaseMzantsi Afrika, iimveliso ezenziweyo kwaye ngokukodwa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zokhuselo nobudlelwane.

src: Lokuvakasha kuphindze kwakhutsata emandla ekwakha sakhiwonchanti saseNingizimu Afrika sacondza ematfuba etinkampani taseNingizimu Afrika ekukhangiseni kwaseDubai lokubitwe ngekutsi pheceleti, EXPO 2020 in Dubai, kanye nekubambisana emkhakheni wetekuthula, tekuvikela kanye nekusimama.
tgt: Olu tyelelo lukwakhuthaza ukuxhotyiswa kolwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo olugxile ekunikeni iinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika amathuba kwi-EXPO 2020 eDubai, kwakunye nentsebenziswano kwicandelo lezoxolo, ukhuseleko nozinzo.

src: IKhabhinethi itemukele tinyatselo leticatsa letihlelwe yiNdvuna yeTemidlalo Nekukhibika Fikile Mbalula tekwakha kabusha temidlalo nekukhibika letibhidlikile naletibandlula ngemandla ngekusebentisa Ishatha Yetingucuko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo angqongqo athe amiselwa nguMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uFikile Mbalula ngokusebenzisa uXwebhu lweNguqu ukwakha ngokutsha imbonakalo yezemidlalo nolonwabo eqhekekileyo nenocalucalulo olunzulu.

src: Loku kutawusheshisa tingucuko tekutsi kube khona inchubo yetemidlalo lebumbene lesime etukwemitsetfomgomo yentsandvo yelinyenti, kulingana, kubekwa kwetintfo ebaleni, kumelelwa kwabo bonkhe bantfu, kufinyelela nekukhula kwemazinga ekuhlanganyela ngekuhambisana netimfuno teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.
tgt: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa inguqu ebhekisele kwinkqubo yezemidlalo emanyeneyo exhaswa yimigomo yolawulo lwentando yesininzi, umakulingwane, ukwenza elubala, ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke ubani uthatha inxaxheba, ukufikelela nokwanda kokuthathwa kwenxaxheba ngokweenjongo ze-NDIKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngamasebe ngamasebe nengxelo ezingena nzulu ekucaciseni inkqubela eseyenziwe ukuphucula ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela mcombelelo lowetfulwe ngematiko lehlukene lonemibiko lemikhulu lechaza inchubekela embili leyentiwe ekwenteni timphilo tebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi tibe ncono.
tgt: Oku kubonakalisa ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiPhakathi nesisisondeza ekufezekisweni koMbono wama-2030 wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Loku kukhombisa kufezekiswa kweLuhlakamsebenti Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini lolusisondzeta dvutane nekuzuza Umbononchanti 2030 weLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bamamele futhi bazibukele ezi ngxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuwo onke amajelo eendaba ukuze bayiqonde ngcono iNkqubo yokuSebenza kaRhulumente.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi balandzele inkulumomphikiswano yomcombelelo etinkhundleni tekuchumana tebetindzaba letinyenti letehlukene kute bavisise kancono Luhlelo lwaHulumende lweKusebenta IKhabhinethi icela kutsi kube nekutinikela lokuchubekako kute kutsi kube netingucuko letingito tetindzawo tekusebenta letihambisana naloko lokutfolwe Ngumbiko Wemnyaka We-16 Wekhomishini Yetekucashwa Ngekulingana yabo bonkhe bacashi lababekiwe lowetfulwa ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi “Tingucuko tibalulekile”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi icela ukuzibophelela okuqhubekayo ukwenza inguqu enentsingiselo emisebenzini ngenxa yeziphumo ezivela kwiNgxelo yoNyaka yeKhomishini ye-16 kaMakulingwane eMisebenzini kubo bonke abaqeshi abachongiweyo neyathi yamiselwa phantsi komxholo othi “Iinguqu zibalulekile”.

src: Lombiko usita hulumende kutsi avisise simo setekucashwa ngekulingana kulelive kanye nenchubekela embili yakho ekuguculeni simo sasemsebentini ngemnyaka-2015.
tgt: Le Ngxelo iyamnceda urhulumente ukuba abuqonde ubume bomakulingwane emisebenzini kweli lizwe nenkqubela yakhe ekwenziweni kwenguqu emisebenzini kunyaka wama-2015.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu ekwakhiweni kwetindlu letitigidzi leti-4, 3 kanye nematfuba ekuba netindlu kusukela kwaba khona intsandvo yelinyenti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu ngokunikezela ngezigidi eziyi-4,3 zezindlu namathuba ezezindlu ukususela mhla kwafika ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.

src: Lamatfuba afaka ekhatsi-2, 806 235 wetindlu letelekelelwa ngalokuphelele (tindlu te-BNG), 121 784 wetindlu tetenhlalo/tekurentwa, 6329 weteLuhlelo Lwekwelekelelwa Kwangamunye Loluchumene Netimali kanye nemasayithi latfola tinsita la-986 608.Leligcatsi lelingumlandvo selwente kutsi kube neluphahla lwebantfu labangetelulu kwalabatigidzi letinge-20 futsi-ke kugubha umkhosi walokuzuza lelitiko seletfule umkhankhaso wavelonkhe wekukhombisa timphumelelo talelive.
tgt: La mathuba aquka izindlu zenkxaso epheleleyo ezingama-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zezentlalo/zokurenta ezingama-121 784, izindlu zeNkqubo yeNkxaso-mali yoMntu ngaMnye ezingama-121 784 kunye neziza ezifumana iinkonzo ezingundoqo ezingama-986 608.Le mpumelelo iyimbali ibonelele ngezindlu abantu abangaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kwaye ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo isebe limisele iphulo lesizwe lokubonakalisa le mpumelelo yesizwe.

src: Lokwetfulwa kwavelonkhe kwentiwe eCOSMO City, lomunye wemiklamo lehlanganisiwe lebekwa embili lekhona kulo lonkhe lelive nawo logubha umkhosi weminyaka lelishumi solo waba khona.
tgt: Oku kumiselwa kwesizwe kwenzeke e-COSMO City, neyenye yeeprojekthi eziphambili ezidibeneyo kwilizwe jikelele nekwabhiyozela iminyaka elishumi yabakho.

src: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonkhe bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika ngekufaka sandla kwabo, kutinikela kanye nekusebenta ngekutikhandla ekucinisekiseni kutsi siyabuyiswa sitfunti sebantfu baseNingizimu Afrika labadzingako, ngekuhlaliswa kwebantfu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngegalelo labo, lokuzinikela nokusebenza kwabo ngamandla ekuqinisekiseni ukuba isidima sabemi baseMzantsi Afrika abahlelelekileyo siyabuyiselwa ngezokuhlaliswa koluntu.

src: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma Mabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangane ngekubamba Umkhosi Losezingeni Lelisetulu Kakhulu Wekusayinwa kweSivumelwane saseParis, lesemukelwa ngemave la-176 ngeNgongoni 2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma uNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo ngokuqhuba uMsitho wokuTyikitya okwiNqanaba eliPhezulu wesiVumelwano saseParis, nesithe samkelwa ngaMazwe angamaLungu ali-176 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.

src: Kusayinwa kwaleSivumelwano saseParis kwenta sinyatselo sekucala sekuphumelelisa lesitawukhomba indlela imitamo yemave emahlaba yekunciphisa kubhunyiswa kwemimoya lengcolile lengcolisa umoya lesiwuphefumulako kanye nekuhlangabetana nato tonkhe tinsayeya letivetwa kugucuka kwesimo selitulu.
tgt: Ukutyikitywa kwesiVumelwano saseParis kuphawula inyathelo lokuqala ekuphunyezweni kwaso nokuzakukhokela amalinge ehlabathi ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa kweegesi ezingcolisa umoya nokukwazi ukulwa imingeni ehambelana nako ebangelwa kukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ilindzele kuphetfwa kwetinchubo tekucinisekiswa kwetekuhlala letifanele, ngubo bonkhe, kute ivumele sikhatsi lesifanele sekutsi leSivumelwane saseParis sifezekiswe ngalokuphelele nga-2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulinde ngomdla ukuqukunjelwa kweenkqubo zokugunyaziswa zalapha ekhaya, ngawo onke, ukuvumela ukungena kwangexesha ukwenzela ukufezekiswa ngokupheleleyo kwesiVumelwano saseParis ngowama-2020.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela futsi nekutsi Litiko Letemvelo libambisene neLitilo Letekuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni emalabhorekhthri ekwetfula labitwa ngekutsi ngemaLebhu Etitjalo netilwane Letehlukahlukene: Kukhuliswa kwemnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika ngemcebo wetitjalo netilwane” kusukela mhla ti-10 Mabasa kuya kumhla ti-13 Inkhwekhweti 2016.Inhloso kuzuza emandla emnotfo wetitjalo netilwane taseNingizimu Afrika letehlukahlukene lokubekwe ngalokucacile kuluhlaka Lwendlelalisu Yemnotfo Wetitjalo Netilwane Letehlukahlune Lwavelonkhe leyavunywa yiKhabhinethi ngaKholwane 2015 kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngalo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphela ukuba iSebe lezeNdalo lizibandakanye neSebe lezoKhenketho ekuqaliseni iilebhu zokubonelela ezinesihloko esithi “iLebhu yeNzululwazi ngeZilwanyana neziTyalo: Ikhulisa igalelo loqoqosho lwemithombo yobunzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo yaseMzantsi Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-10 kuTshazimpuzi ukuya kowe-13 kwekaCanzibe yowama-2016.Injongo kukuphumeza amandla oqoqosho lobutyebi bezenzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo zaseMzantsi Afrika achazwe kuyilo lwesiCwangciso-qhinga soQoqosho lweNzululwazi ngeziLwanyana neziTyalo seSizwe esiphunyezwe yiKhabhinethi kweyeKhala yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuthatha inxaxheba koluntu.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi letibalulekile.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi ezingundoqo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume Luhlelo Lwekusebenta Lwenchubomgomo Yetimboni (i-IPAP) lwanga-2016/17 – 2018/19, loluyinsika yeLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica lwaMengameli futsi lufaka sandla ekufezekisweni kweLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso soMgaqo-nkqubo wokuSebenza kwezoShishino (i-IPAP) sowama-2016/17 – 2018/19, nesiyintsika engundoqo yesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba sikaMongameli kwaye senza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.

src: Loku ngumnyaka wesiphohlongo kuphindzeka kuphumelela kwetinhlelo tahulumende tekutfutfukisa timbono lokwakhela ekuzuzeni, tinkhundla tenchubomgomo kanye netinhlelo tekuphindzeka lokwendlulile.
tgt: Oku kukuphindaphindwa kwaminyaka le kwesibhozo kwesicwangciso sikarhulumente semizi-mveliso esiyimpumelelo nesakhelwa kwiimpumelelo, amaqonga emigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zokuphindaphindwa kwangaphambili.

src: I-IPAP 2016/17 ifuna kuzuza inchubomgomo yetimboni lenemphumela losezingeni leliphakeme etimeni temnotfo letimatima.
tgt: I-IPAP yowama-2016/17 iinjongo zayo kukwenza impembelelo enkulu kumgaqo-nkqubo wezoshishino phantsi kweemeko ezinzima zezoqoqosho.

src: Loku kufaka ekhatsi imiphumela yekwehla kwemandla emali emhlabeni wonkhe lokuchubekako kanye nesomiso lesibi kabi naletinye tintfo tetenhlalo letisikhinyabeto.
tgt: Ekukho phakathi kwazo impembelelo eqhubekayo yokudodobala kwezoqoqosho kwihlabathi jikelele kuquka iimeko emaxongo kurhwebo lwezesinyithi kunye nezimbiwa kwakunye nembalela enkulu neminye imiqobo ebalulekileyo yalapha ekhaya.

src: Lokuzuziwe emnyakeni lophelile kufaka ekhatsi imisebenti levikelwe lelinganiselwa kule-67 000 kanye nekuvetwa kwemisebenti lemisha lenesitfunti lengalinganiselwa kule-7 000 emikhakheni yeTimphahla, yeMayadi Etikhumba kanye neyeTicatfulo.
tgt: Imisebenzi eyimpumelelo yonyaka ophelileyo iquka ukusindiswa kwemisebenzi emalunga nama-67 000 nokudalwa kwemisebenzi emitsha endilisekileyo ethelekelelwa kuma-7 000 kwicandelo leMpahla nelezeziKhumba neZihlangu.

src: Umkhakha lomncane wekwendlulisa imikhicito letilimo nguwona mkhakha locashe bantfu labanengi kwendlula yonkhe imikhakha yasekhaya lekhicitako, uniketa imisebenti lelinganiselwa kule-216 090 nga-2015 nakucatsaniswa kule-208 822 nga-2014.
tgt: Icandelwana elisebenza phantsi kokucolwa nokulungiswa kweemveliso zezolimo lelinye lamacandelo okuvelisa amakhulu apha ekhaya ngokwengqesho, abonelela ngemisebenzi ethelekelelwa kuma-216 090 ngowama-2015 xa kuthelekiswa nama-208 822 ngowama-2014.

src: Lungetulu kwegidzi letinge-R600 telutjalomali lolwaba khona nge-2015/16, lokwakha sisekelo sekucinisa kutfutfuka kwemabhizinisi lapho khona bekugcilwe emimangweni yasemaphandleni.
tgt: Lutyalo-mali olungaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-600 zeerandi athe atsalwe ngowama-2015/16, elusisiseko sokomeleza uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci olugxile kuluntu lwasemaphandleni.

src: IKhabhinethi iluvumile Luhlakamsebenti Lwekugcina Loluhlanganisiwe Lwekutfutfukisa Tindzawo Tasemadolobheni kanye neLuhlelo Lwekufezekisa lwanga-2016/19.
tgt: Khabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yokuGqibela yoPhuhliso lweeDolophu oluDibeneyo nesiCwangciso sokuPhumeza sowama-2016/19.

src: Umphumela sewuwonkhe waloLuhlakamsebenti Lwekugcina Loluhlanganisiwe Lwekutfutfikisa Tindzawo Tasemadolobheni kutfutfukiswa kwendzawo.
tgt: Iziphumo ezipheleleyo zeNkqubo –sikhokelo yoPhuhliso lweDolophu oludibeneyo yinguqu ngokwabala omhlaba.

src: Loku kwenta sivumelwane setebhizinisi lesisha semadolobhakati aseNingizimu Afrika, lokutawucondzisa kukhula kwetindzawo tasemadolobheni tibe yimodeli yekukhula lokungenamkhawulo nemadolobha lahleleke kahle futsi lasondzelene nalachunyaniswako, laphephile, lanemitfombolusito kanye naletindzawo lekahle tekusebenta nekuhlala kuwo.
tgt: Oku kuza notshintsho olutsha kwizixeko needolophu zaseMzantsi Afrika, nokuza kuqhubela uhlumo lwasezidolophini kwindlela eluqilima yohlumo oluzinzileyo, iqhagamshelanise ize iququzelele izixeko needolophu, neziyindawo ekhuselekileyo, ezinemithombo esebenzayo futhi neziyindawo elungileyo ukuba umntu angasebenza ahlale kuzo.

src: Loku kuphendvula ticondziso teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe lwekwakha inchumomgomo yekutfutfukisa tindzawo tasemadolobheni letawucinisekisa kuhlelwa ngendlela lefanele, kwakhiwa kwetakhowonchanti nekulawulwa kwato kute tesekele kukhula tibuye futsi tikhulule emandla emnotfo wemadolobhakati nemadolobha etfu.
tgt: Oku kusabela kumyalelo wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso wokuqulunqa umgaqo-nkqubo wophuhliso lwedolophu oza kuqinisekisa ngokucwangcisa okufanelekileyo, utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo nolawulo lokuxhasa uhlumo nokuvulela amandla ezoqoqosho lwezixeko needolophu.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kushicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende Inchubomgomo Yavelonkhe Yetekutfutfukisa Imisebenti – Kwakha Inchubo Yetinsita Yekutfutfukisa Imisebenti Lehlanganisiwe nalephumelelako yaseNingizimu Afrika, kute kutsi ummango uphawule ngayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweDrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo – uKwakhela uMzantsi Afrika iNkqubo esebenzayo neDibeneyo yeeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.

src: Loluhlaka lweNchubomgomo naselufezekisiwe lutawuniketa indlela luchunyanisiwe yekubukana netinsita tekutfutfukiswa kwemisebenti lenguyonayona yetakhamuti.
tgt: Le drafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo xa sele iphunyeziwe iza kubonelela ngendlela edibeneyo yeenkonzo zophuhliso lwamakhondo asemgangathweni kubo bonke abemi.

src: Loku kutawubenta kutsi bakwati kukhetsa kahle tinhlobo temisebenti kute kutsi batfole imisebenti, bafake sandla emmangweni babuye futsi bakhe umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Oku kuza kubenza bakwazi ukuthatha izigqibo zokukhetha amakhondo afanelekileyo ukuze bakwazi ukufumana imisebenzi, benze igalelo kuluntu nasekwakheni uqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Luphiko Lwetekutfutfukisa Imisebenti ludlala indzima lebalulekile ekusiteni timakethe tetisebenti kutsi tisebente kanye nekutsi tinchubo temfundvo tizuze imigomo yato.
tgt: IiNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo zidlala indima engundoqo ekuncedeni umsebenzi wokubonelela ngemisebenzi nenkqubo yezemfundo ukuba zifikelele kwiinjongo zazo ezijongise kuzo.

src: Loku kufaka sandla ekutsini kuzuzwe tincomo teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe tekukhutsata kukhula kwemnotfo nekucashwa, kucondzaniswe tisebenti nemisebenti kanye nekukhulisa lizinga lekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono kanye nelinani letitjudeni tasemanyuvesi letiphotfulile.
tgt: Oku kwenza igalelo ekuphumezeni izindululo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso sokukhuthaza uhlumo lwezoqoqosho nemisebenzi, ukuthelekisa abasebenzi abaphangelayo nemisebenzi nokwandiswa kophuhliso lwezakhono kunye noninzi lwabo banezidanga zasedyunivesiti.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngekufezekiswa kweNchubo Yekuhlola Yavelonkhe yabuye futsi yavuma Umbiko wemnyaka wa-2014/15 kanye neLuhlelo Lwekuhlola Lwavelonkhe lwa-2016/17 to 2018/19, njengencenye yemtamo wekwenta kancono kwetfulwa kwetinsita,Inchubo Yekuhlola Yavelonkhe ivela kuLuhlakamsebenti Lwenchubomgomo Yekuhlola Lwavelonkhe lolucinisekisa kutsi bufakazi lobungubobabona nalobungavunicala bekuhlola buyayakwa enchubeni yekuhlela, yelwabiwomali, ekwentiweni kancono kwenhlangano bubuye futsi bulinganisele kulawula kute kwentiwe kancono kusebenta.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngokuphunyezwa kweNkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe yaza yamkela iNgxelo yonyaka wama-2014/15 kunye nesiCwangciso soVavanyo seSizwe sesihlanu seminyaka yowama-2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018/19, njengenxalenye yendlela yokuphucula unikezela lweenkonzo.

src: Sekuphetfwe kuhlola lokunge-47 nobe kusatawentiwa, lokufaka ekhatsi lusetjentisomali lwahulumende lolutigidzigidzi letinge-Kuvunywe imibiko yekuhlola le-15 kanye nale-12 leyetfulwe kuKhabhinethi kute kube ngulamuhla.
tgt: INkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe ivela kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woVavanyo weSizwe oqinisekisa ukuba ubungqina bovavanyo obuthembakeleyo nobungakhethe-cala buyafakwa kwiinkqubo zokucwangcisa, ukwenza uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ukuphuculwa kweziko, uhlaziyo lomgaqo-nkqubo, kwakunye nolawulo lwenkqubo oluqhubekayo nolawulo lweprojekthi ukuze kuphuculwe indlela ekusetyenzwa ngayo.

src: Tinhlelo le-14 tekutfutfukisa tiyafezekiswa kwamanje futsi inchubekela embili yato ikhombisa tingucuko letinkhulu letibonakalako, letitawenabisa umphumela.
tgt: Luvavanyo olungama-47 eselugqityiwe okanye olusaqhutywayo, lubandakanya imali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-75 zeerandi enkcitho karhulumente.

src: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngemiphumela yabuye futsi yavuma netincomo ngenhloso yekukhulisa imiphumela ngekufezekiswa kweMkakha Wetenhlalo Weluhlelo Lwemisebenti Yahulumende Leyengetiwe (i-EPWP-SS).Loluhlelo ludlala indzima lenkhulu kutekuvikela kutenhlalo kwebantfu labadzala labangaguli ndzawo labangasebenti, ngekutsi bafakwe emisebentini lekhicitako nekutsi batfole umholombhasha welizinga lelisemkhatsini we-R1 517.
tgt: Zingxelo zovavanyo ezili-15 esezamkelwe ize ibe zezi-12 ezithiwe theca phambi kweKhabhinethi ukuza kutsho ngoku.

src: IKhabhinethi yatisiwe ngalokutfoliwe yabuye futsi yemukela netincomo tekuhlolwa kwedizayini nekufezekiswa kweSelekelelo Sekutfutfukisa Kuhlaliswa Etindzaweni Tasemadolobheni kanye neLuhlelo Lwekwenta Kancono.
tgt: Izicwangciso zokuphucula ezili-14 ziyaphunyezwa kwaye inkqubela kuzo ibonakalisa iinguqu ezinkulu, ukuvula umsantsa wempembelelo.

src: Loku lokutfoliwe kwesekela kugcinwa kweSelekelelo Sekutfutfukisa Kuhlaliswa Etindzaweni Tasemadolobheni njengesibonelelo sekugcwalisela lesisita ngetimali umbono lomkhulu wekuhlaliswa lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kute kutsi kuzuze bantfu labaphuyile kanye nemakhaya latfola imali lengenako lesezingeni lelisemkhatsini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zovavanyo nezindululo ezamkelweyo ngenjongo yokwandisa impembelelo yokuphunyezwa kweCandelo lezeNtlalo leNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu eNatyisiweyo (i-EPWP-SS).

src: Loku kubalulekile ekuzuzeni imigomo lehlosiwe levela kuLuhlakamsebenti Lwendlelalisu Lwethemu Lesemkhatsini kuvetwa kwematfuba etindlu leti-1 495 etindzaweni tekuhlala letingutonatona nga-2019.
tgt: Le Nkqubo idlala indima ebalulekileyo kukhuseleko lwezentlalo lwabantu abadala abakwaziyo ukusebenza abangaphangeliyo, ngokubatsalela kumsebenzi onenkqubela baze bafumene ukuvuzwa kwenyanga okungumyinge we-R 1 517.

src: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile umbiko weKufezekiswa neKuhlolwa Kwemphumela weTebucwepheshe neTisebenti teLuhlelo lweTimboni, kuphendvula kwebaphatsi kulombiko kanye neluhlelo lwekwenta kancono lolungeniswe Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni.
tgt: Uninzi lweenkqubo zecandelo lezentlalo zibonelela ngeenkonzo ezikhethekileyo kuluntu oluhlelelekileyo noluhluphekayo.

src: Loluhlelo lwetfulwa Litiko Letekuhwebelana Netimboni nga-1992 kucinisa kutfutfukiswa kwemakhono kutesayensi, tebunjinela netebucwepheshe.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngokuphindaphindeneyo phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibini, ukususela kwiinkqubo ezintlanu ukuya kwezi ngama-22 nezikhokelele ekubeni eli candelo lifikelele kumathuba emisebenzi engama-175 769 kwisigaba sokuqala namathuba emisebenzi engama-866 246 kwisigaba sesibini, ngaphezulu kakhulu kuma-750 000 ebesizimisele kuwo.

src: Lufaka sandla ekwakhekeni kwematfuba emisebenti ngekutsi lukhicita kufika kwenabacwaningi labanelikhono lelisezingeni lelisetulu kanye nebaphatsi betebucwepheshe betimboni kanye nekutfutfukisa kucudzelana kwetinhlangano temabhazinisi letihlanganyelako.
tgt: Ezi zindululo zigxile ekuphuculeni ukuphunyezwa ukuze kunciphe ukungathathwa kakuhle kwezigqibo, ukuphunyezwa (iintlawulo nokuvuzwa) nokubonelelwa koqeqesho, kwakunye nokuququzelela.

src: LoLuhlelo lungilo, lubalulekile futsi luyincenye leyenele yekwesekela lokusha lokuniketa lokulingana nemali ngekwekutfutfukiswa kwetebucwepheshe nekutfutfukisa tisebenti kanye nemakhono laphatselene netimboni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo yaza yazivuma izindululo zokuyilwa nokuphunyezwa kovavanyo lweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini neSicwangciso sokuPhuculwa kwaso.

src: Luphindze futsi lucatsiniseka kahle kakhulu naletinye tinhlelo temave emhlaba.
tgt: Ezi ziphumo zixhasa ukugcinwa kweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini njegesibonelelo soxabangelo nesiyinkxaso-mali yombono obanzi wezokuhlaliswa koluntu ozinzileyo nolinganayo ukwenzela ukuba kuxhamle abahluphekileyo namakhaya amkela imivuzo ephakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswa ngalokutfolwe nguMbiko Welicembu Lekusebenta Letindvuna lebeluhlola tinsolo ‘tikhundla tabothishela letitsengiswako’ lokufaka ekhatsi bantfu labatimele, tinhlangano tabothishela kanye netikhulu teMatiko Etemfundvo Etifundza letitsite.
tgt: Oku kuyanceda ekufikeleleni kummiselo ovela lwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiphakathi ukubonelela ngamathuba ezindlu azizigidi ezi-1 495 kwimeko yezokusingqongileyo yokuhlala okusemgangathweni ngowama-2019.

src: IKhabhinethi itivumile tincomo tekubukana naloko lokutfoliwe ngalokuhlelekile nangekwesekela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo engokuphunyezwa nokuVavanywa kweMpembelelo yezobuChwepheshe nemiCimbi yezaBasebenzi yeNkqubo yezoShishino, indlela abalawuli abayihlangabeza ngayo le ngxelo nesiCwangciso sokuphucula esifakwe liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.

src: Iphindze futsi yemukela tinkinga letinkhulu kulenchubo lekhona kwamanje yekubeka bothishela etikhundleni emkhakheni wetemfundvo lesisekelo libuye futsi libeke tincomo tekusita Litiko Letemfundvo Lesisekelo kanye nemkhakha wetemfundvo lesisekelo jikelele kute kulungiswe letinsayeya letitfoliwe.
tgt: Le Nkqubo yaveliswa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino ngowe-1992 ukomeleza uphuhliso lwezakhono kwezenzulu-lwazi, ezobunjineli nobuchwepheshe.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume kwetfulwa ePhalamende Umtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibela Temahlatsi.
tgt: Yenza igalelo ekudalweni kwemisebenzi ngokuvelisa igquba labaphandi-nzulu abanezakhono ezikudidi oluphezulu nabalawuli bezobuchwepheshe boshishino nangokuphucula ukukhuphisana kwemibutho yamashishini athatha inxaxheba.

src: LoMtsetfosivivinyo uchibela Umtsetfo Wetemahlatsi Wavelonkhe, 1998 (Umtsetfo 84 wa-1998).Kufesekiswa kwaletichibelo kutawenta kancono kulawulwa kwemahlatsi lokuchubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo kubuye futsi kukhutsate kuhlanganyela kwemacembu lasengotini, laphila ngetemahlatsi, kuMkandlu Wekweluleka Ngetemahlatsi Wavelonkhe.
tgt: Le Nkqubo iyasebenza, ibalulekile kwaye iluphawu olusebenzayo kwinkxaso yokuvelisa izinto ezintsha ebonelela ngexabiso elivakalayo ngemali ngokophuhliso lwezobuchwepheshe nophuhliso lwemicimbi yezabasebenzi nezakhono ezihambelana noshishino.

src: Baholi betenkholo kanye nebaholi betinhlangano temmango batawujoyina hulumende ekuthantazeleni kuhlanganiswa lokuchubekako kwentsandvo yelinyenti, kubumbana kwavelonkhe, kuchumana kwemimango yetenhlalo kanye neLukhetfo Lwahulumende Wendzawo lolunekuthula naloluyimphumelelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziphehlelele izindululo zokusebenza ngokulandela inkqubo ethile nangokwendlela ekuchazwe ngayo kwiziphumo.

src: IKhabhinethi yatiswe ngeluhlelo lweLitiko Letebuciko Nemasiko kutsi litawungenisa Inyanga Ye-Afrika ngeNkhwekhweti-2016 ngaphansi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kwakha i-Afrika Lencono neMhlaba Loncono” njengencenye yekugubha umkhosi kwalelive kugujelwa kusungulwa kweNhlangano Yekuhlanga kwe-Afrika (i-OAU), manje leseyibitwa ngekutsi Bunye Be-Afrika (i-AU) kanye nemsebenti leyiwentile.
tgt: KwiNgxelo yalo yokugqibela iQela loMphathiswa lihlabe amadlala kwindima edlalwa ngabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwinkqubo yokukhetha nokuqeshwa ootitshala.

src: Mengameli Jacob Zuma utawetfula Inyanga Ye-Afrika ngeLilanga Lekuthantaza Lavelonkhe mhla tinge-29 Mabasa 2016.Nga-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika itawugcila kubomake kanye nemitamo yekutfutfukisa lusha, sibe sikhumbula umnyaka we-60 weKushuca kwaBomake kanye nemnyaka we-40 weTibhelu Telusha taseSoweto.
tgt: Ikwaphawule iingxaki ezibalulekileyo kwinkqubo yangoku yokuqesha kwisithuba esikhoyo kwicandelo lezemfundo esisiseko yaza yabonelela ngezindululo zokunceda iSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko necandelo lezemfundo esisiseko ngokubanzi ukuba lingayisombulula njani le mingeni ichaziweyo.

src: Bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika bacelwa kutsi bahlanganyele eluhlelweni lwemikhakhaminyenti lolufaka ekhatsi imisebenti leminengi lefaka ekhatsi tebuciko lobubukwako, itiyetha, umculo, tifundvo kanye netingcungcutsela tetemfundvo kanye nemgubho we-10 wase-Afrika wekugubha Sikhwama Semagugu Emhlaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho siHlomelo wezamaHlathi weSizwe ePalamente.

src: Inyanga Ye-Afrika iyinkhundla yekuchumana nekutinikela kabusha kwetfu kuMcondvo weKubumbana kwe-Afrika kanye neKuncoba Kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni bantfu balalelivekati.
tgt: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho wezamaHlathi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuphunyezwa kwezi zihlomelo kuza kuphucula ulawulo lwezamahlathi oluzinzileyo kukhuthaze nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabahlelelekileyo, abaxhomekeke kwezamahlathi ukuze baphila, bathathe inxaxheba kwiBhunga leeNgcebiso lezamaHlathi leSizwe.

src: Mhla tinge-20 Inkhekhweti 2016 hulumende utawuhola kugujwa kwemkhosi wavelonkhe weminyakalikhulu weNyuvesi yaseFort Hare kuluphiko loluse-Alice eMphumalanga Kapa.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa umsitho wokubekwa esihlalweni nokufungiswa kukaMongameli uYoweri Museveni wase-Uganda eKampala ngomhla we-12 kuCanzibe wama-2016.

src: Mayelana nekulungiselela lomgubho lomkhulu, Mengameli Jacob Zuma sewusungule Likomidi LeTindvuna (i-IMC) kutsi lihlele libuye futsi lichumanise lomgubho wemnyakalikhulu loyincophamlandvo.
tgt: Olu tyelelo luphumayo luza kuqhubeka ukomeleza ubudlelwane bala mazwe mabini, uMzantsi Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: Lesikhungo sekufundza lesiyincophamlandvo sibe sikhonkhwane ngesikhatsi semzabalazo wekutfola inkhululeko sibuye futsi satiwe ngekutsi “libhodo lekuphekelwe kulo baholi base-Afrika” ngoba kwafundza khona bantfu labebalwa nelubandlululo, bantfu labakhulu labafanana nabo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo kanye naGovan Mbeki.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela uSuku loMthandazo leSizwe eliza kubanjelwa kumaBala ase-ABSA eDurban ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi wama-2016.

src: Ngiyo kuphela inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika lekhicite baholi bemibuso labasihlanu: Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye na-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.
tgt: Iinkokheli zakwaLizwi kunye neenkokheli zemibutho yoluntu ziza kuzibandakanya norhulumente ekuthandazeleni ukuqhubeka komanyano lwentando yesininzi, umanyano lwesizwe, intlalo- ntle kwakunye noNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 oluza kuba noxolo futhi lube yimpumelelo.

src: Njengencenye yekugujwa kwemkhosi wemnyakalikhulu weNyuvesi yaseFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema titjudeni lebetifundza kulenyuvesi kanye nemalunga emmango kutsi babelane ngaloko labakukhumbulako ngeFort Hare bentele umkhankhaso weCoca Yakho Indzaba basebentisa #MyFortHare.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngezicwangciso zeSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko zokusingatha iNyanga ye-Afrika kuCanzibe yowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono” njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yelizwekazi yokusekwa koMbutho weManyano ye-Afrika (i-OAU), ngoku ebizwa ngokuba yiMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) kunye nemisebenzi eyenzileyo.

src: Lisekela laMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa litawuhola litsimba letitfunywa laseNingizimu Afrika liye kuForamu Yetemnotfo Yemhlaba (i-WEF) ye-Afrika ye-26 eRwanda emkhatsini wamhla ti-11 namhla ti-13 Inkhwekhweti 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kumphehlelela iNyanga ye-Afrika ngoSuku loMthandazo leSizwe ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi yowama-2016.Ngowama-2016 iNyanga ye-Afrika iza kugxila kumalinge wophuhliso lwabantu basetyhini nolutsha, ngeli xesha siza kube sibhiyozela unyaka wama-60 woMngcelele wooMama nonyaka wama-40 woVukelo loLutsha eSoweto.

src: Leforamu itawubanjelwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Kuchumanisa imitfombolusito yase-Afrika ngeTingucuko tekweDijithali”.Hulumende ngaloLuhlelo lwakhe Lwemaphuzu Layimfica utfutfukisa tigucuko tekwedijithali telive lakhe.
tgt: Abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayabongozwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule nkqubo iqulathe iindidi ngeendidi zemisitho nemibhiyozo equka eyobugcisa obubonwayo, izifundo ngedrama, umculo, izifundo neentetho eziqhelekileyo kwakunye ngesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 yeNgxowa-mali yamaFa eHlabathi ase-Afrika.

src: Wetfula sigaba sekucala semtamo wakhe we-inthanethi lesebenta ngekushesha letawuchumanisa tisetjentiswa tahulumende letingetulu kwaleti-5 000 kubomasipala besigodzi labasiphohlongo eminyakeni lemitsatfu.
tgt: Le Nyanga ye-Afrika isebenza njengeqonga lokuqhagamshelanisa ngokutsha nokuzibophelela kwethu ngokutsha kuko konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika neBuyambo yase-Afrika ngokudibanisa abantu belizwekazi basondelelane.

src: INDABA 2016 eSikhungweni Senkhomfa sase-Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban kusukela mhla ti-7 kuya kumhla ti-9 Inkhwekhweti 2016, yinkhundla ye-Afrika Yonkhe letawukhutsata kutsengwa kwemikhicito yetfu yetekuvakasha bantfu bemave angaphandle.
tgt: Ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe wama-2016 urhulumente uza kukhokela umbhiyozo wesizwe wokugqiba kweDyunivesithi iFort Hare iminyaka elikhulu yabakho kwiziko layo eliseDikeni eMpuma Koloni.

src: Tekuvakasha, njengalenye yetinsika letisitfupha tekukhula kwemnotfo teLuhlelo Lwetekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe, tifake tigidzi letinge-R357 kuSambakhulu Semkhicito Wasekhaya (i-GDP) nga-2014 tabuye futsi tesekela i-9% yako konkhe kukhokhelwa kwaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umsitho omkhulu wokubhiyoza, uMongameli uJacob Zuma umisele iKomiti yabaPhathiswa (i-IMC) ukuba yenze izicwangciso ize iququzelele lo mbhiyozo wenkulungwane uyimbali.

src: Umkhandlu Wemhlaba Wetekuhamba kanye neTekuvakasha ulinganisela kutsi tekuvakasha titawufaka tigidzigidzi letinge-R560 ku-GDP yetfu nga-2025 kantsi futsi titawesekela imisebenti lengetulu kwaletigidzi letimbili.
tgt: Eli ziko lemfundo liyimbali belisebenza njengenqaba yethemba ngexesha lomzabalazo wethu wenkululeko kwaye laziwa “njengeziko lokupheka iinkokeli ze-Afrika” libe liyidyunivesithi ekwakufundwa kuyo ziinkokheli ezazikumzabalazo wokulwa ucalucalulo ezifana neengqanga oo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukhwe, Oliver Tambo noGovan Mbeki.

src: Kukhulisa umphumela weTekuvakasha eMnotfweni Waselwandle kuyinsika lebalulekile yeLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica, lokwesekelwa ngemakhono lasengakatsintfwa etilwandle tetfu, lokungafaka sandla ekukhuleni kwemnotfo.
tgt: Kuphela kwedyunivesithi yaseMazantsi e-Afrika evelise iintloko zoorhulumente ezintlanu: uNelson Mandela waseMzantsi Afrika, uYusuf Lule wase-Uganda, uRobert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Mayelana nekukhunjulwa kweLilanga leTisebenti mhla lu-1 Inkhwekhweti 2016, iKhabhinethi ihamba etinyatselweni tekutinikela kwelive letfu ekuvikeleni emalungelo etisebenti ngekwemtsetfo wetisebenti lotfutfukako.
tgt: Njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yenkulungwane iDyunivesithi iFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu ababefunda kule dyunivesithi noluntu jikelele ukuba babalisane ngeenkumbulo zabo ngedyunivesithi iFort Hare nephulo likaBalisa iBali Lakho ngokusebenzisa i- #MyFortHare.

src: Kusukela nga-1994 hulumende ngekusebentisa umtsetfo lefanana neMtsetfo Webudlelwane Betisebenti Nebacashi, Umtsetfo Wetimo Tekucashwa Letisisekelo, Umtsetfo Wekucashswa Ngekulingana kanye neTemphilo yasemsebentini neKuphepha yatfutfukisa emalungelo etisebenti.
tgt: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwingqungquthela yama-26 yeQonga lezoQoqosho leHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika e-Rwanda phakathi komhla we-11 nowe-13 kuCanzibe yowama-2016.

src: IkKabhinethi icela bafundzi beLibanga le-12 kutsi bacale manje bakhiphe ku-inthanethi emafomu ekufa ticelo tetindzawo tekufundza etikhungweni tetemfundvo lephakeme nobe bafake ticelo ku-inthanethi njengencenye yeMkankhaso i-Apply Now/Khetha Career GuidanceLomklamo uchutjwa njalo ngemnyaka Litiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha, utawuchutjwa kulo lonkhe lelive kute kube yiNyoni 2016 futsi usita bafundzi kutsi bakhetse kahle nabafaka ticelo tendzawo yekufundza etikhungweni temfundvo lephakeme.
tgt: Eli qonga lisingathwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuqhagamshelanisa iMithombo ye-Afrika ngeNguqu yezebuChwepheshe”.Urhulumente uqhubela phambili inguqu kwezobuchwepheshe yeli lizwe ngesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba.

src: Bafundzi bakhutsatwa kutsi batsintse Sikhungo Setinsita Tekutfutfukisa Imisebenti nge-SMS nome batfumele “please call me” ku: 072 204 5056 nobe :086 999 0123, incwadzigezi: EMAILTOKEN, ku-Facebook ku: WEBTOKEN nobe ku-Twitter ku: WEBTOKEN Tincumo teKhabhinethi etindzabeni letibalulekile tesimondzawo.
tgt: Uza kusungula isigaba sokuqala sephulo lakhe lamaza osasazo aza kufaka uqhagamshelwano kumaziko karhulumente angaphezulu kwama-5 000 kwizithili zoomasipala ezisibhozo kwixesha leminyaka emithathu.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata labatsintsekako kutsi baphawule ngeluhlaka lolubuyeketiwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika lweShatha Yekuhlonyiswa Ngemandla Emnotfo Umkhakha Lobanti Webantfu Labamnyama kanye neMboni Yetimbiwa, lwanga-2016 lolwashicilelwa kuGazethi yaHulumende.
tgt: INDABA YOWAMA-2016 ebanjelwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ukususela kumhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kuCanzibe yowama-2016, liqonga lokuzingca ngako konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika eliza kukhuthaza iimveliso zokhenketho kubathengi behlabathi.

src: Loluhlaka lolwabuyeketwa lweShatha Yetetimbiwa iyachubeka ihlanganise tinchubomgomo tahulumende tekutfutfukisa kanye nemtsetfo kute kutsi kuchutjwe emabhizinisi kalula, kwakheke kucaca kwekulawula, kucombeleleka kanye nekuciniseka.
tgt: Ukhenketho, njengenye yeentsika ezintandathu zohlumo lwezoqoqosho kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso, lenze igalelo eliyimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-357 kwiSambuku seMveliso yeSizwe (i-GDP) ngowama-2014 laza laxhasa i-9% kwingqesho epheleleyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

tgt: IBhunga lezoHambo eHlabathini noKhenketho lithelekelela ukuba ukhenketho lenze igalelo elizibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-560 kwi-GDP yethu ngowama-2015 kwaye luza kuxhasa imisebenzi engaphezulu kwezigidi ezibini.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kutsi kuvunywa kutfolwa kwe-SAB Miller yi-AB InBev lokuhlongotwako kubukwa tiphatsimandla temicudzelwano.
tgt: Uqoqosho lwaselwandle nokhenketho lubonelela ngamathuba angumangaliso ohlumo lwezoqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela indlela levunywe yiNdvuna Yekutfutfukiswa Kwetemnotfo kanye ne-AB InBev kutiphatsimandla temcudzelwano ngekwetintfo letinyenti letitsandvwa ngummango.
tgt: Kwisikhumbuzo soSuku lwabaSebenzi ngomhla woku-1 kuCanzibe wowama-2016, iKhabhinethi iyakuphinda ukuzibophelela kwayo ekukhuseleni amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho yezabasebenzi enenkqubela.

src: Lokutinikela kwalenkampani kusebenta njengenkhombandlela, yetindzaba letitsandvwa ngummango, kuletinye tinkampani letihlanganiswako kanye nekutfola etimeni letinjalo.
tgt: Ukususela ngowe-1994 urhulumente uwaqhubele phambili amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho efana noMthetho woBudlelwane bezaBasebenzi, uMthetho weeMeko zoMsebenzi ezisiSiseko, uMthetho womakuLingwane eMsebenzini nezeMpilo noKhuseleko eMsebenzini.

src: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kutinikela lokuvunyelwene ngako ngulenkampani kwekusebentisa sigidzigidzi si-R1 kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako kute kukhutsate kulima kwebalimi labancane kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwemtfulitinsita wendzawo, emabhizinisi lamasha, bucwepheshe bagezi nemanti lenele kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwelusha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqalise ukuprinta iifomu zokufaka izicelo okanye bafake izicelo kwi-intanethi kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo njengenxalenye yephulo lika-Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.

src: Kutinikela kumisebenti kufaka ekhatsi kugwema kutsi kulahleke imisebenti ngekudendwa kwetisebenti emsebentini ngekungatikhetseli ngenca yalokuhlanganiswa kwaletinkampani kanye nekugcina emazinga ekusebenta kulenkampani kuleminyaka lesihlanu letako, kuyincenye yesivumelwano lesiveta lokusha lesisemkhatsini walenkampani nahulumende sekwesekela timboni, kutfutfukiswa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kanye nekuvetwa kwematfuba emisebenti.
tgt: Eli phulo liqhutywa rhoqo ngonyaka liSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, liza kuqhutya esizweni jikelele kude kube yinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2016 kwaye linceda abafundi ekukhetheni ngokufanelekileyo xa befaka izicelo kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.

src: Etehlakalweni letehlukene, iKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kucala kusebenta kwemigomo yeMtsetfo Wekuchibela Imicudzelwano lowenta kutsi kube licala kutsi bacondzisi nebaphatsi bavumelane ngalokuyimfihlo kutsi balungise tintsengo, emathendza nobe timakethe.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhagamshelane neZiko leNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwaMakhondo ngokuthumela i-SMS okanye u-“please call me” kua-072 204 5056 okanye 086 999 0123, i-imeyili: EMAILTOKEN, kwikhasi lika-Facebook kwa: WEBTOKEN okanye basebenzise i-Twitter kwa: WEBTOKEN Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.

src: Lemigomo iyincenye yetinyatselo tekucinisakulwanetinhlangano letikhulisa tintsengo ngalokungekho emtsetfweni lokulimata umnotfo kubuye futsi kubite batsengi tintsengo letishisiwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphazelekayo ukuba bahlomle kwidrafti ehlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwamaLungelo ngokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi (i-BBBEE) kuShishino lwezeMigodi neziMbiwa zaseMzantsi Afrika, lowama-2016 nolwapapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso.

src: Simema emabhizinisi eNingizimi Afrika kutsi acudzelane ngetintsengo letiphasi, lokunyenti lokusha, lizinga lelincono lekudla lokuniketwako nobe tinsita temtfulitinsita laninika emakhasimende kunekuvumela ngalokuyimfihlo.
tgt: Le draftio ihlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwezeMigodi ibandakanya imigaqo-nkqubo yenguqu karhulumente nemithetho ngakumbi.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kutsi umkhakha wemabhange ulawulwa ngalokusezingeni lesitulu kanjani eNingizimu Afrika - nasemhlabeni wonkhe, kanye nesidzingo sekutsi iNingizimu Afrika ifanele kutsi ihambisane nemazinga emhlaba lafanana neBasel III kanye nemitsetfosimiso Lelwa nekwenta sengatsi imali letfolakele ngebugebengu itfolakale ngetindlela letifanele yeMbutfo Wekusebenta Wesinyatselo Setimali (i-FATF), lebeyivunywe yiKhabhinethi phambilini, yabuye futsi yesekelwa ngumtsetfo losisekelo lovunywe nguHulumende.
tgt: Ikwahambelana namasolotya oMthetho wokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi, wama-2003 (uMthetho onguNombo 53 wama-2003) kunye neKhowudi yokuSebenza kaKuhle (iiKhowudi zakwa-DTI).

src: Inchubo ye-Twin Peaks itawuphindze ilawule kutiphatsa kwetimakethe emkhakheni wetemabhange nalobanti.".
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukugunyaziswa kokuthengwa kweSAB Miller ngu-AB InBev kusaqwalaselwa ngamaqumrhu ezokhuphiswano.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayemukela imiphumela yeMhlangano Wesikhwama Setimali Wemave Emhlaba kanye neweMacembu Elibhange Lemhlaba weNtfwasahlobo yanga-2016 lobanjwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi “Tinsayeya Temave Emhlaba, Tisombululo Temave Emhlaba”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela indlela ekuvunyelwene ukuba mawuphathwe ngayo lo mba nguMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho ne-AB InBev umaqumrhu okhuphiswano kuluhlu lwemiba ehambelana neemfuno zoluntu.

src: Kwahlongotwa indlela lemkhakhamitsatfu letawubasela ngemandla kukhula ezingeni lemave emhlaba, lekhutsata emave kutsi asebentise tonkhe tigwadluli tenchubomgomo kute phelwe kukhula, imali yahulumende lengenako kanye nekuntjintjwa kwetimiso.
tgt: Isivumelwano esenziwe yile nkampani siza kusebenza njengesikhokelo, kwimiba ebalulekileyo kuluntu, nakwezinye iinkampani ezithenga okanye ezizimanya nezinye phantsi kweemeko ezikwafanayo.

src: Emave lanendzawo yemali nemali yahulumende lengenako akhutsatwa kutsi asebente kakhulu kute akhuphule timfuno nanoma kunjalo, kufezekiswa kwekuntjintja kwetimiso bekubalulekile kuwonkhewonkhe.
tgt: Oku kuquka isibhambathiso ekuvunyelwene ngaso yile nkampani sokuchitha imali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi kule minyaka mihlanu izayo ukukhuthaza amafama afuyela ukuziphilisa efuya ngomyinge omncinci nophuhliso lababoneleli-zinkonzo balapha ekhaya, amashishini amatsha asakhulayo, ezamandla nobuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa kakuhle amanzi nophuhliso lolutsha.

src: Kulinyenti loku kufaka ekhatsi kutjala imali kusakhiwonchanti, kulokusha kanye nekwenta kancono simondzawo sekulawula, emkhatsini waletinye tintfo.
tgt: Isibophelelo ngokwemisebenzi siquka ukuthintela ukudendwa ngenkani kwabasebenzi ngenxa yendibanisela yeenkampani nokugcina izinga lengqesho kule nkampani kule minyaka mihlanu ilandelayo, oko yinxalenye yesivumelwano sokuhlahla indlela phakathi kwale nkampani norhulumente ukuxhasa ukwanda kwemizi-mveliso, uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci nokudala imisebenzi.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuta bonkhe bavoti labafanele labasengakabhalisi futsi labangakacinisekisi imininingwane yabo kutsi basengabhalisa nobe bacinisekise imininingwane yabo ngekutsi bavakashele Lihhovisi leKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele (i-IEC) yendzawo yakubo.
tgt: Komnye omba, iKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwamasolotya oMthetho-siHlomelo woKhuphiswano owenza ukuba kungabikho mthethweni ukuba abalawuli nabaphathi basebenzisane ukwenze iyelenqe lokunyusa amaxabiso, kwiziniki-maxabiso okanye kurhwebo.

src: Loku kuyadzingeka kute kutsi kucinisekise ligama lakho eluhlwini lwebavoti lokutawenta bavoti labafanelekile kutsi basebentise lilungelo labo lentsandvo yelinyenti mhla ti-3 Ingci 2016.IKhabhinethi icela bavoti labafanelekile kutsi bacinisekise kutsi bayahlangabetana netidzingo tekuniketa lihhovisi leKhomishini Yelukhetfo Letimele (i-IEC) emakheli abo.
tgt: La masolotya ayinxalenye yamanyathelo okunyusa izinga lokulwa amaqela enza amayelenqe enzakalisa uqoqosho ngokuthi abize abathengi amaxabiso aphezulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iTransnet, Umkhandlu Wetebushushisi Wavelonkhe, Inhlangano Yetekusakata Ngemoya YaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) kanye neLitiko Letemfundvo Lephakeme Nekucecesha, Litiko Letebudlelwane Nekubambisana Kwemave Emhlaba, kanye neLetebulungiswa Nekutfutfukiswa KweMtsetfosisekelo ngekutsi abekwe ezingeni lekutsi “Abacashi Labahehana Kakhulu” eNingizimu Afrika yinkampani lebeka bacashi luphawu, UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi incoma Indvuna yeLitiko Letesayensi Netheknoloji, Naledi Pandor, lotfole umklomelo we-Order of Merit kuFederal Republic of Germany ngekufaka kwakhe sandla ekutfutfukisweni kwetesayensi emaveni emhlaba.
tgt: Sicela onke amashishini aseMzantsi Afrika ukuba mawakhuphisane ngamaxabiso aphantsi, ngokuba nobuchule obuthe chatha, ukuphucuka komgangatho wezinto abonelela ngazo okanye ukunika abathengi inkonzo ekwizinga eliphezulu kunokwenza amayelenqe.

src: Lomklomelo uklonyeliswe bantfu labavela emaveni emhlaba ngekuzuza kwabo emikhakheni yetepolitiki, tetenhlalo nome tetemfundvo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba icandelo leebhanki lilawulwa ngokwezinga eliphezulu eMzantsi Afrika – nasehlabathini jikelele, kunye nemfuneko yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uhambelane nemigangatho yehlabathi efana ne-Basel III nemithetho yeQela lezemiSebenzi yezeZimali (i-FATF) yokulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali, neyayamkelwe ngaphambili yiKhabhinethi, yaxhaswa yimithetho engundoqo eyayamkelwe ngurhulumente.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Umcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Letemvelo Nosipho Ngcaba ngekutfola Umklomelo We-Eco-Logic Wemphilo Yonkhe Wanga-2015/16 lovela kumagazini yetemvelo, i-The Enviropaedia.
tgt: Inkqubo yokuGunyaziwe Ababini nayo iza kulawula indlela oluziphatha ngayo urhwebo kwicandelo leebhanki necandelo lezezimali ngokubanzi.”.

src: IKhabinethi ihalalisela sobuciko Kemang Wa Lehulere ngekuba "nguSobuciko Wemnyaka" wa-2017 lowesekelwa yiDeutsche Bank.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgxowa-mali yeMali yeHlabathi yowama-2016 neNdibano yaseNtlakohlaza yamaQela eeBhanki zeHlabathi eqhubeke phantsi komxholo othi “IMingeni yeHlabathi, iziSombululo zeHlabathi”.

src: Wa Lehulere, lohlolisisa kufaneleka kwalokukhonjiswa yiNingizimu Afrika ngemuva kwelubandlululo, utawukhangisa imisebenti yakhe yedvwana kwekucala eGermany eDeutsche Bank KunstHalle eBerlin kulomnyaka lotako.
tgt: Kuphakanyiswe indlela embaxa yokuvuselelwa kohlumo kwinqanaba lehlabathi, kukhuthazwa amazwe ukuba asebenzise onke amandla okunyusa akwimigaqo-nkqubo yawo ukukhuthaza uhlumo, oko kuthetha olungokwemali, olungokwemali kaRhulumente nokulungiswa kwezakhiwo.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Litiko Letekuvakasha ngekuphumela kutfola umklomelo weNchubomgomo Yemmango/Kwesekela Lehamba Embili kuMiklomelo Yetekuvakasha Lokunesibopho yanga-2016.
tgt: Amazwe anesithuba ngokwemali nangokwemali kaRhulumente akhuthazwa ukuba enze ngakumbi ukuphucula imfuneko noxa kunjalo, ukuphunyezwa kokulungiswa kwezakhiwo kubaluleke kakhulu kunako konke okunye.

src: Lomklomelo uklonyeliswa litiko lemkhakha wahulumende, umtimba lophetse nobe nanobe ngusiphi sikhungo lesitinikele ngalokucacile sabuye futsi safaka sandla ekutfutfukiseni tekuvakasha etinesibopho.
tgt: Kuninzi oku kuquka utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo, ubuchule bokuvelisa izinto ezintsha nokuphucula ukusebenza kolawulo, phakathi kokunye.

src: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umdlaligaluva Branden Grace ngekuwina mcudzelwano wakhe wekucala we-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage eHilton Head, e-UIKhabhinethi idzabukile ngekushona kwaBertie Lubner lowafaka sandla lesikhulu ekutfutfukeni kweNingizimu Afrika kutsi ibe ngumholi kutemabhuzinisi, umvelisi wemusa nesihawu kanye nasihlalo wemphilo yekubonga weNhlangano YemaJuda aseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke abo bangabavoti abaselungelweni abangekabhalisi baqinisekise nangeenkcukhacha zabo ukuba bangakwenza oko ngokutyelela ii-Ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC) ezikufutshane kubo.

src: IKhabhinethi yendlulisele emavi ayo endvudvuto kubangani nemindeni yalaba labalishumi (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle and Simphiwe Nhlapo) labashone kunhlekelele yengoti yebhasi babuya kuRali Yekwetfulwa KweManifesto ye-ANC eBhayi.
tgt: Oku kuyadingeka ukuqinisekisa ngokubakho kwegama lakho kuluhlu lwabavoti okuza kwenza ukuba abavoti abaselungelweni bakwazi ukusebenzisa ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngomhla we-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abavoti abaselungelweni ukuba baqinisekise ukuba banazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo zokunikezela ngeedilesi zabo kwi-ofisi yeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC).

src: Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, dokotela lokhetsekile wekucala lomnyama eNingizimu Afrika wetembeleko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabakwa-Transnet, iGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso, iZiko lezoSasazo loMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) neSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, iSebe lezoBudlelwane baMazwe ngamazwe neNtsebenziswano, kunye neSebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko ngokuthi anikwe iwonga lokuba kudidi lokuba “Ngabona baQeshi banoMtsalane” eMzantsi Afrika yinkampani esebenza ngamagama abaqeshi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi yothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othe wafumana imbasa i-Order of Merit kwiFederation Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe kuphuhliso lwezenzululwazi ehlabathini jikelele.

src: Njengemsunguli wemtfolamphilo wetembeleko eSibhedlela ePark Lane eJozi, Netshidzivhani wasita bantfu labanengi baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi babe nemindeni yabo.
tgt: Eli wonga belinikezelwa kubantu behlabathi jikelele ngeempumelelo zabo kwinqanaba lezepolitiki, lezentlalo okanye kwelobungqondi.

src: IKhabhinethi yendlulisele emavi ayo endvudvuto emndenini nakubangani baDene Smuts, lobekaLilunga lePhalemnde leDemocratic Alliance esikhatsini lesendlulile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMlawuli-Jikelele weSebe lezeNdalo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokufumana imbasa ebizwa i-Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award evela kwimagazini yezendalo, i-The Enviropeadia.

src: IKhabhinethi imetfulela sigcoko ngekufaka sandla kwakhe kahle kakhulu ekutfutfukisweni kwentsandvo yetfu yelinyenti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla igcisa uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba “Ligcisa loNyaka” lowama-2017 elixhaswa yi-Deutsche Bank.

src: IKhabhinethi ijoyina Mengameli Jacob Zuma ekufiseleni Make Winnie Madikizela-Mandela kwelulama ngekushesha iphindze futsi icela kutsi lomndeni uhlonishwe ngalesikhatsi lesi.
tgt: UWa Lehulere, ophonononga imisebenzi yobugcisa emva koCalucalulo eMzantsi Afrika, uza kwenza umboniso wakhe wokuqala eyedwa eGermanu kwiholo eDeutsche Bank KunstHalle eBerlin kulo nyaka uzayo.

src: Winnie Mandela uhlonishwa kakhulu ngendzima yakhe layidlala ekulweleni kwetfu inkhululeko lokwafaka sandla ekucedzeni tinchubomgomo letigcilatanako kanye nekuletsa intsandvo yelinyenti eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezoKhenketho ngokuphumelela ibhaso lokuba Yelona Nkonzo kaRhulumente inoMgaqo-nkqubo/Nkxaso eNgcono kwiMbasa yoKhenketho oluFanelekileyo e-Afrika lowama-2016.

src: Kubekwa EtikhundleniKutawuhlolwa ticu tabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni kubuye futsi kucinisekiswe ngalokufanele.
tgt: Eli wonga linikezelwa kwisebe lecandelo laseburhulumenteni, ugunyaziwe okanye iqumrhu elithe labonakalisa ukuzinikela okucacileyo negalelo lokuqhubela phambili ukhenketho.

src: Paul Steenkamp kuMkandlu Wetekweluleka Ngalokusha Wavelonkhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomdlali wegalufa uBranden Grace ngokuphumelela imbasa yakhe yokuqala,i-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage e-Hilton Head, e-U IKhabhinethi ilusizi ngokushiywa kwethu nguBertie Lubner nothe wenza igalelo elincomekayo kuphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika njengenkokeli kwezoshishino, umthandi wabantu nowawongelwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo ubomi bakhe bonke we-SA Jewish Board of Deputies.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson njengeSikhulu Lesikhulu Setimali saseSENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde njengeSikhulu Lesiphetse seLuphiko Lwetemisebenti Lefananako kanye ne-Ejensi yeKufinyelela yaseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvelwano olunzulu kubahlobo nosapho lwamaxhoba alishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, uSesi Mtshali, uSana Sibeko, uMphikeleli Malindi, uGugulethu Sithole, uVusi Nkabinde, uDaphney Linda, uSicelo Kheswa, uSphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) engozi yebhasi emasikizi eyenzeke ngethuba ebebuya kwiNgqungquthela yoMqulu weziThembiso ye-ANC eBhayi.

src: Kuphindza futsi kubekwa esikhundleni kwa-Adv.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwanqwenela abo bathe bonzakala ukuba bachache ngokukhawuleza.

src: Rory Wayne Voller njengeLisikelaKhomishani leKhomishini Yetinkampani kanye Nemisebenti Yebuciko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano olunzulu kusapho nezihlobo zikaGqirha u-Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, nongowokuqala oNtsundu eMzantsi Afrika ukuba yingcali kwezokuchumisa.

src: Kwelulwa kwekontileka yaLungisa Fuzile njengeMcondzisi Jikelele weMgcinimafa Wavelonkhe.
tgt: Njengomseki wekliniki yokuchumisa kwiSibhedlele i-Park Lane eRhawutini, uNetshidzivhani uncede abemi baseMzantsi Afrika abaninzi ukuba baqalise iintsapho zabo.

src: Kwelulwa kwekontileka yaNosipho Ngcaba njengeMcondzisi Jikelele weLitiko Letemvelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zikaDene Smuts, owayesakuba liLungu lePalamente lombutho iDemocratic Alliance.

src: N Mafu njengeLisekela leMcondzidi Jikelele: Kuhlomisa Ngemakhono Nekulawulwa Kwalabatsintseko kuLitiko Letigayigayi Temphi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilothulela umnqwazi igalelo lakhe elikhulu kuphuhliso lolawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi olumilisele kumgaqo-siseko.

src: TLM Makotoko njengeSikhulu Setkusebenta kuLitiko Letemvelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi njengoMongameli uJacob Zuma, inqwenelela uMama uWinnie Madikizela-Mandela ukuba achache ngokukhawuleza ikwacela ukuba usapho lunikwe intlonipho yalo ngeli xesha.

src: Kufezekiswa Kwetinhlelo Tahulumende Letibalulekile.
tgt: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umbiko lovela eNdvuneni yeTetimali locondziswe kuMengameli, lomayelana nenchubekelembili nekubonisana kwaHulumende nemkhakha lotimele netetisebenti mayelana nemnotfo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ingxelo eyenziwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali kuMongameli, ngenkqubela yokufakana imilomo kukarhulumente naboshishino lecandelo labucala kunye nemibutho yabasebenzi ngoqoqosho.

src: Mengameli ugunyate Indvuna kutsi ihole tinkhulumiswano nalabalingani betenhlalo kutsi bente indlelalisu babuye futsi batfole tindlela tekukhulisa umnotfo nekulondvolota silinganisotikweleti salelive.
tgt: UMongameli ebegunyazise uMphathiswa ukuba akhokele ezi ndibano zokufakana imilomo nala mahlakani ezentlalo ukuba kuboniswane ngesicwangciso-qhinga kunye nokuveza amalinge okukhulisa uqoqosho nokugcina indawo ilizwe elibekwa kuyo ngokwezoqoqosho.

src: Kuyayitfokotisa Ikhabhinethi kutsi lomsebenti sewucinise imitamo letawenta kancono litsemba lemnotfo walelive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inovuyo lokuba lo msebenzi uphele ekuveliseni amanyathelo okuqala aluqilima aza kuphucula amathemba kumbono wezoqoqosho weli lizwe.

src: NgeMsombuluko Mengameli umemetele imitamo leminyenti lehamba embili, lefaka ekhatsi: (1) sikhwama senhlanganisela yemkhakha lotimele kanye nemkhakha wahulumende seKwesekela Emabhizinisi Lamancane, (2) kulungisa tintfo leticindzela kukhula kwelutjalomali kute kutsi kusheshiswe umnotfo lofaka konkhe ekhatsi, (3) lubanjiswano lwelutjalomali kutakhiwonchanti lwemkhakha lotimele kanye nemkhakha wahulumende lolumiselwe ekuphumeleleni kweLuhlelo Lwekuphehla Emandla Lolutimele kanye (4) nekucinisa Emabhizinisi aHulumende kucinisekisa kutsi anemali lengapheli kanye nekucinisekisisa indzima yawo layidlalako ekugcugcuteleni intfutfuko.
tgt: NgoMvulo uMongameli ubhengeze amaphulo aphambili aliqela, aquka: (1) ingxowa-mali edibeneyo yabezoshishino labucala norhulumente yeNkxaso yamaShishini amaNcinane, (2) ukuhlangabezana neengxaki eziphazamisa utyalo-mali olwandayo khona ukuze kukhawuleziswe uhlumo oluquka wonke umntu, (3) utyalo-mali oludibeneyo lukarhulumente nabezoshishino labucala kwiziseko ezingundoqo kusetyenziswa umzekelo weNkqubo yabaVelisi baMandla oMbane abaZimeleyo ebe yimpumelelo kunye (4) nokomeleza amaShishini kaRhulumente ukuqinisekisa uzinzo lwawo lwezezimali nokomeleza indima yawo ekuqhubemi uphuhliso.

src: Letimemetelo tisicinisekiso saloko lokungazuzwa ngulelive nangabe bonkhe bahlanganyeli bangasebentisana basebentele umgomo munye.2 IKhabhinethi iyachubeka nekutetsemba kutsi kuhlanganiswa kwetimali lokunemandla kwahulumende, kugcogcwa kwetigidzigidzi tetigidzigidzi-R1 lokungumlandvo tagcogcwa Luphiko Lwekugcogca Imali LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) kanye netinyatselo tekungenelela letisihlanu tesikhatsi lesifishane letisandza kumenyetelwa, konkhe loku kuphelelisa luhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica kute kutsi kucinisekiswe tingucuko letinhle kumnotfo wetfu.
tgt: Ezi zibhengezo zibubungqina bokuba yintoni enokwenziwa leli lizwe xa onke amahlakani ezentlalo edibene esebenzisana kwaye ejongise kwinjongo enye.2 IKhabhinethi ihleli iqinisekile ukuba uhlengahlengiso olumandla lwezoqoqosho, ukuqokelela kweNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) imali efikele kwitriliyoni yeerandi okokuqala ezimbalini kwakunye nokubhengezwa kwakutsha nje kwamanyathelo okungenelela amahlanu exesha elifutshane, zonke nje zongeza kwisicwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ngokwenzeka kwenguqu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.

src: Kugcogcwa kwamalingena lokukhulile yi-SARS kutawuchubeka kwente Hulumende kutsi etfule tinsita letiphucula lizinga lemphilo lato tonkhe takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika.3 IKhabhinethi iyasemukela simemetelo lesentiwe yi-ejensi lelinganisa tikweleti, iMoody’s Investor Services, lekutsi kuleliviki leliphelile icinisekise silinganisosikweleti salelive kutsi singemazinga lamabili ngetulu kwengoti yelutjalomali lelizingancane.
tgt: Ukwanda kwerhafu eqokelelweyo ngabakwa-SARS kuza kongeza ukwenza ukuba uRhulumente anikezele iinkonzo eziza kuphucula umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.

src: Ekucinisekiseni silinganisosikweleti, iMoody's ikucaphele kutsi iNingizimu Afrika isondzela ezingeni lekuntjintja ngemuva kweminyaka yekuba butsakatsaka futsi tindlela tekuhlanganiswa lokunemandla kulwabiwomali lwanga-2016 kutawutintisa sikwelete sahulumende kuSambakhulu Semkhicito Wasekhaya (i-GDP) kulomnyaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe yi-arhente yokuhlela, iMoody’s Investor Services, ethe kwezi veki zimbini zidlulileyo yaphinda yaliqinisekisa inqanaba eli lizwe elibekwa kulo kwezoqoqosho engamanqanaba amabini ngaphezulu kwenqanaba elilelona liphantsi nelamnkelekileyo kubatyali-zimali.

src: Onkhe emacembu avumile kutsi kudzingeka kutsi kucinisekiswe imitamo yekubambisana kute kutsi inike emandla kuvuka kwemnotfo.
tgt: Ekungqineni eli nqanaba, abakwaMoody’s baphawule okokuba uMzantsi Afrika uya uyiguqula imeko emva kweminyaka yohlumo olubuthathaka kwaye amanyathelo okuhlengahlengisa nokomeleza uqoqosho owama-2016 aza komeleza ityala likarhulumente kwiSambuku seMveliso yeLizwe (i-GDP) kulo nyaka.

src: Imibiko yenchubelembili kanye netinhlelo letivela kuMcombelelo weMatiko ikhombisa kutsi iNingizimu Afrika isive lesisebentako, lesiholwa nguhulumende, lesakha imphilo lencono yabo bonkhe bantfu.
tgt: Onke amaqela ayangqinelana ukuba amalinge entsebenziswano adinga ukomelezwa ukunika amandla ekuphucukeni koqoqosho.

src: Kumiswe ngemumo tindlela letitawunciphisa umphumela lomubi wekwehla kwemnotfo emhlabeni wonkhe jikelele, kanye nekulungiselela kukhula lokunemandla lapho imijikeleto yemnotfo igucuka iba ngulemihle.
tgt: Sikwaqaphela ukuba umsebenzi woMphathiswa wezeMali kunye namahlakani ezentlalo ukwaquka umsebenzi oluthotho wohlolo lwemali ilizwe elinayo oza kuchonga uhlaziyo olunokwenziwa nongenelelo lokugcina urhwebo olomeleleyo lwemali eyinkunzi yaseMzantsi Afrika nomlinganiselo wohlolo lwemali yotyalo-mali.4 UMongameli uyazibulela iiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngabaPhathiswa ngokwahlukeneyo nezithi zihlangabezane neemfuno zabo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Siphindze futsi sisebenta ngemandla kususa tintfo tasekhaya levimba kukhula.
tgt: Iingxelo zenkqubela nezicwangciso eziphuma kwezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zibonakalisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usisizwe esisebenzayo, apho urhulumente akhokelayo khona, ekwakheni ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Lomcombelelo uphindze futsi ukhombise kutsi hulumende, tisebenti kanye nemabhizinisi kuyasebentisana, kundlula tonkhe letinte tikhatsi, kutfola tindlela tekuvisetela ngemandla kukhula kanye nekwakha imphilo lencono yabo bonkhe.
tgt: Kumiselwe amanyathelo aluqilima ukunciphisa impembelelo embi yokudodobala koqoqosho ehlabathini jikelele kuqoqosho lweli lizwe, nokulungiselela uhlumo lwezoqoqoqsho oludlamkileyo xa uqoqosho seluguquke lwathembisa.

src: Loku kufaka ekhatsi kufezekiswa lokunemandla kweLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica, lokwamenyetelwe nguMengameli Zuma eNkhulumeni yakhe Yebunjalo Belive yanga-2015 kanye ne-Operation Phakisa, lokwentelwe kusheshisa kufezekiswa kwetisombululo etindzaweni letibalulekile letitfutfukiswako.
tgt: Sikwasebenza ngamandla ukususa imiqobo yalapha ekhaya kwezohlumo.

src: LoLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe, njengekunciphisa buphuya nekungasebenti.5 IKhabhinethi icinisekise bantfu baseNingizimu Afrika kutsi lesimo sekubate imisebenti siyalungiswa nekufezekiswa kweLuhlelo Lwekutfutfukisa Lwavelonkhe (i-NDP) ngekungenelela kweLuhlelo Lwemaphuzu Layimfica lolufuna kufaka emandla kukhula lubuye futsi lukhuphule imisebenti emikhakheni lebalulekile yemnotfo wetfu.
tgt: Ezi voti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zikwabonakalisa ukuba urhulumente, imibutho yabasebenzi nabezoshishino basebenzisana, kakhulu kunangaphambili, ukufumanisa ngeendlela zokuvuselela uhlumo nokwakha ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.

src: Kuhlangana kwemkhakha lotimele kubaluleke kakhulu kumphumela loyimphumelelo.
tgt: Oku kuquka ukufezekiswa ngamandla kwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, esathi sabhengezwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowama-2015 kwakunye nephulo i-Operation Phakisa, elamiselwa ukukhawulezisa ukufezekiswa kwezisombululo kwimimandla apho uphuhliso ludingeka ngamandla khona.

src: Hulumende usebentisa yonkhe imitamo lekhona kufaka ekhatsi Luhlelo Lwekusebenta Lwenchubomgomo Yetimboni (i-IPAP) kwakha umkhicito lotsatsa tisebenti letinyenti kanye nemikhakha yetinsita lelungisa tekubabete kwemisebenti lokuchutjiselwe lutsi ekhatsi timo letimatimo tetemnotfo wemave emhlaba kanye newasekhatsi.
tgt: Ezi nkqubo zihlangabezana nemiba ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP), efana nokuncitshiswa kwendlala nentswela-ngqesho.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa kwakhona abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba iimeko yentswela-ngqesho kweli lizwe kuhlangatyezwana nayo ngokufezekiswa kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) seli lizwe, ngongenelelo lwezoqoqosho lwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba esenzelwe ukuvuselela uhlumo size sikhulise imisebenzi kumacandelo angundoqoqo kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Indvuna Yetekuhwebelana Netetimboni, Rob Davies yetfule umnyaka wesiphohlongo wekuphindvwa kwe-IPAP kusuka nga-2016/17 kuya ku-2018-19 mhla tiyi-9 Inkhwekhweti 2016 lapho khona basunguli bekwentiwa kwetinsimbi nemishini kutawuba bantfu labamnyama nga-100% eGauteng.
tgt: Intsebenziswano yecandelo lezoshishino labucala ibaluleke kakhulu ukuze kufumaneke iziphumo ezihle.

src: Hulumende igcizelela kubaluleka kwekubambisana netinkampani tetimboni tendzawo letiphucuke ngalokusezingeni lelisetulu letingahlanganyeli nje kuphela ekutfutfukiseni sakhiwonchanti, titfutsi, nekufezekiswa kwemisebenti leminyenti, kepha nasemikhakheni leyehlukahlukene lenebucwepheshe lobusetulu, lelungele kutsengisela lamanye emave kanye nalenetisebenti letinyenti temnotfo lophelele waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Urhulumente usebenzisa onke amaphulo akhoyo kuquka nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza koMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukudala iimveliso eziza kuthatha abasebenzi abongezelelekileyo namacandelo eenkonzo ukuhlangabezana nentswela-ngqesho ethe yaphinda yongezwa bubunzima beemeko zezoqoqosho zehlabathi jikelele nezalapha ekhaya.

src: Nanobe nje Luklayo Lwetisebenti Lwekota yekucala yanga-2016 lukhombise kukhula nge-27% kwelizinga lekubate imisebenti njalo ngekota, emazinga ekubate imisebenti anga-2016 asetulu nge-204 000 ebantfu labacashiwe nakucatsaniswa nekota yekucala yanga-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwemukela kuniketelwa kweBeaufort West Youth Hub, eNshonalanga Kapa, nguMengameli Jacob Zuma, lokunika bantfu labasha sikhungo, lapho khona bangatihlomisa ngemandla.
tgt: UMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino uRob Davies umisele owesibhozo umfuziselo wonyaka we-IPAP2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018-19 ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe wowama-2016 kwinkampani yokunyibilikisa isinyithi negilasi enabanikazi abaNtsundu ngokupheleleyo eGauteng.

src: Lesikhungo sinetisetjentiswa letehlukene letiniketa kutfutfukiswa lokuphelele kwebantfu labancane kanye nemmbango ngebubanti bawo.
tgt: Urhulumente ugxininisa ukubaluleka kokwakhiwa kwentsebenziswano emandla neenkampani zezoshishino zalapha ekhaya ezigqwesileyo nezisebenzisa ubuchule bale mihla ezingabandakanyeki nje kuphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, ezothutho nezolungiselelo kodwa zibandakanyeke kuthotho lwezinto zobuchwepheshe ezinzima, ezilungele ukuthunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle necandelo elifuna kakhulu abasebenzi loqoqosho laseMzantsi Afrika liphela.

src: Letisetjentiswa letikulesikhungo titawunika bantfu labancane lababuya emimangweni lephuyiyile ematfuba latawubenta kutsi bahlanganyele kancono futsi bafake ligalelelo lelakhako emimangweni yabo nakulelive.
tgt: Ngeli xesha uPhando olungabaSebenzi lweKota ebelwenziwe kwikota yokuqala yowama-2016 lubonakalise ukwanda kwintswela-ngqesho okufikelela kuma-26.7% ngokwekota nekota, ngowama-2016 izinga lemisebenzi linyuke ngama-204 000 ekuqesheni abantu xa lithelekiswa nekota yokuqala yowama-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukunikezelwa kweZiko loLutsha laseBhobhofolo eNtshona Koloni nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, elibonelela ulutsha ngoncedo lobuchule, apho lunokuzixhobisa.

src: Lesikhungo Semakhono lesinetisetientiswa letiphelele sichutjwa Likoloshi laseNingizimu Kapa stawucecesha-200 ngemnyaka bahlanganyenli beMbutfo Weluphiko Lwelusha Lwasemaphandleni Lwavelonkhe (i-NARYSEC) kutekulawula emabhizinisi, kusebentisa ngcondvomshini kanye nekutfutfukisa umntfwana eminyakeni yekucala.
tgt: Eli Ziko lineendidi ngeendidi zoncedo lobuchule olubonelela ngophuhliso olugabalala lwabantu abatsha noluntu ngokubanzi.

src: I-NARYSEC luhlelo lwesikhatsi lesidze lapho khono kucondvwa lusha lwasemaphendleni, luyahlwaywa luphindze lunikwe emakontileka eminyaka lemibili.
tgt: Olu ncedo lobuchule lukhoyo kweli ziko lolutsha luza kubonelela abantu abatsha abasuka kuluntu oluhluphekileyo ngamathuba okuthatha ngcono inxaxheba nokwenza igalelo elihle kuluntu lwalo nakwilizwe.

src: Lusha loluneminyaka yebudzala lesemkhatsini we-18 kuya kulenge-25 luyahlwaya bese lubhaliselwa kuceceshelwa emakhono lehlukene latawubahlomisa ngelwati lwengcondvo kanye nelwenta ngalokubonakalako, kutsi batakhele imisebenti yabo kanye nalabanye bantfu emimangweni yabo.
tgt: IZiko lezaKhono elixhotyiswe ngokupheleleyo neliqhutywa yiKholeji yaseMzantsi Koloni iza kubonelela ngoqeqesho kulawulo lwezoshishino, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nophuhliso lwabantwana abazintsana ukuya kutsho kubathathi-nxaxheba abangama-200 beQela leNkonzo yoManyano lwamaShishini oLutsha lwaseMaphandleni leSizwe (i-NARYSEC) ngonyaka.

src: Lesikhungo seLusha singumjlamo wekulinga kufezekisa akuta sewube khona phambilini, futsi utawentiwa kulesifundza.7 IKhabhinethi iyawemukela Umhlangano Wesifundza Sase-Afrika weLubanjiswano LwaHulumende Loluvulekile (i-OGP) wanga-2016 losandza kubanjwa lebewungeniswe yiNingizimu Afrika ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi "Hulumende lovulekile weNtfutfuko Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo e-Afrika" kusuka mhla ti-5 tiya kumhla ti-6 Inkhwekhweti 2016.Lomhlangano wenteke ngemuva kwetinyanga lestisikhombisa iNingizimu Afrika ibe nguSihlalomholi weLubanjiswano LwaHulumende Lovulekile.
tgt: I-NARYSEC yinkqubo yexesha elide apho igxile, ikwagaya ulutsha lwasemaphandleni kuphela nenesivumelwano sexesha leminyaka emibini.

src: Tinchumbomgomo tahulumende lovulekile tibaluleke kakhulu ekuzuzeni umkhakha lobanti kakhulu wemigomo yentfutfuko lechubekela embili ngalokungenamkhawulo, kuchumanisa kuvuleka nebuholi bekutfutfukiswa kwebantfu labaphuyile emhlabeni.
tgt: Kugaywa ulutsha oluminyaka iphakathi kwe-18 nama-25 ubudala luze lubhaliselwe uqeqesho kwizakhono ezahlukahlukeneyo eziza kuluxhobisa ngokufanayo kulwazi ngeengcingane nangokuphathwayo ukudala imisebenzi okanye bona ngokwabo nabanye abantu badale imisebenzi kuluntu lwabo.

src: Lolubanjiswano LwaHulumende Lovulekile kanye naHulumende Lovulekile nako kuyintfo lebalulekile letawusita umhlaba kutsi ucuze i-Ajenda yanga-2030 yeNtfutfuko Lechubekela Embili Ngalokungenamkhawulo.
tgt: Eli Ziko loLutsha luyiprojekthi esaLingwayo kwaye iyeyokuqala elolu hlobo kwaye liza kudluliselwa kwamanye amaphondo.7 Khabhinethi iyayamkela iNtlanganiso yoMmandla we-Afrika yoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo yowama-2016 ebibanjwe phantsi komxholo othi “UbuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo boPhuhliso obuZinzileyo e-Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kuCanzibe wowama-2016.Le ndibano iza emva kweenyanga ezisixhenxe uMzantsi Afrika wathi waba nguSihlalo oKhokelayo woBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo.

src: Lengcungcutsela yeSigodzi beyiyiNgcungcutsela yeSigodzi yeLubanjiswano Lwahulumende Lovulekile (i-OGP) lenkhulu kakhulu lehlelwe y-OGP lebenemiphumela lemikhulu yeseshini ngayinye kuyo yonkhe inkhomfa.
tgt: Imigomo yoburhulumente obuvulelekileyo ibaluleke kakhulu ekuphumezeni uludwe olubanzi lweenjongo eziphambili zophuhliso oluzinzileyo, ukuqhagamshelanisa okuvulekileyo kulawulo loorhulumente ukwenzela ukuphuculwa kwabahlelelekileyo nabahluphekileyo ehlabathini jikelele.

src: Ngokuhambisana nekutinikela kwabohulumende ekubambisaneni nakubuholi lobukahle, lengcugcutsela beyinebahlanganyeli labavela kuTinhlangano Temimango (ema-CSO) letehlukene temave emhlaba jikelele letimiselwe emimangweni emikhakheni leyehlukene ngaphandle kwema-CSO letayelekile labekaloku ayincenye yalolubanjiswano.8 IKhabhinethi iyakucaphela kuvunywa kuhlanganiswa kwetinkampani letintsatfu tekukhicita nekusabalalisa tinatfo temabhodlela kute kwakhiwe nkampani lenkhulu kakhulu kulelivekati yekukhicita nekusabalalisa tinatfo temabhodlela, iCoca-Cola Beverage Afrika.
tgt: UBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo nobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo bukwangundoqo ekuncedeni uluntu lwehlabathi ukuba lukwazi ukuphumeza i-Ajenda yowama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasemukela sivumelwane setimo talokufunwa ngummango salokuhlanganiswa lokusemkhatsini wahulumende nemcembu ekuhlangasiswa eCoca-Cola Beverages Africa lesekela lemitamo yetfu yemnotfo lomkhulu wetimboni.
tgt: Le Ngqungquthela yoMmandla ibe yeyona inkulu kwiingqungquthela zoMmandla zoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo (i-OGP) kwezakhe zaququzelelwa yi-OGP eneziphumo ezincomeka kakhulu kwisigaba ngasinye yade yayokuphela le ngqungquthela.

src: Lesivumelwane sivikela emazinga laphelele ekusebenta kulenkampani sikhatsi lesiminyaka lemitsatfu, sivikela tisebenti kuluphiko lwekubonisana ngemigomo nemibandzela yekudendwa emsebentini lokuphatselene nalokuhlanganiswa, sesekela inchubo yekusabalalisa ekhaya sibuye futsi sitinikele ekutfutfukiseni balimi labebancishwe ematfuba phambilini ngekwemlandvo kanye netfulitinsita balenkampani.
tgt: Ukugcina isibophelelo sikarhulumente kubudlelwane nolawulo lukarhulumente olungcono, le ngqungquthela ibe nomtsalane kubathathi-nxaxheba abavela kwiMibutho yoLuntu (i-CSO) evela ehlabathini jikelele emilisele kuluntu olukumacandelo awohlukahlukeneyo olungaphandle kwe-CSO yesiqhelo esoloko iyinxalenye yobu budlelwane.

src: Ngetulu kwaloko, tigidzi letinge-R400 setinikwe kutsi tisite ngemali kutfutfukiswa kwetinkampani kumkhakha wetekulima kwatsi futsi letinye tigidzi letinge- R400 lutjalomali lwekukhulisa kusabalaliswa lwemkhicito lovela kumacembu emkhicito kanye nemakhono ekutsengisa kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwemakhono lahambisana nako nekucecesha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukwamkelwa kwesivumelwano sokudibanisa amaziko amathathu kutha ebhotileni ukwenza elona ziko lokutha ebhotileni lakwaCoca- Cola Beverages Africa lakhe lasikhulu kweli lizwekazi.

src: I-Appletiser letsandvwa kakhulu itawuchubeka nekukhicitwa lapha eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano kwiimeko zeemfuno zoluntu kule ndibanisela phakathi kukarhulumente kunye noCoca-Cola Beverages Africa amaqela endibanisela anokuxhasa amalinge wethu wokuvulwa kwemizi-mveliso okukhulu kuqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Lesivumelwane sivula indzawo yefriji kuticandzisi takaCoca-Cola noma letinika batsengisi labatsengisa nantfu ngabanye: emaphesenti lalishumi atawuniketwa imikhicito letitsa kusuka kubakhiciti labancane etikhungweni tekutsengisela bantfu ngabanye lapho khona kuneticandzisi letiniketwa nguCoca-Cola.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sisikhuselo sabo bakwinqanaba lengqesho ekumyinge ophakathi kule nkampani ixesha elingangeminyaka emithathu sikhusela abasebenzi abakwinqanaba elisezantsi ukuba bangabi ngamaxhoba okudendwa okuhambelana nendibanisela, sixhasa ukusetyenziswa kwezinto zasekhaya kwinkqubo yokuthenga nokuthengisa nokuzibophelela ekuphuhliseni amafama aye sakuhleleleka nababoneleli-zinkonzo kule nkampani.

src: Loku kuvula iminyango kute kutsi kungene betemabhizinisi labasha kanye nalabasha labancane bemikhicito yetinatfo temabhodlela nekutisabalalisa, kusita kugwema tebhizinisi lenemkhawulo letenta kutsi emabhizinisi lamancane nalasemkhatsini avaleleke ngaphandle kwemakethe.
tgt: Ukongeza apho, imali ezizigidi ezingama-400 zeerandi iza kubonelela ukuxhasa ngezimali uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinane ekuqaleni kwemveliso yezolimo ide ibe yimveliso egqibeleleyo ize enye imali ezizigidi ezingama-400 eerandin aye ekunyusweni kutyalo-mali ukuphuhliswa ukubonelelwa kwemveliso abasebenzisi bayo kunye namandla eevenkile nophuhliso lwezakhono ezibandakanyekayo noqeqesho.

src: Kwengeta, lutjalomali lwesikhatsi lesidze lwalenkampani kulelive kutawentiwa kancano ngekusungulwa kwenhlokohhovisi yaletinkampani letihlanganisiwe eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Imveliso ye-Appletiser esele isaziwa kakhulu iseza kuqhubeka iveliswa eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Lesivumelwane silandzela sivumelwane lesisandza kwentiwa yi-Annhauser Beush InBev lesiphatselene nekutsengwa kwe-SAB Miller.
tgt: Esi sivumelwano sivulela indawo kwizikhenkcezi zakwaCoca-Cola kwiivenkile ezincinci: indawo eyi-10% ingasetyenziselwa ukufaka iimveliso ezikwafanayo ezivela kwivenkile ethengisa ngemiyinge emincinci kweli candelo leevenkile apho kukho khona izikhenkcezi zakwaCoca-Cola.

src: Inkakhulu, ekugcizeleleni kucasha, bendzawo kanye nekutfutfukisa emabhizinisi lamancane, letivumelwane tikhomba kubaluleka kwekusimamisa bemabhizinisi lahlanganisiwe kanye netindzaba temmango bese kubekwa lizinga lekusebenta kwetinkampani leticabanga ngekuhlanganiswa lokufanana naloku.9 IKhabhinethi ikucaphele kwetfulwa kwe-Mpact Polymers yetigidzi letinge-R350 tesakhiwonchanti selibhodlela ebhodleleni ekubambisaneni neCoca-Cola.
