src: Liphindze futsi linike indlela lephelele yekuvusetela kabusha tekuvakasha kulelive.
tgt: Ikwabonelela ngemephu yendlela yokubuyisela ngokupheleleyo ukhenketho elizweni.

src: Nanome Lisu Lekuvusetela Kabusha Tekuvakasha lasungulelwa kuchuba inchubo yekuvusetela kabusha lomkhakha, kugcina imisebenti kanye nekuvikela tindlela tekutiphilisa, leLisu Lelikhulu litawutsatsa lomsebenti liwubeke kulelinye lizinga futsi lichube ematfuba lamasha kulomkhakha.
tgt: Nangona iSicwangciso soBuyisela seCandelo lezoKhenketho saphuhliswa ukuququzelela ukuchacha ngcono kweli candelo, ukugcina imisebenzi kunye nokukhusela iindlela zokuphila, esi Sicwangciso siPhambili siya kuwuthatha lo msebenzi siwuse kwelinye inqanaba kwaye siququzelele amathuba amatsha kweli candelo.

src: Lelisu liphakamisa emasubuciko ekungelela lasikhombisa kucinisekisa kutsi umkhakha wetekuvakasha ubuyela etinsukwini tawo ngesikhatsi usaseyimphumelelo, nekutsi ube sizindza sekudala imisebenti nemabhizinisi.
tgt: Esi sicwangciso siphakamisa izicwangciso-qhinga zongenelelo ezisixhenxe ukuqinisekisa ukuba icandelo lezokhenketho libuyela kwiintsuku zalo zodumo, kwanokuba libe liziko lokudala imisebenzi kunye noshishino.

src: Imboni yetekuvakasha ineligalelo lelimcoka kutemnotfo futsi yesekela imisebenti lenge-725 000 ngembikwalolubhubhane lwe-COVID-19.Imitsetfosivivinyo.
tgt: Ishishini lezokhenketho linegalelo elibalulekileyo kuqoqosho kwaye lalixhase imisebenzi engama-725 000 phambi kobhubhani we-COVID-19.

src: Inyanga Yetekutfutsa kulonyaka itawukhunjulwa ngaphasi kwengcikitsi letsi: “Siyakha – Sakha sakhiwonchanti lesincono kute sikhulise iNingizimu Afrika.”.

src: Lusuku Lwemhlaba Lwabothishela.
tgt: Usuku looTitshala lweHlabathi.

src: INingizimu Afrika itawuhlanganyela nemhlaba wonkhe ekugubheni Lusuku Lwabothishela Lwemhlaba ngaLesine, mhla ti-5 Imphahla 2023, ngaphasi lwengcikitsi letsi: “Bothishela lesibadzingako bemfundvo lesiyifunako: Sibopho semhlaba wonkhe sekubuyisela emuva kweswelakala kabothishela.” Lolusuku kucondvwe ngalo kucaphelisa, kuvisisa nekudvumisa ligalelo lelimcoka labothishela labalifakako kutemfundvo kanye nentfutfuko emhlabeni wonkhe.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uza kujoyina ihlabathi liphela ekubhiyozeleni uSuku looTitshala lweHlabathi ngoLwesine, umhla wesi-5 kweyeDwarha 2023, phantsi komxholo othi: “Ootitshala esibadingayo kwimfundo esiyifunayo: Kunyanzelekile kwihlabathi jikelele ukunciphisa ukunqongophala kootitshala”.

src: Lolusuku lumenyetelwe ngekuhlanganyela Inhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yetebasebenti neNhlangano Yetemfundvo, Yetesayensi Nemasiko yaMhlabuhlangene ngenhloso yekugubha umsebenti lomcoka lowentiwa bothishela betfu.
tgt: Olu suku lujolise ekukhuliseni ulwazi, ukuqonda kunye nokuxabisa igalelo elibaluleke kakhulu elenziwa ngootitshala kwimfundo nakuphuhliso kwihlabathi jikelele.

src: ImilayetoKuhalaliselaIkhabhinethi ihalalisela iphindze futsi ifisele tilokotfo letinhle ku:Jenene Bheki Cele, Indvuna Yetemaphoyisa, loklonyeliswe nge-Great Wall Commemorative Medal yaseRiphabhliki yaseShayina ngeligalelo lelifakwe Luphiko Lwetemaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika ngekucinisekisa kugcinwa kwemtsetfo ngalokubanti emkhatsini walamave WEBTOKEAngie Motshekga, Indvuna Yetemfundvo Lesisekelo, ngekukhetfwa nguMabhalane Jikelele waMhlabuhlangene Mnu Antonio Guterres, kutsi atewusebenta kuPhaneli Yemhlaba Wonkhe Lesezingeni Lelisetulu kute atemeluleka ngekutsi emave kufanele kutsi atigucule njani tinhlelo tawo tetemfundvo.
tgt: Olu suku lubhengezwe ngokubambisene noMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi kunye noMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye neNkcubeko ukubhiyozela umsebenzi obalulekileyo owenziwa ngootitshala bethu.

src: Kukhetfwa kweNdvuna Motshekga kutsi angene kulephaneli lesezingeni leliphakeme kukhombisa lizinga lakhe lebungcweti emkhakheni wetemfundvo futsi kuyinkhomba yekwetsemba indlela yetemfundvo yelive laseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: ImiyalezoAmazwi okuvuyisanaIKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi okuvuyisana kunye neminqweno emihle kwaba:UNjengele Bheki Cele, uMphathiswa wamaPolisa, ofumene iMbasa ye-Great Wall Commemorative evela e-People’s Republic of China ngegalelo leNkonzo yamaPolisa oMzantsi Afrika kwintsebenziswano ebanzi yokuthotyelwa komthetho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.

src: Lephaneli ifaka ekhatsi labamelele Inhlangano Yemave Emhlaba Yebasebenti, neNhlangano Yetemfundvo, Yetesayensi Nemasiko yaMhlabuhlangene Yabothishela Yemsebenti Lotsite, Tinyonyana Temhlaba Wonkhe Tabothishela kanye neTindvuna letintsatfu temfundvo.
tgt: UNks Angie Motshekga, uMphathiswa weMfundo esiSiseko, ekukhethweni kwakhe nguNobhala-Jikelele we-UN, uMnu Antonio Guterres, ukuba asebenze kwi-Global High-Level Panel ukumcebisa ngendlela amazwe angaziguqula ngayo iinkqubo zawo zemfundo.

src: KuTitjudiyo Temafilimu taseKapa, balingisi bendzawo kanye nemaciko laceceshiwe, ngemisebenti yabo kuluchungechunge lwe-Netflix, leluthi-One Piece leluphume embili emhlabeni wonkhe letisakatwa etinkhundleni te-inthanethi.
tgt: Ukukhethwa kukaMphathiswa u-Motshekga kwiphaneli yomgangatho ophezulu kubonisa inqanaba lobuchule bakhe kwinkalo yezemfundo kwaye kubonakalisa ukuthemba indlela eqhuba ngayo imfundo yaseMzantsi Afrika.

src: Ku-Van Ryn's Distillery, ngekutsi aklonyeliswe ngendzebe Yenkhantini Yemhlaba Lephume Embili ngenkhantini leneminyaka le-12 ibiliswa ku-2023 International Spirits Challenge lapha eLondon.
tgt: Le phaneli ibandakanya abameli abavela kuMbutho weHlabathi wezaBasebenzi, uMbutho waMazwe aManyaneyo ezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi kunye nezeNkcubeko, i-Teacher Task Force, uManyano looTishala kwiHlabathi jikelele (i-Global Teachers Union) kunye nabaPhathiswa abathathu bezemfundo.

src: A. Tindzaba Letibalulekile Talelive Tihlabani Tendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco Yanga-2023 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele Emabhokobhoko ngekuphumelela kutsatsa Indzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco yanga-2023 leyenta kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ngilo lodvwa live lelitsetse Lendzebe Yemhlaba Yelibhola Lembhoco emahlandla lamane nekutsi litsatse lendzebe tikhatsi letimbili ngekulandzelana.
tgt: Imiba enguNdaba-mlonyeni IiNtshatsheli zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 IKhabhinethi ivuyisene neqela lama-Springboks kwimpumelelo yalo yeNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo yama-2023 eyenze ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilizwe ekukuphela kwalo ukuphumelela iNdebe yoMhlaba yeBhola yoMbhoxo amaxesha amane (4) kunye nelesibini ukuyiphumelela amaxesha elandelelana.

src: Emlandvweni welibhola lembhoco, lelicembu leMabhokobhoko ngilona libhice tinhlanga letehlukene kunawo onkhe emacembu ngekwebuhlanga bebantfu labakhona eNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: Kwimbali yebhola yombhoxo eMzantsi Afrika, eli qela le-Springboks lelona lineyantlukwano ngokwentlanga eMzantsi Afrika.

src: Kuhlanganiswa kwalelicembu lelibhice kangaka akuzange kumane kwenteke nje, kepha kwaba yimitamo leyentiwa ngulabaphetse kanye netisebenti leticecesha lelicembu leMabhokobhoko yekutsi bakhetse licembu lelifaka bantfu labehlukene.
tgt: Ukwakhiwa kweqela elineyantlukwano enjalo ibingesosenzo sebhaqo, kodwa ibingumzamo wangabom wabaphathi kunye nabasebenzi abaqeqeshayo be-Springboks abaye bakhetha iqela eliquka zonke iintlanga.

src: Leso sincumo semceceshi Rassie Erasmus nelicembu lakhe lesabonisa kuba nesibindzi siyachubeka kubonisa takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika kanye nemhlaba wonkhe kwekutsi wonkhe umuntfu lonelikhono, uma anikwa litfuba nekusekelwa, angaba mkhulu - lokusiciniseko sekutsi Sinemandla Lamakhulu Uma Sihlangene.
tgt: Eso sigqibo sokuthatha umngcipheko somqeqeshi welo xesha u-Rassie Erasmus kunye neqela lakhe sisaqhuba ukubonisa abantu baseMzantsi Afrika kunye nehlabathi ngokubanzi, ukuba wonke umntu onesakhono, xa enikwe ithuba nenkxaso, angagqwesa – oku kusisiqiniseko sokuba soMelele xa Sikunye.

src: Lokumcoka kakhulu, kucina nekutimisela kweMabhokobhoko enkhundleni yemdlalo kucuketse liciniso leliyingcikitsi yebuve baseNingizimu Afrika, loko lokwenta lelive lelihle kangaka liphakame limelane nebumatima kuze baphumelele bancobe.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukunyamezela kunye nokuzimisela kwe-Springboks kwibala lezemidlalo ngumfuziselo wokuba ngumNtu waseMzantsi Afrika wokwenene, oko okwenza ukuba esi sizwe sikhulu kangaka silwe noloyiso nangona sijongene neenzingo, ekugqibeleni siphume soyisile.

src: Labanye bebadlali balelicembu leMabhokobhoko kubite kutsi bamelane netitsa lebetisendleleni yabo yekuphumelela.
tgt: Abathile kwabona badlali bagqwesileyo beli qela le-Springboks kuye kwafuneka endleleni yabo ebhekise empumelelweni boyise iinzingo zobomi babo.

src: IKhabhinethi iphumisele kuhalalisa kwayo kuSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, longukapteni weMabhokobhoko Lotsetse Indzebe Yemhlaba kabili ngekuhola licembu lelibe kulelizinga lelibitwa nge-Greatest Of All Time (GOAT), lekungako lemigubho kumele ichubeke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuvuyisana kwayo noSiyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, ikapteni ebikhokele i-Springboks iqela eliphumelele iNdebe yeHlabathi kabini ngokulandelelana de labe lifikelela kwiwonga lokuba liqela eliphambili elake Laba liKhulu ngeXesha lalo i-Greatest of All Time (i-GOAT) mayiqhube ke imibhiyozo.

src: Umhlangano we-AGOA IKhabhinethi isemukele sincumo sebaphatsi beMerikha kanye nemhlangano ngekuba nenhloso yekwelula sikhatsi se-AGOA, lokuyintfo leletsa sicinisekiso kubahlanyeli betimali kulawo mave lavumelekile ku-AGOIKhabhinethi beyiphindze yakwemukela kutsi leli lisingatse uMhlangano we-AGOA wanga-2023 eJozi kusukela mhlaka-2 kuya ku-4 kuLweti wanga-2023, lobenetihambi letivela emaveni langu-32 ase-Afrika letifaka ekhatsi bohulumende, bosomabhizinisi, umphakatsi wonkana kanye nekwekucala nalabamele tisebenti kanye nalabamele hulumende waseMerikha.
tgt: I-Forum ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi isamkele isiqinisekiso esisuka kulawulo lwase-United States kunye nenkongolo esimalunga nenjongo yokolula i-AGOA, nto leyo izisa isiqinisekiso kuluntu lotyalomali kumazwe afanelekileyo ukuxhamla kwi-AGOKanajalo iKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukusingathwa kwe-forum ye-AGOA yama-2023 ebibanjelwe e-Johannesburg ngomhla we-2 ukuya mhla we-4 kweyeNkanga 2023 nebizinyaswe ngabathathi nxaxheba abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika angama-32 avela kurhulumente, uShishino, uluntu ngokubanzi kunye nabezemisebenzi ebebehambele lo msitho okokuqala kuquka kunye nabameli bakarhulumente wase-United States.

src: IKhabhinethi beyikadze ikuphakamisa kwekutsi i-AGOA iniketa litfuba lekutsi iMerikha icinise budlelwane bayo ne-Afrika kutemnotfo nekutsi ngaloko kumele ikuchubekise sikhatsi leseluliwe, nekutsi iciniswe kuze ibe nemiphumela futsi igcame.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isoloko ikuqinisekisa ukuba i-AGOA ibonelela i-United States of America ngethuba lokomeleza ubudlelwane bayo bezoqoqosho ne-Afrika yiloo nto ke kufuneka le AGOA yolulwe ukuze ibenethuba eloneleyo lokuthela iziqhamo, kwaye yenziwe luqilima ukuze ibe neempembelelo ezintle kananjalo ibenawo nomtsalane.

src: Umhlangano WeTindvuna te-BRICS kuTekuvakasha IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kuphetfwa kweMhlangano We-2023 BRICS WeTindvuna KuTekuvakasha lobe yimphumelelo, lobewubanjelwe e-Cape Town, lapho emave layincenye yalenhlangano atibophelele ekubambisaneni lokujulile kanye nekutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kwe-BRICS, kusungula imizila letawutfutfukisa kuvakashelana kancono nekuchumana kwemave layincenye yalenhlangano.
tgt: INtlanganiso yobaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqukunjelwa ngempumelelo kweNtlanganiso yabaPhathiswa bezoKhenketho be-BRICS yama-2023 ebibanjelwe eKapa, apho amazwe angamalungu azibophelele kwintsebenziswano enzulu kunye nasekukhuthazeni ukhenketho phakathi kwi-BRICS, ukuphuhlisa iindlela zokuhamba nonxulumano phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Loku kutawucinisa umkhakha wetekuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika losewuvele ubonisa timphawu tekuvuseteleka.
tgt: Oku kuza komeleza nangakumbi icandelo lezokhenketho laseMzantsi Afrika esele libonisa iimpawu zokuvuka ke noko.

src: Etinyangeni letingu-8 tekucala kulomnyaka wa-2023, lelive libe netivakashi letingu-5.5 wetigidzi letifikile, loku yinkhulo lengu-63.4% uma kucatsaniswa nesikhatsi lesifanako emnyakeni wa-2022.
tgt: Kwiinyanga ezisi-8 zokuqala zika-2023, ilizwe lamkele i-5.5 yezigidi zabantu abafikayo oko okubonakalise ukonyuka ngama-63.4% xa kuthelekiswa neli thuba linye lango-2022.

src: Kubhalisela Kuvota I-IEC seyimemetele imphelasontfo yekucala mhlaka-18 na 19 kuLweti 2023 kutsi ibe yekubhalisela Kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024.
tgt: UkuBhalisela ukuVota I-IEC yabhengeza umhla we-18 nowe-19 kweyeNkanga 2023 njengempelaveki yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhutsata bonkhe labavunyelwe kuvota kutsi babhalisele kuvota Elukhetfweni Lwavelonkhe lwa-2024 etindzaweni tekuvota lesitedvute.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuba babhalisele ukuvota kuNyulo Jikelele luka-2024 kwizikhululo zokuvota ezikufutshane nabo.

src: Kubhalisa nge-intanethi kwebavoti kwavulwa kusukela ngeNdlovana 2023 futsi takhamuti tiyakhutsatwa kutsi tisebentise letinsita kuze babhalise noma balungise imininingwane yabo.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota nge-intanethi kuvulwe ukususela ngeyoMdumba wama-2023 kwaye abemi bayabongozwa ukuba basebenzise esi sibonelelo ukubhalisa okanye ukuhlaziya iinkcukacha zabo.

src: Takhamuti taseNingizimu Afrika letifake ticelo tema-ID tiyakhutsatwa nato kutsi tivakashele emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya kuyowalandza.
tgt: Abantu baseMzantsi Afrika abafake izicelo zabo zee-ID bayakhuthazwa ukuba bazilande ngokuthi batyelele i-Ofisi yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya.

src: Kunema-ID langemakhadi langetulu kweti-500 000 lasolo angakalandvwa emaHhovisi Elitiko Letasekhaya eveni lonkhe.
tgt: Angaphezulu kwama-500 000 amakhadi ee-ID ekusafuneka ukuba ayolandwa kwii-ofisi zeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya elizweni ngokubanzi.

src: Gezi Indvuna leseHhovisi LaMengameli lephetse lindzaba taGezi ikhulume kabanti nesive ngesimo sagezi eveni.
tgt: Umbane UMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli onoxanduva lokujonga imicimbi yezoMbane unike amagqabantshintshi abanzi ngemeko yombane elizweni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyidvumisile imitamo yaHulumende Wesifundza se-Gauteng losebenta ne-Eskom kulungisa gezi etindzaweni letise-Gauteng lebetihlushwa kuhamba kwagezi ngenca yekubiwa noma kubhidlita ema-transformer.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqhwabele izandla iinzame zikaRhulumente wePhondo lase-Gauteng zokusebenza ne-Eskom ukubuyisela umbane kwimimandla yase-Gauteng ebithwaxwa kukucima kombane ngenxa yokwebiwa okanye umonakalo kwizixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane.

src: Ebusuku bayitolo, kukhanyiswe ema-transformer agezi lasitfupha eKagiso, lese-West Rand emva kwekutsi takhamuti takhona tihleli ngaphandle kwagezi iminyaka lengetulu kwalemitsatfu.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, kuye kwalayitwa izixhobo ezihambisa amandla ombane ezithandathu eKagiso, kummandla weNtshona Randi emva kokuba uluntu lwashiyeka lungenambane isithuba esingaphezulu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: IKhabhinethi imema lemiphakatsi kutsi ivikele letakhiwo ekubiweni, kumoshwa kanye nemonakalo lokubangwa kokhela gezi ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema olu luntu ukuba luzikhusele iziseko zophuhliso ezibalulekileyo ekwebiweni, ekonakalisweni kunye nomonakalo obangelwa luqhagamshelo olungekho mthethweni.

src: Kudla lokunebutsi IKhabhinethi ikhatsatekile ngakuvama kwekutsi bantfwana badle kudla lokunebutsi ngoba badla kudla losekudlulelwe sikhatsi, nalokonakele lokutsengiswa etipaza nasetitaladini.
tgt: UkuTyhefeka kokuTya IKhabhinethi ixhalabile yindlela ekonyuke ngayo iziganeko zabantwana abatya ityhefu ngenxa yokutya ukutya okuphelelwe lixesha kunye nokutya okungcolisekileyo kwasespaza kunye nokwabathengisi basesitalatweni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakhutsateka ngemitamo yebemtsetfo kucinisa tekuphepha nekulandzelwa kwemigomo yekudla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthazwa ziinzame ezenziwa ngabanyanzelisi bomthetho zokunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kokhuseleko ekutyeni.

src: Umhlangano Wekucecesha Kutfutsela Kulamanye Emave Nebaholi Bemadolobha kanye Nebendzabuko IKhabhinethi yatjelwa kafishane ngalomhlangano wekucecesha lowabanjwa Litiko Letasekhaya nalowahanjelwa yi-DSBD, i-COGTA, Litiko Letekuhlaliswa Kwebantfu kanye nebaholi bendzabuko, nebaholi bemadolobha labaphuma kubomasipala bemadolobha kanye netigodzi, lebewubuka tindlela tekuncandvwa kwemiphumela yekungena eveni ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, lokufaka ekhatsi kusebenta kwetipaza.
tgt: INtlanganiso yeeNgxoxo nooSodolophu kunye neenkokeli zeMveli ngeMfuduko yeHlabathi IKhabhinethi yanikwa amagqabantshintshi malunga nentlanganiso yeengxoxo ngemfuduko yehlabathi eyayisingethwe liSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya ngothatho nxaxheba lwe-DSBD, i-COGTA, iSebe leeNdawo zokuHlaliswa kwabaNtu kunye neenkokeli zemveli noosodolophu abavela koomasipala abambhaxa kunye nabezithili eyayijolise ekunqandeni iziphumo zemfuduko engekho mthethweni, kuquka noshishino lwezipaza.

src: Imiphumela lesembili ifaka ekhatsi kucalwa kweluchungechunge lwetichibelo temitsetfo yekubukana netingcinamba letiphatselene nekutsi bomasipala kanye netiphatsimandla tendzabuko bacinise tichibelo temitsetfo yemabhizinisi.
tgt: Iziphumo ezingundoqo ziquka ukwaziswa kwemithetho equka konke kamasipala ukuze ithathele ingqalelo imingeni enxulumene nokunyanzeliswa kokusetyenziswa kwemithetho yendawo inyanzeliswa ngoomasipala kunye nabasemagunyeni kulawulo lwemveli.

src: Kutawuba khona kuhlolwa kwemabhizinisi, ikakhulu tipaza ngulabaphuma ematiko etekusebenta, temphilo, kusungulwa kwemabhizinisi lamancane kanye nemacembu ebahloli beLitiko Letasekhaya, khona kutawucinisa kulandzelwa kwemigomo ngekusebentisa imitsetfo lefanele.
tgt: Kuza kubakho uhlolo nophando olukhawulezileyo oluza kuqhutywa ngokuhlanganyelweyo lokujonga ukusetyenziswa kwemithetho yamashishini, ingakumbi izipaza lisebe lezemisebenzi, elezempilo, elophuhliso lwamashishini amancinci kunye namaqela ahlola imfuduko eSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya, ukunyanzelisa ukuthotyelwa kwemithetho elindelekileyo kumashishini.

src: Kutawentiwa luphenyo lwetipaza etindzaweni tasemakhaya kanye nasemalokishini, lokuhambisana netindlela tekutsi tibhaliswe lokutawentiwa baholi bendzabuko kanye nabomasipala.
tgt: Ukuphicothwa kwezipaza ezilalini nasezilokishini, kunye neendlela zokuzibhalisa ezingasetyenziswa ziinkokeli zemveli kunye noomasipala nako kuza kwenziwa.

src: Kuphindze kube khona nemitamo yekusekela tiphatsimandla tendzabuko kwekutsi bagcine luhlu lalabaphuma kulamanye emave emiphakatsini yabo.
tgt: Kukwakho neenzame zokuxhasa oogunyaziwe bemveli ukuba bagcine uluhlu lwamagama abemi bangaphandle kwiindawo abahlala kuzo.

src: Imitsetfo yekubhaliswa kwemabhizinisi nayo iyaguculwa kuze kusekelwe bonkhe labo labafuna kutsengisa kulomkhakha wekutisebentela.
tgt: Kulungiswa umthetho wokunikwa kwelayisenisi kumashishini ngelo kuxhasa bonke abo banqwenela ukurhweba kwicandelo lweshishini elingekho sikweni.

src: Kulwa Nebugebengu Lokuhlangahlangene IKhabhinethi iyayincoma i-SAPS ngekuncandza ngemandla kwalabo lababambisana ngekutsengiswa kwetidzakamiva lokulandzela kutfolakala kwe-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letingu-80 leyatsatfwa mhlaka-20 kuMphala 2023 endzaweni yekugcina imphahla e-Dube Trade Port ngekhatsi kweSikhumulo Setindiza I-King Shaka.
tgt: UMlo woLwaphulomthetho oHlanganyelweyo IKhabhinethi iyincomile i-SAPS ngokufumana iqela elithubelezisa iziyobisi kumazwe angaphandle kulandela ukufunyanwa kwe-cocaine exabisa ama-R80 ezigidi ebanjwe ngowama-20 kweyeDwarha 2023 kumzi wokugcina impahla i-Dube Trade Port kwisikhululo seenqwelomoya i-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Emalangeni lamabili landvulela kutsatfwa kwaletidzakamiva, kwatsatfwa lenye i-cocaine lengabita emarandi latigidzi letinge-70 kukhonteyina eSikhumulweni Semikhumbi eThekwini.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini eziphambi koku, kubanjwe enye i-cocaine exabisa ama-R70 ezigidi kwiZibuko laseThekwini.

src: IKhabhinethi ishaya tandla ngemsebenti we-SAPS wekuphatamisa nekuhliphitwa kwetinhlelo tebugebengu emkhatsini wemave lokumisa kabi kakhulu imiphakatsi yetfu kanye nesive.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqhwabela izandla i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wayo ekuphazamiseni kunye nasekunqandeni ulwaphulomthetho oluququzelelweyo lwamazwe amaninzi olusisigrogriso esikhulu kwiindawo zethu esihlala kuzo nakwisizwe siphela.

src: Umkhankaso lobitwa nge-Operation Safer Festive Season wetekuphepha ngesikhatsi semaholide sewuvele uveta titselo ngoba emaphoyisa sekabophe basolwa labangu-140, lebafaka ekhatsi longungcondvongcondvo wekumbiwa kwetimayini ngalokungekho emtsetfweni, nangekutsatsa tibhamu letingenawo emalayisensi.
tgt: IPhulo le-Operation Safer Festive Season sele liveza iziphumo ngamapolisa abambe ngaphezulu kwe-140 yabarhanelwa, kuquka norhanelwa ngokuba ngungqondongqondo ekumbiweni kwemigodi okungekho mthethweni, kunye nokuthathwa kwemipu engenazilayisenisi.

src: Luhambo Lwamengameli Lwekuyohlola Kuchubeka Kwemsebenti
tgt: UTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uTyelelo lukaMongameli lokuyoKhangela Ukuqhubekeka koMsebenzi kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni, obelulandelela ukujonga iziphumo zothetha-thethwano zendibano noluntu elalibanjwe ngo-2022 kwiNkqubo yoPhuhliso lweZithili.

src: .IKhabhinethi ikwemukele Kuhambela kwaMongameli welive kuMasipala wase-Emfuleni lwekuyohlola kuchubeka kwemsebenti, lobekulandzelela emva kwetingcoco letabakhona nemphakatsi ngesikhatsi sekuchutjwa kweLuhlelo Lekutfutfukisa Tigodzi (i-DDM) nga-2022.
tgt: Utyelelo luka-2022 Emfuleni lwachonga imiba yokungalungiswa kakuhle kweziseko zophuhliso ngumasipala.

src: Kuvakashela e-Emfuleni nga-2022 kwaveta tingcinamba tekugcinwa kwesakhiwonchanti ngumasipala.
tgt: Ngongenelelo lweSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kube khona inkqubela ebonakalayo ekuthatheleni ingqalelo imingeni yeziseko zophuhliso zamanzi nezogutyulo ekhokelele ekuweni kwenkqubo ye-Vaal Waste Water.

src: .Ngekungenelela kweLitiko Letemanti Netekuhlanta, kwaba nenchubekela embili leyabonakala ekubukeni tingcinamba letiphatselene netakhiwonchanti temanti kanye nekuhlanta letabangela kungasebenti kwe-Vaal Water Waste.
tgt: Sowuqalile umsebenzi wokuphukcula unikezelo lwamanzi, ukusebenza ngokufanelekileyo kweziseko zophuhliso zamanzi amdaka kwaye oko kuphelisa ingxaki yemibhobho ehambisa amanzi amdaka ebesele egxagxaza ezitalatweni nakwiiyadi zabantu.

src: Kunemisebenti leseyentiwe kutfutfukisa kwabiwa kwemanti, kusebenta kahle kwetakhiwonchanti temanti langcolile kanye nekucedvwa kwenkinga yemangcoliso lagijima etitaladini nasemabaleni etakhamuti.
tgt: Inkqubela eqatshelweyo kolu tyelelo iquka uphuculo kwimibhobho yamanzi emininzi kunye nakwizikhululo zeempompo zamanzi, ukulungiswa ngaphezulu kunye nokutywinwa kweendlela, kunye nokufakwa ngobuninzi kwezibane zasesitalatweni ngelokuphucula ukukhanya nokhuseleko.

src: Inchubekela embili leyabonakala ngesikhatsi salokuvakasha ifaka ekhatsi kuphuculwa kwemaphayiphi kanye netiteshi tekufutsa emanti lamaningi, kulungiswa nekuchitjelwa kwemigwaco, kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwekukhanyisa nekuphepha ngekutsi kufakwe emalambu etitaladini.
tgt: ISicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika ISebe lezoThutho liqalise iindibano kwiSicwangciso seNkqubo yoThutho lweMpahla eMzantsi Afrika, njengenxenye yamanyathelo okuthathela ingqalelo imingeni ejongene necandelo lokuthuthwa kwempahla kunye nokomelezwa kweenzame zokubuyiselwa koqoqosho eMzantsi Afrika.

src: INkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika Litiko Letekutfutsa selicale tinkhulumo letimayelana neNkhombandlela Yenchubo Yetekutfutfwa Kwemphahla eNingizimu Afrika, lokuyincenye yetaba tekubhekana netingcinamba letibukene nemkhakha wetekutfutsa nekuhanjiswa kwemphahla kanye nekuciniswa kwemitamo yekuvusetela umnotfo waseNingizimu Afrika.
tgt: UPhuhliso nokuGcinwa kweziSeko zoPhuhliso IKhabhinethi iyamkele inkqubela eyenziweyo ngophuhliso kunye nokugcinwa kweziseko zophuhliso ngokugqitywa kweebhulorho zasezilalini ezingama-36 phantsi kwenkqubo yeWelisizwe Rural Bridges, kunye nokwakhiwa okuqalayo kweeprojekthi ezingama-20 kwiindawo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu, iindlela, namanzi.

src: Kutfutfukiswa Nekugcinwa Kwetakhiwonchanti IKhabhinethi iyemukele inchubekela embili leyentiwa kutfutfukiswa kanye nekugcinwa kwetakhiwonchanti ngekutsi kuphetfwe kwakhiwa kwemabhuloho langu-36 etindzaweni tasemaphandleni ngephasi kwemkhankaso i-Welisizwe Rural Bridges, kanye nekwakhiwa lokusachubeka kwemiklamo lengu-20 yetekuhlaliswa kwebantfu, imigwaco, kanye nemanti.
tgt: UkuPhehlelelwa ngokuTsha kweendlela zehlabathi zeQumrhu leeNqwelomoya loMzantsi Afrika (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuphehlelelwa ngokutsha kweendlela zehlabathi ze-SAA ngokubuyiswa ngokutsha kwehambo yayo yenqwelomoya ehamba phakathi kwamazwekazi eya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, ephawule kananjalo ukubuya kwenkonzo ehamba ihambo ende esuka eKapa nase-Johannesburg.

src: Kubuyiselwa Kwemizila Yekuya Kulamanye Emave Kwe-South African Airways (i-SAA) IKhabhinethi ikwemukele kubuyiselwa kwemizila yekundizela kulamanye emave kwe-SAA ngekutsi kuphindze kucalwe tindiza emkhatsini welivekati kuya e-São Paulo, e-Brazil, lokukhombise kubuya kwemizila lemidze lesuka e-Cape Town kanye naseJozi.
tgt: Ukubuyela kwe-SAA kwiindlela zehlabathi kuza kufaka isandla ngqo ekuqhubeni ukukhula kokusetyenziswa kwezithuthi ezihamba kweli lizwe, kunye nokukhula kwecandelo lezokhenketho emva kokuba ligqugqiswe ngubhubhane we-COVID-19.

src: Lokubuyela kuletindlela tekundizela kulamanye emave kutawufaka sandla ekuphakamiseni kukhula kwekuhambela kwalamanye emave kuleli, kanye nekukhula kwemkhakha wetekuvakasha kulandzela umonakalo lowadalwa yi-COVID-19.
tgt: UMzantsi Afrika uphehlelela eyona drone inkulu e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ivuyisene noMkhosi kunye nenkampani yobuchwepheshe bokubhabha emoyeni kweenqwelomoya i-Milkor ngokuphehlelela kwabo ngempumelelo i-Milkor 380 okusisithuthi esizihambelayo emoyeni (i-UAV), oku kubeka uMzantsi Afrika phakathi kwamazwe aqhubayo ukwenza imitsi emide kubuchwepheshe beenqwelomoya ezizihambela emoyeni ii-drone.

src: INingizimu Afrika isungula idroni lenkhulu kunawo wonkhe e-Afrika IKhabhinethi ihalalisele inkampani yaka-Milkor yeTekuvikela kanye netekundiza, ngekuphumelela kusungula I-Milkor 380, lekuyindizamshini lengashayelwa ngumuntfu, leyente kutsi iNingizimu Afrika ibalwe kanye nalamanye emave lachubeka ngemandla kutebuchwepheshe bemadroni.
tgt: I-Milkor 380 yeyona drone inkulu eyakhiwe e-Afrika kwaye iza kusetyenziswa licandelo lezokhuselo ngeenjongo zokulwa, ulawulo lomda, ulondolozo lwendalo kuquka nokulwa ukuzingela okungekho mthethweni.

src: Le-Milkor 380 yidroni lenkhulu kunawo onkhe lekakhiwe e-Afrika futsi itawusetjentiswa kuhlasela ngumkhakha wetekuvikela, kulawula imincele, nemitamo yekonga imvelo lefaka ekhatsi kuncandza kutingela ngalokungekho emtsetfweni.
tgt: Iimviwo zeMatriki kunye nezokuphela konyaka ezikolweni IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuqala kakuhle kweemviwo zeSatifiketi esiPhezulu seSizwe (iMatriki) zama-2023, eziqale ngowama-30 kweyeDwarha 2023.

src: Batali kanye nebagcini bayakhutsatwa kwekutsi bachubeke kusekela bafundzi ngalesikhatsi lesimcoka kangaka.
tgt: Abazali nabagcini babantwana bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhubeleke nokuxhasa abafundi ngeli xesha libaluleke kangaka.

src: Tincumo teKhabhinethi Simo SasePalestine IKhabhinethi ijabhile ngekutsi hulumende we-Israyeli ale kuhlonipha umtsetfo wemave nekuchubeka kucekela phasi tincumo teNhlangano Yamhlabuhlangene tekumisa kulwa ngaphandle kwekujeziswa.
tgt: Izigqibo zeKhabhinethi IMeko yase-Palestine Idanile iKhabhinethi kukwala kukarhulumente wakwaSirayeli ukuthobela umthetho wehlabathi kunye nokuqhubeka kwayo ijongela phantsi izigqibo zeZizwe eziManyeneyo zigqibo ezo ezifuna kubekwe phantsi izikhali ngaphandle kokohlwaywa.

src: Imizila yekuletsa lusito kubantfu basePalestine solo ivaliwe, intfo lenemiphumela lemibi kubantfwana, basikati kanye netakhamuti letingenacala.
tgt: Iindlela zokunika uncedo kubantu base-Palestine zisavaliwe kuza neziphumo ezimbi ebantwaneni, abasetyhini nabemi abangenatyala.

src: Lokugadla ngetindiza kwahulumende we-Israyeli lokucotfula bantfu basePalestine, kuyachubeka kantsi nesibalo salabafile lokufaka ekhatsi basikati nebantfwana siyenyuka.
tgt: Uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olubulala abantu ngobuninzi olwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine, luyaqhuba lubonakala ngamanani okusweleka kwabantu anyukayo aquka abasetyhini nabantwana.

src: Kulamalanga lamabili ledlulile, umhlaba bewumile ubuka ungakhoni kwenta lutfo ngekugadla emoyeni lokunemandla eGaza naseWest Bank lokubhubhise tikolwa, takhiwo temphilo, ema-ambulensi kanye netakhiwo teluntfu kanye nemigwaco lekutsiwa iphephile kuya eNingizimu neGaza.
tgt: Kwiintsuku ezimbini ezidlulileyo, ihlabathi liye lahlala lijongile nje kungekhonto linokuyenza, njengoko uhlaselo lwasemoyeni olonyukayo lwase-Gaza nase-West Bank lutshabalalise izikolo, izibonelelo zempilo, iinqwelo zezigulane neziseko zophuhliso zabantu kunye nezo ndlela kuthiwa zikhuselekile eziya kuMzantsi we-Gaza.

src: Ngenca yaloku, iKhabhinethi itsetse sincumo sekubita bonkhe labaseTel Aviv labamele lelive kuze bacocisane.
tgt: Ngenxa yoku, iKhabhinethi igqibe ekubeni ibuyise bonke oonozakuzaku baseMzantsi Afrika abase-Tel Aviv ukuze kudityanwe nabo.

src: IKhabhinethi iphindze yakubona kuchubeka kwetinkhulumo letinetinshanshu talolincusa le-Israyeli kuleli, Mnz.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iziqaphele kananjalo ngokukhathazeka izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezenziwa ngunozakuzaku wakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika, uMnu Eliav Belotsercovsky, ezibhekisele kubantu baseMzantsi Afrika, ubunkokeli baseMzantsi Afrika kuquka uluntu ekuhlaleni oluthetha phandle ngokubulawa ngobuninzi kwabantu okwenziwa ngurhulumente wakwaSirayeli ebantwini base-Palestine.

src: Eliav Belotsercovsky, lebekatibhekise kutakhamuti teNingizimu Afrika, nakubaholi beNingizimu Afrika labakuhulumende kanye nangaphandle kwakhe, lokufaka ekhatsi imibutfo yeluntfu lekhuluma lokuphambene nalokubhujiswa kwebantfu basePalestine lokwentiwa nguhulumende we-Israyeli.
tgt: Ezi zimvo zinyhatshayo zikaNozakuzaku Belotsercovsky ziyaphikiswa ziingxelo zabo babengoonozakuzaku bakwaSirayeli eMzantsi Afrika ababini (u-Illan Baruch noGqr Alon Liel) abo babengangungqi ekuchazeni izenzo zikarhulumente wabo ezichasene nabantu base-Palestine njengezenzo zengcindezelo.

src: Letinkhulumo teLincusa Belotsercovisky letinekucekela phasi ticatsaniswa nalokwaphawulwa ngulabake baba ngemancusa e-Israyeli kuleli (Illan Baruch naDkt.
tgt: Izimvo ezinyhatshayo ezibhekiswe kwabo bathethela phandle kunye nakwiinkokeli zelizwe zenza isikhundla sikanozakuzaku Belotsercovsky singakhuseleki okanye angafumani khuseleko.

src: Alon Liel) lebebangayekeli kuchaza tento tahulumende wabo kubantfu basePalestine batifananisa neMbuso Welibandlululo.
tgt: Ke ngoko iKhabhinethi iyalele iSebe lezobuDlelwane beHlabathi neNtsebenziswano ukuba livakalise ukungoneliseki kukarhulumente waseMzantsi Afrika ngalo nozakuzaku oko kuzakwenziwa kulandelwa amajelo ozakuzo afanelekileyo.

src: Letinkhulumo leticekela phasi letibhekiswe kulabo labaphumisela kuphambana kwabo nalokubulala lokunelunya kanye nebaholi balelive kwenta sikhundla saBelotsercovsky sichubeke kungameleki.
tgt: INgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo woHlahlo Lwabiwomali leXesha eliPhakathi IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgxelo yoMgaqonkqubo yoHlahlo Lwabiwomali yeXesha eliPhakathi (i-MTBPS) yama-2023, enike uvavanyo olucacileyo lwemo yezoqoqosho ekhoyo ngoku kwaye yabonisa ukugcinwa kakuhle kwemali yethu yelizwe ngurhulumente nangona ephakathi kwemiqobo enzima.

src: Ngenca yaloko iKhabhinethi seyikhiphe umyalo wekutsi Litiko Lebudlelwane Kanye Nekuhlanganyela Nemave ledlulise kungaphatseki kahle kwahulumende weNingizimu Afrika ngalesento salelincusa lisebentisa tindlela tebuhlobo nalamanye emave.
tgt: Izigqibo ezikwi-MTBPS ziphucula inkqubosikhokelo yethu yezemali zivuselela ukukhula koqoqosho ngexa ingqinelanisa izibophelelo zethu zasekuhlaleni ezixhasa abo basesichengeni elizweni lethu.

src: Inkhulumo Yenchubo Yemaphakelotimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini IKhabhinethi isemukele Sitatimende Senchubo Yemaphaketimali Esikhatsi Esisemkhatsini (i-MTBPS), lesibeke elubala kuhlolwa kwesimo semnotfo saletinsuku yaphindze yabonisa kubambelela kwahulumende mayelana netimali talelive esikhatsini lapho kungena kwayo kunetihibe.
tgt: ISicwangciso soKwakha ngokuTsha eMva kweNtlekele sibe negalelo kwiimpawu zokuqala zokuphucuka kuqoqosho lwethu.

src: Tincumo leticuketfwe ngule-MTBPS tiyaluphakamisa luhlelo lwetimali temnyaka kukhutsatwa kwekukhula kwemnotfo kube kulinganisa nekutibophelela kwetfu eluntfwini lokusekela labo labasengcupheni esiveni sakitsi.
tgt: UPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu IKhabhinethi ivume iNkqubosikhokelo yoPhuhliso loMzila wooLoliwe abaHamba ngeSantya esiPhezulu kwaye iimpembelelo zemali ekuphunyezweni koku kuza kuxoxwa ngazo phakathi kwabaPhathiswa owezoThutho nowezeMali.

src: 3.Kwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu IKhabhinethi seyiphasise Luhlelo Loluluhlaka Lwekwakhiwa Kwemzila Wetitimela Letinelitubane Lelikhulu kantsi imitselela yekucaliswa kwaloluhlelo kutawudzingidvwa Tindvuna Tetekutfutsa kanye Netetimali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubekwa phambili komzila osuka e-Johannesburg uya eThekwini ngophononongo olucazululiweyo loko kunokwenzeka, kwaye osuka e-Johannesburg nase-Polokwane uya eMusina, kunye nosuka e-Johannesburg uya eMbombela ziza kubekwa emarikeni.

src: IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kubekwa embili kwemzila losemkhatsini weJozi kanye naseThekwini kwekutsi kube neluphandvo loluyibukisisako lendzaba, kulapho imizila emkhatsini weJozi nePolokwane naseMusina, kanye nalesemkhatsini neJozi neMbombela yona itawufakwa emakethe.
tgt: IPhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo eliQulunqwayo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngoBumi, iMfuduko kunye noKhuselo lweeMbacu ukuze ulunike izimvo uluntu.

src: Umhlahlandlela WeLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kushicilelwa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lelimayelana Nekuvikelwa Kwebuve, Kungena Eveni kanye Nekukhosela kuze sive sibeke imibono yaso.
tgt: UMgaqonkqubo oqulunqwayo ujolise ekunikeni inkqubosikhokelo yokukhokela ekunikweni kobuhlali nobumi kubemi bamazwe angaphandle, ngokunjalo nokukhuselwa kwembacu kunye nabafuni gwiba eMzantsi Afrika, kuthathelwa ingqalelo okubalulekileyo kukhuselo lwesizwe lweRiphabliki kunye nokuthotyelwa kwezivumelwano neeprotokoli zehlabathi ekufudukeni ezo uyinxenye yazo uMzantsi Afrika.

src: Lomhlahlandlela Wenchubo uhlose kubeka luhlaka lweticondziso tekuniketwa kwebuve nemvume yekuhlala kuleli kulabaphuma kulamanye emave, kanye nekuvikelwa kwalabakhosele kuleli laseNingizimu Afrika ngekubalekela timphi nekufuna kufihla inhloko ngenca yemphatfo yemave abo, ibe ingakhohlwa ngulokufunwa yiRiphabhliki mayelana netekuphepha kwelive ibuye ilandzele tivumelwano nenchubo yemave lecondzene netekuhamba emkhatsini wemave iNingizimu Afrika letibophelele kuko.
tgt: INgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka

src: Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili Lomayelana Nekusetjentiswa KweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Lemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kutsi Umbiko Wesitfupha Wemnyaka Wenchubekela Embili ngekusetjentiswa kweLiphepha Lelimhlophe Ngemalungelo Ebantfu Labakhubatekile ushicilelwe kugazethi yahulumende.
tgt: .IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kwigazethi karhulumente kweNgxelo yeNkqubela yoNyaka yesi-6 ngokuphunyezwa kwePhepha leNgcaciso-Nkqubo ngamaLungelo abaNtu abanokuKhubazeka.

src: Lokushicilelwa kwalombiko wenchubekela embili kutawucondzana nekugujwa kweNyanga Yekwatisa Ngemalungelo Alabakhubatekile lokucala mhlaka ti-3 kuLweti kuya kumhla ti-3 iNgongoni.
tgt: Ukupapashwa kwengxelo yenkqubela kuza kudibana nokukhunjulwa kwihlabathi kweNyanga yokuQondwa kwamaLungelo okuba nokuKhubazeka ukusukela ngowe-3 kweyeNkanga ukuya kowe-3 kweyoMnga.

src: Lombiko wenchubekela embili uphindze ubonise timphawu tekukhula kwesibalo lesingephasi semgomo wekulinganisa labacashiwe lesisuke ku-2% laya ku-3% webantfu labakhubatekile, sicondze ku-7% nakufika umnyaka wa-2030.
tgt: Ingxelo yenkqubela ikhombisa kananjalo ukonyuka kujoliso lolingano lobuncinane bengqesho ukusuka kwi-2% ukuya kwi-3% ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ukusukela kunyakamali ka-2024/2025, ngokubhekisele kubuncinane be-7% yojoliso lolingano kwingqesho ebantwini abanokukhubazeka ngowama-2030.

src: Imitsetfosivivinyo UMtsetfosivivinyo Loluhlaka weSikhwamamali Sekuvusetela i-Afrika Nekusebentisana Kwemave Ngemave (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi seyiphasise kufakwa ePhalamende kweMtsetfosivivinyo Wekuchibiyela we-ARLo Mtsetfosivivinyo uhlose kuchibela uMtsetfo we-ARF (Umtsetfo we-51 wange-2000) nekusungula i-Ejensi Yekutfutfukiswa Kwekubambisana eNingizimu Afrika, letawusetjentiswa njengendlela yekusekela kutfutfuka kanye nekubambisana kweNingizimu Afrika kanye nemave lahlobene nayo ngekuphakamisa inchubo yentsandvo yelinyenti, kubusa ngebucotfo, nekuncandza nekucatululwa tindzaba tembango eveni, kutfutfukisa tenhlalakahle nemnotfo kanye nekuhlanganyela.
tgt: ImiThetho eYilwayo UmThetho oYilwayo weNgxowamali yokuZalwa ngokuTsha kwe-Afrika kunye neNtsebenziswano (i-ARF) IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa komThetho oYilwayo oTshintshiweyo we-ARF ePalamente.

src: Kubekwa Etikhundleni Kutawucinisekiswa ticu tetemfundvo nekuhlola kufaneleka kwabo bonkhe lababekwe etikhundleni.
tgt: UmThetho oYilwayo ufuna ukutshitsha umThetho we-ARF (umThetho wama-51 ka-2000) kwaye useka i-Arhente yeNtsebenziswano yoPhuhliso loMzantsi Afrika, eza kusebenza njengendlela yokuxhasa uphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika kunye nentsebenziswano namazwe osebenzisana nawo oko kusenziwa ngokukhuthazwa kwentando yesininzi, ulawulo olululo, uphuhliso kunye nokuhlanganisa okunxulumene nezentlalo nezoqoqosho.

src: Kubekwa kwa-MnuEbrahim Rasool esikhundleni sekuba nguSihlalo we-Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Abaqeshiweyo Zonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu.

src: Kubekwa kwa-MkMargaret Mosibudi kuba lilunga le-National Nuclear Regulator Board.
tgt: Ebrahim Rasool njengoSihlalo weBhanki yoPhuhliso yamaZantsi e-Afrika.

src: Imicimbi Letako Ingcoco Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Ingcoco yekumelana nenkhohlakalo itawubanjwa mhlaka ti-8 namhla ti-9 kuLweti 2023 eHhotela i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni kutogcugcutela umphakatsi ekulweni nenkhohlakalo ngekuhambisana neNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni.
tgt: IMisitho Ezayo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo INgxoxo emayelana nokuLwa noRhwaphilizo iza kubanjwa ngowe-8 nowe-9 kweyeNkanga 2023 kwiHotele i-Birchwood Ekurhuleni ukuhlanganisa uluntu kumlo ochasene norhwaphilizo ngokungqinelana neSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe.

src: Ngenyanga yeLweti 2020, iKhabhinethi yaphasisa iNdlelalisu Yekumelana Nenkhohlakalo Eveni (i-NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: IKhabhinethi, ngeyeNkanga 2020, yasivuma iSicwangciso esiLwa uRhwaphilizo seSizwe (i-NACS 2020-2030).

src: Lena kuyindlela yelive lehlose kusungula umphakatsi longenankhohlakalo iphindze ikhutsate sive kutsi singayibeketeleli inkhohlakalo futsi sigcine umtsetfo lobekiwe.
tgt: Esi sisicwangciso selizwe esijolise ekudaleni indawo yoluntu engenalo urhwaphilizo ngexa kananjalo sikhuthaza abemi ukuba bangalunyamezeli kwaphela urhwaphilizo kwaye bathobele ulawulo lomthetho.

src: Umnkankaso Wemalanga Langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kanye Nebantfwana wange-2023 Lomnyaka lesikuwo wekukhumbula minyaka lenge-25 yekuhlanganyela kweNingizimu Afrika kuloMkankaso Wemalanga langu-16 Wekumelana Nekuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati Nebantfwana lotawugujwa ngephasi kwesicubulo lesitsi: “Kukhutsatwa Kwetento Tekucedza Budlova Lobucondziswe Kubulili Lobutsite Nekubulawa Kwebasikati (i-GBVF): Asishiyi Muntfu Ngaphandle”.
tgt: IiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo lokuChasa ubuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana lika-2023 Lo nyaka uphawula isikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-25 sothatho nxaxheba loMzantsi Afrika kwiiNtsuku ezili-16 zePhulo lobuTshantliziyo ekuChaseni ubuNdlobongela obubhekiswe kwabaseTyhini nabaNtwana eliza kuqwalaselwa phantsi komxholo: “Ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuphelisa ubuNdlobongela obuSekelwe kwiSini nokuBulawa kwabaseTyhini (i-GBVF): Kungashiywa mntu emva”.

src: Lomkhankaso wemhlaba utawucala kusukela mhlaka ti-25 kuLweti, ngeLilanga Lemave Lekucedza Kuhlukubetwa Kwebasikati kuze kube ngumhla ti-10 kuNgongoni, lekuLilanga Lemave Lemalungelo Eluntfu.
tgt: Eli phulo lehlabathi liqhuba ukusukela kowama-25 kweyeNkanga, uSuku lweHlabathi lokuPheliswa kobuNdlobongela obuBhekiswe kwabaseTyhini ukuya kowe-10 kweyoMnga, uSuku lwamaLungelo oluNtu lweHlabathi.

src: Lomkhankaso uhlose kucedza kuhlukubetwa kwebasikati kodvwa kube kuphakanyiswa emalungelo eluntfu.
tgt: Lijolise ekulweni ubundlobongela obubhekiswe kwabasetyhini ngexa lisagcine amalungelo oluntu.

src: Umhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo INingizimu Afrika itawubambisana neLicembu Lemave laboThishela le-UNESCO (i-TTF) kusingatsa uMhlangano Weli-14 Wengcoco Yenchubomgomo ngenyanga yaBhimbidvwane 2024, lotawubanjwa ngephasi kwesihloko lesitsi “Kubukana nekungabikho kwabothishela ngalokwenele nekwenta lomsebenti wekufundzisa ube ngulokhangisako”.
tgt: IQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 UMzantsi Afrika uza kusingatha iQonga leNgxoxo yoMgaqosiseko ye-14 idibene noMsebenzi oWenziwa ngooTitshala kwiMfundo weHlabathi (i-TTF) we-UNESCO ngeyoMqungu ka-2024 phantsi komxholo “Ukuthathela ingqalelo ukunqongophala kootitshala kunye nokuwenza ube nomtsalane ngakumbi umsebenzi lo”.

src: Lomhlangano utawubutsanisa tisebenti tahulumende, bothishela kanye netingcweti temfundvo kutodzingidza ndzaba letiphatselene nesimo sekusebenta kwabothishela, tindzaba tekukhutimela kwabothishela ekusebenteni kwabo kanye nekutiphendvulela nekwenta umsebenti wekufundzisa ukhangeke.
tgt: Iqonga liza kuhlanganisa kunye amagosa karhulumente, ii-NGO, ootitshala kunye nengcali zemfundo ukuxoxa ngemiba ebalulekileyo ephathelene neemeko zengqesho kootitshala, imiba yokuzimela nokuthatha uxanduva kootitshala ngokunjalo nendlela yokwenza ube nomtsalane umsebenzi wokufundisa.

src: Licembu lema-Proteas ngekutibekela indzawo ekucudzelaneni lokwendvulela umdlalo wekugcina wekhilikithi weNdzebe Yemhlaba ye-ICC 2023 eNdiya.
tgt: Ii-Proteas ngokuzifumanela indawo kwimidlalo eyandulela eyokugqibela kwindebe yeHlabathi ye-ICC ka-2023 e-Indiya.

src: Nobe kube khona kubuyiselwa emuva emdlalweni wabo neNdiya itolo, live lakitsi lime lisimile ngekusekela lelicembu futsi liyetsemba kwekutsi licembu litawuchubeka kwakha nekusenta sitichenye.
tgt: Nangona zingakhange ziphumelele kumdlalo wazo ne-Indiya izolo, ilizwe lisahleli libaxhasa ngamandla kwaye linethemba lokuba ziza kuqhuba ukwakha kwaye zisenze sibe nebhongo.

src: Sihlabani semjako we-Moto GP, Brad Binder, losenyalo ente umlandvo wema ephodiyamu yalabahamba embili wamela iNingizimu Afrika kulandzela kuphumelela kwakhe waba kulabatsatfu labasembili emjahweni i-Grand prix eThailand.
tgt: Umqhubi wemoto yomdyarho ye-Moto GP u-Brad Binder waseMzantsi Afrika ngoku onerekhodi yodidi oluphezulu kwiphodiyam emva kokugqiba kwakhe ephezulu ekwindawo yesithathu kuMdyarho weeMoto wase-Thailand.

src: Umdlali waseNingizimu Afrika walabakha ticubu temtimba nalohamba ngencola yalabakhubatekile, Macethandile Kulati ngekuvikela sicoco sakhe Emdlalweni wanga-2023 Wenhlangano Yemave Yabombetsa Labakha Ticubu Temtimba eSlovania.
tgt: USozinyama wokuqala ohamba ngesitulo esinamavili waseMzantsi Afrika u-Macethandile Kulati ngokukhusela isitsaba sakhe kwiQumrhu leHlabathi looSozinyama leHlabathi kunye nobuNtshatsheli ekuziLolongeni kwiHlabathi ngo-2023 e-Slovenia.

src: Ngasetibalweni tetimali, i-South African Chartered Accountants lebambe lichaza lelisetulu eluphandvweni lwabochwepheshe emhlabeni jikelele lolwentiwe yi-Edelman.
tgt: I-South African Chartered Accountants ngokufumana isikhundla esiphezulu kuphando lwehlabathi lokwenza umsebenzi ngokwethembeka olwenziwe yi-Edelman.

src: Dkt Calude Mashego ngekutsatsa sicoco sekubekwa abe yiNkhosatana yeMhlaba eNingizimu Afrika, losatawumela live laseNingizimu Afrika emcudzelwaneni wesicoco semhlaba seNkhosatana Yemhlaba lotawubanjelwa e-New Delhi, eNdiya ngeNgongoni lonyaka.
tgt: UGqr Claude Mashego ngokuphumelela ukhuphiswano lokuba nguNkosazana Mzantsi Afrika okokuqala kwaye ke ngoku uza kumela uMzantsi Afrika kuNkosazana Mzantsi Afrika kwiNkosazana yeHlabathi e-New Delhi, e-Indiya ngeyoMnga kulo nyaka.

src: UMmeli Kholeka Gcaleka kulandzela kubekwa kwakhe kutsi abe nguMvikeli Weluntfu lomusha lokutawuba sikhatsi lesiminyaka lesikhombisa letako kusukela mhlaka lu-1 kuLweti 2023.

src: Lowatfweswa sicoco seligolide, Zanele Situ ngekuphuma embili emcudzelwaneni walabakhubatekile waba wekucala kulabasikati labamnyama kutsatsa imedali yeligolide Emidlalweni Yalabakhubatekile eSydney nga-2000.
